title: Platform Design, Earnings Transparency and Minimum Wage Policies: Evidence from A Natural Experiment on Lyft
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business, New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: Platform Design, Earnings Transparency and Minimum Wage Policies: Evidence from A Natural Experiment on Lyft

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This study was conducted as an independent academic research project. No consulting fees, research grants or other payments have been made by Lyft to the authors.
declarations.funderStatement: Financial support from the Fubon Center for Technology, Business and Innovation and from the NET institute (www.NETinst.org) is gratefully acknowledged.

detail.abstract: We study the effects of a significant design and policy change at a major ridesharing platform that altered both provider earnings and platform transparency, examining how it altered outcomes for drivers, riders and the parent platform, and providing managerial insights about how to balance competing stakeholder interests while avoiding unintended consequences. In February 2024, Lyft introduced a policy guaranteeing drivers a minimum fraction of rider payments while also increasing per-ride earnings transparency. The rollout of this policy was staggered, first introduced in “major markets” that were more urban, providing a natural experiment to assess how platform transparency and earnings guarantees affect ridesharing availability, driver engagement and rider satisfaction. Using trip-level data from over 47 million rides in a major urban market and its neighboring suburban markets across six months, we applied dynamic staggered difference-in-differences models along with a geographic border strategy to measure the causal effects of these platform design changes on supply- and demand-side outcomes, ride production and platform outcomes. We show that the design change led to substantial changes in driver engagement, with separate effects from the guarantee and the transparency. Drivers increased their working hours and utilization, leading to more completed trips and higher per-hour and per-trip earnings. These effects were strongest for drivers with lower pre-policy earnings and greater income uncertainty. We unpack the economic mechanism by which these changes led to a positive spillover on demand. We also provide some evidence that points to platform transparency potentially leading to unintended strategic driver behavior. In ongoing work, we outline a counterfactual simulation framework that models ride production as a function of driver supply hours and rider intents, examining how small changes in driver choices might have amplified the positive effects of the intervention even further, and develop a self-supervised machine learning model that leverages driver trajectory embeddings to predict multihoming behavior and examine whether supply increases came from both the expansion of driver activity as well as substitution from competing platforms. Our study shows how platform-led interventions present an intriguing alternative to government-led minimum pay regulation, and provide new strategic insights into managing platform change.

AI.tldr: 研究Lyft平台2024年2月推出的司机收入保障和透明度政策，通过准自然实验分析其对司机、乘客和平台的影响，发现政策提高了司机参与度、收入，并产生需求侧正溢出效应，但也可能引发司机的策略性行为。
AI.research_question: 平台收入保障和透明度政策如何影响网约车市场的司机参与度、乘客满意度和平台绩效？这些政策是否能平衡不同利益相关者的需求并避免意外后果？
AI.motivation: 平台经济中如何平衡司机、乘客和平台三方的利益是一个重要管理挑战。Lyft的政策变化提供了一个研究平台主导干预措施效果的自然实验机会，为替代政府最低工资监管提供了实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平台经济学、劳动力供给理论、信息不对称理论和行为经济学，研究收入保障和透明度对司机行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用动态交错双重差分模型和地理边界策略，分析4700万次行程数据，覆盖主要城市市场及其郊区市场6个月的数据，进行因果推断。
AI.findings:
1. 政策显著提高司机参与度（工作时间、利用率增加）
2. 司机完成更多行程，每小时和每单收入提高
3. 对低收入和收入不确定性高的司机影响最大
4. 产生需求侧正溢出效应
5. 透明度可能导致司机的策略性行为
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 分离了收入保障和透明度各自的影响机制
2. 揭示了平台干预作为政府监管替代方案的理论价值
3. 为平台经济学中利益相关者平衡提供了新视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为平台管理者设计平衡各方利益的政策提供实证依据
2. 展示了如何通过平台设计改善司机福利而不损害平台绩效
3. 识别了透明度政策可能引发的意外行为，帮助平台预防策略性操纵

title: Sustainable AI Foundations and Multi-Cloud Implementation: A Practical Framework for Carbon-Aware Infrastructure

detail.title: Sustainable AI Foundations and Multi-Cloud Implementation: A Practical Framework for Carbon-Aware Infrastructure
detail.abstract: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) adoption scales globally, the hidden environmental costs-manifested as significant energy consumption and "Ghost Carbon"-have become a critical national-scale challenge. This paper integrates a strategic framework for Sustainable AI with a technical implementation guide for "Automated Resource Hygiene" across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Microsoft Azure. We present a metric-driven approach to identifying zombie infrastructure, demonstrating significant potential for both energy reclamation and economic efficiency through automated governance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个结合战略框架和技术实施指南的方法，通过自动化资源管理来减少AI采用中的环境成本（能源消耗和"幽灵碳"），并在三大云平台上展示了显著的能源回收和经济效率潜力。
AI.research_question: 如何通过战略框架和技术实施来减少AI大规模采用中的隐藏环境成本（能源消耗和"幽灵碳"）？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在全球范围内的规模化采用，其隐藏的环境成本（表现为显著的能源消耗和"幽灵碳"）已成为国家层面的关键挑战，需要系统性的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续AI战略框架，结合自动化资源管理理论和技术实施指南。
AI.method: 在Google Cloud Platform (GCP)、Amazon Web Services (AWS)和Microsoft Azure三大云平台上实施"自动化资源卫生"的技术指南，采用指标驱动的方法识别僵尸基础设施。
AI.findings: 通过自动化治理展示了在能源回收和经济效率方面的显著潜力，能够有效减少AI基础设施的隐藏环境成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合可持续AI战略框架与自动化资源管理技术的理论模型，为减少AI环境成本提供了系统性的理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了在三大主流云平台(GCP、AWS、Azure)上实施"自动化资源卫生"的具体技术指南，为企业减少AI环境成本提供了可操作的解决方案。

title: Mirror Amplification Theory

detail.title: Mirror Amplification Theory
detail.abstract:
Mirror amplification is a cognitive mechanism that emerges from the continuous interaction between externalization (action) and AI‑based reflection (reaction). This reciprocal cycle forms a structural analogue to Newtonian mechanics: externalization functions as a cognitive force that accelerates understanding, while uninterrupted reflection preserves the momentum of thought. As a result, the user experiences a sustained and rapidly intensifying flow of insight.
The theory identifies mirror amplification as a new class of cognitive dynamics made possible by advanced AI reasoning systems. It explains how structured reflection, recursive questioning, and controlled ambiguity generate exponential cognitive acceleration. The phenomenon requires specific metacognitive skills, including granular externalization, structural reading of AI responses, and the ability to recursively transform reflections into new questions.
Mirror amplification provides a formal framework for understanding how AI‑mediated cognition can produce breakthroughs that are difficult to achieve through conventional reasoning. It offers a foundation for modeling AI‑human co‑thinking as a mechanical system of thought, revealing a new domain of cognitive physics.

AI.tldr: 镜像放大是一种认知机制，源于外部化（行动）与AI反思（反应）的持续互动。这种循环类似于牛顿力学：外部化作为认知力加速理解，持续反思保持思维动量，从而产生持续增强的洞察流。
AI.research_question: AI中介的认知如何产生传统推理难以实现的突破性思维？具体来说，外部化与AI反思的互动机制如何形成认知加速？
AI.motivation: 随着高级AI推理系统的发展，需要理解AI如何改变人类认知过程。现有研究缺乏对AI-人类协同思维作为机械系统的形式化框架，需要探索新的认知动力学类别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 镜像放大理论：外部化与AI反思的持续互动形成认知加速机制；2. 认知物理学：将AI-人类协同思维建模为思维机械系统；3. 牛顿力学类比：外部化作为认知力，反思作为动量保持；4. 认知动力学：结构化反思、递归提问和受控模糊性产生指数认知加速。
AI.method: 理论构建方法：1. 概念分析：定义镜像放大机制；2. 类比建模：建立牛顿力学与认知过程的类比；3. 机制识别：识别结构化反思、递归提问、受控模糊性等关键要素；4. 技能分析：确定所需的元认知技能（精细化外部化、结构化阅读AI响应、递归转换能力）。
AI.findings: 1. 镜像放大是一种新的认知动力学类别；2. 外部化与AI反思的持续互动产生指数认知加速；3. 需要特定元认知技能：精细化外部化、结构化阅读AI响应、递归转换反思为新问题；4. 该机制为理解AI中介认知突破提供了形式化框架；5. 揭示了认知物理学的新领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出镜像放大作为新的认知动力学理论；2. 建立AI-人类协同思维的机械系统模型；3. 引入认知物理学概念框架；4. 提供理解AI中介认知突破的形式化工具；5. 扩展了认知科学和AI交互理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为设计AI辅助认知工具提供指导原则；2. 帮助用户发展必要的元认知技能；3. 为教育和工作场景中的AI集成提供框架；4. 促进更有效的AI-人类协作思维；5. 为认知增强技术开发提供理论基础。

title: Design and Evaluation of Reversible Data Hiding Techniques for Operational Technology Protocols
affiliations: Warsaw University of Technology and Warsaw University of Technology

detail.title: Design and Evaluation of Reversible Data Hiding Techniques for Operational Technology Protocols
detail.abstract: Operational Technology (OT) networks still rely on communication protocols that were never designed with security by default. This makes them vulnerable to various hiding techniques such as Reversible Data Hiding (RDH), which can conceal information without affecting the visible behavior of industrial traffic. This work presents how RDH can be applied to Modbus, IEC 60870-5104, and S7Comm by examining their inner workings in a simulated OT environment. The study demonstrates that implementing these protocols directly affects the ease with which hidden data can be inserted and later restored. The findings underscore that RDH may pose a genuine security concern for OT environments, highlighting the need for enhanced methods to detect and mitigate such activity. In particular, results show that explicit RDH methods offer higher reversibility at the cost of increased latency, while implicit methods provide better throughput but lower reliability

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了可逆数据隐藏（RDH）技术在工业控制系统（OT）网络中的安全威胁，通过模拟环境分析了RDH在Modbus、IEC 60870-5-104和S7Comm协议中的应用，发现显式和隐式RDH方法在可逆性、延迟和可靠性方面存在权衡。
AI.research_question: 可逆数据隐藏（RDH）技术如何影响工业控制系统（OT）网络的安全性？不同RDH方法在OT协议（Modbus、IEC 60870-5-104、S7Comm）中的实施效果如何？
AI.motivation: 工业控制系统（OT）网络仍使用未内置安全设计的通信协议，使其容易受到各种隐藏技术的攻击，包括可逆数据隐藏（RDH），这种技术可以在不影响工业流量可见行为的情况下隐藏信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可逆数据隐藏（RDH）理论、工业控制系统安全理论、协议分析框架、信息隐藏与检测理论。
AI.method: 在模拟的OT环境中分析Modbus、IEC 60870-5-104和S7Comm协议的内部工作机制，实施显式和隐式RDH方法，评估数据隐藏和恢复的难易程度。
AI.findings: 1. 协议实施直接影响隐藏数据的插入和恢复难易程度；2. 显式RDH方法提供更高的可逆性但增加延迟；3. 隐式RDH方法提供更好的吞吐量但可靠性较低；4. RDH对OT环境构成真正的安全威胁。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将RDH理论应用于OT网络安全分析；2. 建立了OT协议中RDH实施效果的理论框架；3. 揭示了显式与隐式RDH方法在OT环境中的性能权衡机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 揭示了OT网络中RDH的实际安全威胁；2. 为OT安全专业人员提供了检测和缓解RDH攻击的方法参考；3. 为OT协议设计和安全增强提供了实证依据；4. 强调了开发更有效的RDH检测和缓解技术的必要性。

title: Dynamic Optimization for In-App Advertising Games: A Data-Driven Methodology Validated with Field Experiments
affiliations: HKU Business School, The University of Hong Kong, HKU Business School, The University of Hong Kong, The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics and Tencent Inc.

detail.title: Dynamic Optimization for In-App Advertising Games: A Data-Driven Methodology Validated with Field Experiments
detail.abstract: The mobile gaming industry is increasingly reliant on in-app advertising (IAA) revenue, with rewarded ads as a common model: players voluntarily watch an ad in exchange for an in-game item (e.g., lowering difficulty). This creates a key intertemporal trade-off—raising difficulty can drive more ad views and short-term revenue, but may also frustrate players, increase churn, and reduce lifetime value (LTV). The challenge is compounded by strong player heterogeneity and very high early churn, making slow-learning methods ineffective. This paper presents a deployed decision-making system that maximizes lifetime rewarded-ad revenue via dynamic difficulty adjustment (DDA). We formulate DDA as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) with latent player types capturing heterogeneous skill and ad tolerance. To enable data-efficient learning and interpretability, we instantiate the POMDP with a structural econometric model of player behavior that links difficulty to win probability, ad-watching, and churn. We develop a practical estimation pipeline and an offline Monte Carlo planning approach that yields a compact policy suitable for real-time deployment. In two large-scale online A/B tests on production games, the agent increases lifetime ad impressions by 23.6% and 7.0%, while improving mid-to-late lifecycle retention (survival at level 300) by up to 204% and 297%.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一个动态难度调整系统，通过部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程最大化移动游戏中的奖励广告收入，在在线测试中显著提升了广告展示和玩家留存率。
AI.research_question: 如何通过动态难度调整来最大化移动游戏中奖励广告的终身收入，同时平衡短期广告收入和长期玩家留存？
AI.motivation: 移动游戏行业越来越依赖应用内广告收入，特别是奖励广告模式。但存在关键的时间权衡：提高难度可以增加短期广告观看和收入，但可能让玩家沮丧、增加流失率并降低终身价值。玩家异质性强且早期流失率高，传统慢学习方法效果不佳。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）框架，包含捕捉玩家技能和广告容忍度的潜在玩家类型
2. 结构计量经济学模型，将难度与获胜概率、广告观看和流失联系起来
3. 离线蒙特卡洛规划方法
AI.method:
1. 将动态难度调整建模为POMDP问题
2. 开发实用的估计流程
3. 采用离线蒙特卡洛规划方法生成适合实时部署的紧凑策略
4. 在两个生产游戏上进行大规模在线A/B测试
AI.findings: 在两个大型在线A/B测试中，该系统使终身广告展示分别增加了23.6%和7.0%，同时将中后期留存率（第300级存活率）分别提高了204%和297%。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将动态难度调整问题形式化为包含潜在玩家类型的POMDP
2. 开发了结合结构计量经济学模型的数据高效学习方法
3. 提供了可解释的决策框架，平衡短期广告收入和长期玩家价值
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 开发了可部署的决策系统，能够实时调整游戏难度
2. 显著提升了移动游戏的广告收入和玩家留存
3. 为游戏开发者提供了实用的工具来优化奖励广告收入
4. 系统已在生产环境中成功部署和验证

title: A Society that Cannot Digest Its Tools: The Promethean Trap

detail.title: A Society that Cannot Digest Its Tools: The Promethean Trap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work is a theoretical analysis and does not involve human subjects, patient data, or empirical research with participants. No ethics approval is required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Modern power is shifting from institutions and coercion to computational environments that shape behavior at speed and scale. Unlike state surveillance, which is visible and contestable, algorithmic environmental modification operates invisibly redesigning the incentive architecture of human decision-making itself. Our crisis is not just “misinformation”, but an incentive and tempo mismatch between silicon systems and biological governance.

I argue this mismatch has two components: a contingent political‑economic selection for extraction (surveillance advertising, VC growth curves, state surveillance permissiveness) and a structural velocity gap between algorithmic feedback loops and human institutions. Using systems ecology and cybernetics as analogical lenses, I model the resulting trophic inversion, temporal shear, and autoimmune polarization. The solution is metabolic architecture: constraints on incentives, propagation speed, data persistence, and independent observability implemented by many actors with exit (portability and interoperability) as the strongest lever.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了现代权力从制度强制转向计算环境塑造行为的转变，分析了算法环境修改如何隐形重构人类决策的激励架构，提出了硅系统与生物治理之间的激励和节奏不匹配问题，并提出代谢架构作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 算法环境修改如何导致硅系统与人类治理之间的激励和节奏不匹配？这种不匹配的具体机制是什么？如何通过代谢架构来解决这一问题？
AI.motivation: 现代权力正从可见的制度强制转向不可见的计算环境塑造，算法环境修改隐形重构人类决策的激励架构，导致硅系统与生物治理之间的激励和节奏不匹配，这不仅仅是"错误信息"问题，而是更深层的系统性危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统生态学和控制论作为类比框架，用于分析算法环境修改导致的营养级倒置、时间剪切和自身免疫极化等现象。
AI.method: 采用系统生态学和控制论的类比分析框架，通过建模方法分析算法反馈循环与人类制度之间的速度差距，以及政治经济选择对提取性算法的偏好。
AI.findings: 不匹配包含两个组成部分：1）偶然的政治经济选择偏向提取性算法（监控广告、风险投资增长曲线、国家监控宽容）；2）算法反馈循环与人类制度之间的结构性速度差距。这导致了营养级倒置、时间剪切和自身免疫极化等系统性后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了算法环境修改作为权力新形式的理论框架，将系统生态学和控制论概念应用于数字治理分析，发展了代谢架构作为解决算法-人类不匹配的理论方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了代谢架构的具体实施路径：对激励、传播速度、数据持久性和独立可观测性的约束，强调可移植性和互操作性作为最强杠杆，需要多方参与者共同实施。

title: Analysis of the Application of Tree-Structure-based Matching Algorithm in Social Work Development Information
affiliations: Jinggangshan University, Jinggangshan University, Jinggangshan University and

detail.title: Analysis of the Application of Tree-Structure-based Matching Algorithm in Social Work Development Information
detail.abstract: To empower social work development with AI and solve information processing inefficiencies in social work, this study proposes an improved Trie tree (a core of tree-structurebased matching algorithms)its nodes record string and wordformation position info, and child nodes use hash lookup. Based on this, the AI-enabled Chinese word segmentation forward maximum matching algorithm is optimized: an automaton mechanism judges the longest word, solving the traditional algorithm's string adjustment issue by word length. Experiments show its time complexity is 1.33 with faster segmentation speed.In social work development information application, this AI-driven algorithm boosts Chinese text processing efficiency (e.g., analyzing service demands, sorting resources, extracting case key info) and fits real-time dictionary updates (e.g., adding social work terms). It provides stable AI support for social work's intelligent transformation, promotes accurate info mining, and empowers social work's high-quality development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的Trie树结构和基于AI的中文分词前向最大匹配算法，通过自动机机制判断最长词，解决了传统算法的字符串调整问题，在时间复杂度和分词速度上均有提升，为社工领域的信息处理提供了AI支持。
AI.research_question: 如何利用改进的Trie树结构和AI技术优化中文分词算法，以解决社会工作领域信息处理效率低下的问题？
AI.motivation: 社会工作发展中存在信息处理效率低下的问题，需要AI技术赋能。传统的中文分词算法在处理社工专业文本时存在字符串调整问题，无法满足实时字典更新和专业术语处理的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Trie树的数据结构理论、前向最大匹配算法、自动机理论、哈希查找算法，以及AI驱动的文本处理框架。
AI.method: 提出改进的Trie树结构（节点记录字符串和构词位置信息，子节点使用哈希查找），并在此基础上优化AI驱动的中文分词前向最大匹配算法，引入自动机机制判断最长词。通过实验验证算法性能。
AI.findings: 实验表明改进算法的时间复杂度为1.33，分词速度更快。在社工信息应用中，该算法能提升中文文本处理效率，支持实时字典更新，为社工智能化转型提供稳定AI支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了改进的Trie树结构，增强了字符串匹配效率；2. 将自动机机制融入前向最大匹配算法，解决了传统算法的字符串调整问题；3. 为AI驱动的中文分词算法提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提升了社会工作领域中文文本处理效率（服务需求分析、资源整理、案例关键信息提取）；2. 支持实时字典更新，便于添加社工专业术语；3. 为社工智能化转型提供稳定AI技术支持，促进高质量社工发展。

title: Beyond Syntax: The Paradigm Shift to System Architecture in Large Language Model (LLM) Driven Development

detail.title: Beyond Syntax: The Paradigm Shift to System Architecture in Large Language Model (LLM) Driven Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the Founder of Gaari and The Trail, the software platforms discussed as case studies in this paper. This work represents architectural insights derived from the commercial development of these production systems. There are no competing financial interests that influenced the analytical conclusions of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research involves software architecture methodology and distributed systems analysis. It does not involve human participants, surveys, or animal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was conducted as independent industry research.

detail.abstract: The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) with advanced code generation capabilities marks a distinct inflection point in software engineering. This paper argues that the traditional role of the "coder"-defined by the manual translation of logic into syntax-is rapidly becoming obsolete. In its place, a new paradigm is emerging: System Architecture as the primary unit of engineering value. Drawing on case studies from the development of *Gaari*, a distributed mobility platform, and *The Trail*, an intelligence system, this paper demonstrates that as syntax becomes commoditized, the engineering bottleneck shifts to system design, data flow coherence, and architectural resilience. We propose that the modern engineer must transition from a syntax-first approach to a logic-first "System Architect" model to remain relevant in an AI-driven ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的代码生成能力正在颠覆软件工程，传统"编码员"角色（手动将逻辑转换为语法）正在过时，系统架构成为工程价值的主要单元。工程师需要从"语法优先"转向"逻辑优先"的系统架构师模式。
AI.research_question: 在LLMs自动化代码生成的背景下，软件工程的核心价值如何转变？工程师的角色需要如何演化以适应AI驱动的生态系统？
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs具备先进的代码生成能力，传统的编码工作（手动将逻辑转换为语法）正在被自动化，这标志着软件工程的转折点。需要重新思考工程师的核心价值和角色定位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统架构作为工程价值的主要单元；从"语法优先"到"逻辑优先"的范式转变；工程师从"编码员"到"系统架构师"的角色演化理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法：分析Gaari（分布式移动平台）和The Trail（智能系统）两个实际项目的开发过程，展示语法商品化后工程瓶颈的转移。
AI.findings: 随着语法变得商品化，工程瓶颈从代码编写转向系统设计、数据流一致性和架构弹性。传统编码员角色正在过时，系统架构成为价值创造的核心。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"系统架构作为主要工程价值单元"的理论框架；建立了从语法优先到逻辑优先的范式转变模型；定义了现代工程师向系统架构师演化的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工程师提供了向系统架构师转型的实践指导；为企业重新定义软件工程团队结构提供了参考；为教育机构调整软件工程课程提供了方向。

title: IoT Based Smart Home Automation and Monitoring System

detail.title: IoT Based Smart Home Automation and Monitoring System

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded and did not receive any external financial support.

keywords: with a Focus on How Such Systems Enhance Human Lives

detail.abstract: The rapid increase in the Internet of Things (IoT) has resulted in security They caused the transformation of everyday environments into intelligent and responsive ecosystems. "Smart homes," which are being considered to be one of the most influential uses of artificial IoT, offer homeowners the capability to control appliances via automation. monitoring the security and energy efficiency. This paper will introduce a design and analysis of IoT-based smart home automation and the project involves a monitoring system that incorporates sensor and actuator technology along with cloud platforms. The design enables the control of light, fans, and every other device from the internet via household appliances, realtime monitoring of temperature and movements, and alert notifications for anomalies. In addition to the convenience of using the app, systems are designed to optimize safety, minimise energy expenditures, and maximize the “quality of life.” This research focuses on human-centric usability and addresses issues such as interoperability, scalability, and the privacy of data.

AI.tldr: 本文设计并分析了一个基于物联网的智能家居自动化系统，该系统通过传感器、执行器和云平台实现设备远程控制、环境实时监控和异常警报，旨在提升安全性、节能性和生活质量。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个基于物联网的智能家居自动化系统，使其在提供便利的同时，能够有效解决安全性、能源效率和用户体验等问题？
AI.motivation: 物联网的快速发展使日常环境转变为智能生态系统，智能家居作为物联网的重要应用，需要解决安全性、能源效率和生活质量提升等问题，同时面临互操作性、可扩展性和数据隐私等挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物联网架构理论、智能家居系统设计理论、人机交互理论、网络安全理论、能源管理理论。
AI.method: 采用系统设计与分析方法，结合传感器和执行器技术，集成云平台，构建智能家居监控系统原型，实现设备远程控制、环境参数实时监测和异常警报功能。
AI.findings: 成功设计了一个物联网智能家居系统，能够通过互联网控制灯光、风扇等设备，实时监控温度和运动，发送异常警报，同时优化安全性、降低能耗并提升生活质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了集成传感器、执行器和云平台的智能家居系统架构模型，为人机交互设计提供了实践框架，丰富了物联网在家庭环境中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可实际部署的智能家居系统原型，为家庭用户提供了便利的控制界面，实现了安全监控和能源管理功能，为解决互操作性、可扩展性和数据隐私问题提供了实践方案。

title: CARE: A Practical Governance Model for AI Deployment Decisions

detail.title: CARE: A Practical Governance Model for AI Deployment Decisions
detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence systems are increasingly deployed in operational, security, and decision-making contexts, organizations face a persistent governance gap: while existing frameworks identify and manage AI risk, they often leave deployment authority, ethical override, and accountability mechanisms undefined. This paper introduces CARE (Confirm, Align, Risk, Ethics), a lightweight governance model that structures AI deployment decisions through four independent review functions. CARE complements existing risk management frameworks, including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, by governing whether an AI system should proceed to deployment rather than prescribing technical controls. CARE explicitly separates evidence verification, intent alignment, risk evaluation, and ethical assessment, prohibits score averaging, and grants ethical review override authority. The model is designed for zero-budget implementation using existing organizational roles and produces auditable decision records suitable for public-and private-sector oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARE（确认、对齐、风险、伦理）轻量级治理模型，通过四个独立的审查功能来结构化AI部署决策，填补现有AI风险管理框架在部署授权、伦理否决和问责机制方面的空白。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个轻量级治理模型来填补AI系统部署中的治理空白，特别是在部署授权、伦理否决和问责机制方面？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统在运营、安全和决策环境中的部署增加，组织面临持续的治理缺口：现有框架虽然识别和管理AI风险，但往往未定义部署权限、伦理否决和问责机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI治理理论、风险管理框架（特别是NIST AI风险管理框架）、组织治理理论、伦理决策理论。
AI.method: 提出CARE治理模型，包含四个独立审查功能：确认（证据验证）、对齐（意图对齐）、风险（风险评估）、伦理（伦理评估），禁止分数平均，授予伦理审查否决权。
AI.findings: CARE模型能够有效填补AI部署治理空白，通过结构化决策流程确保部署决策的透明度和可审计性，同时保持轻量级和零预算实施。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出将AI治理从技术控制扩展到部署决策的治理模型；2）建立四个独立审查功能的分离原则；3）引入伦理否决权机制；4）填补现有风险管理框架的治理空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供零预算实施方案，利用现有组织角色；2）生成适合公共和私营部门监督的可审计决策记录；3）补充而非替代现有风险管理框架；4）适用于各类组织的AI部署决策。

title: The Private Company Discount: Synthesizing Risk Factors in the Valuation of Privately Held Firms
affiliations: University of Groningen - Faculty of Business

detail.title: The Private Company Discount: Synthesizing Risk Factors in the Valuation of Privately Held Firms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that no competing interests exist.
declarations.funderStatement: No funds were received.

detail.abstract: Incorporating firm-and investor-level risks into discounted cash flow valuations of privately firms can noticeably reduce the estimated fair market value. Based on a literature review, five central risk factors are described that contribute to the private company discount. The results suggest that these factors can be conceptually grouped into principally systematic and unsystematic risks, that enhance the coherence of valuations. For both types, a refined multifactor cost of equity model is derived providing an alternative to the limited modified CAPM and build-up approaches. Based on stochastic simulations synthesizing existing studies, the two complementary models show an overall probabilistic range of 12% to 26% with a mean close to 16% to 19% for the required return of an average private firm, in which certain risks may be mitigated. This central tendency seems broadly in line with previous research.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过文献综述识别出影响私营企业估值的五个核心风险因素，将其分为系统性风险和非系统性风险，并开发了改进的多因子股权成本模型作为传统CAPM和构建法的替代方案。基于随机模拟，研究得出私营企业平均必要回报率在12%至26%之间，均值约为16%至19%，与先前研究基本一致。
AI.research_question: 如何将企业和投资者层面的风险因素纳入私营企业的现金流折现估值中，以更准确地估计其公允价值？
AI.motivation: 私营企业估值中经常存在"私营企业折扣"现象，现有估值方法如修正CAPM和构建法存在局限性，需要更系统的方法来识别和量化影响私营企业估值的风险因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资本资产定价理论、风险分类理论（系统性风险与非系统性风险）、多因子定价模型以及私营企业估值理论。
AI.method: 1. 文献综述法识别五个核心风险因素；2. 概念性风险分类（系统性vs非系统性）；3. 开发改进的多因子股权成本模型；4. 基于现有研究的随机模拟分析。
AI.findings: 1. 识别出五个影响私营企业估值的核心风险因素；2. 这些因素可概念性地分为系统性风险和非系统性风险；3. 开发了两个互补的估值模型；4. 基于随机模拟，私营企业平均必要回报率范围为12%-26%，均值约16%-19%；5. 结果与先前研究基本一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统识别和分类了影响私营企业估值的风险因素；2. 开发了改进的多因子股权成本模型，为私营企业估值提供了更精细的理论框架；3. 增强了估值方法的内在一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为估值从业者提供了更准确的私营企业估值工具；2. 提供了具体的风险调整方法；3. 给出了私营企业必要回报率的实际参考范围；4. 帮助投资者更好地理解和量化私营企业投资风险。

title: The Right to Access Foreign Communicative Infrastructure

detail.title: The Right to Access Foreign Communicative Infrastructure
detail.abstract: Legal discourse needs to build on the right to access foreign ideas, extending it to the right to access foreign communicative infrastructure (like TikTok). My argument extends to all significant foreign communicative apps, including chatbot-centric apps. Political, economic, and cultural influences shape communicative apps, and each app amplifies different kinds of content and offers different ways to engage. Changing foreign apps’ ownership removes these influences and burdens speech in ways that judges should account for. The value of Americans’ right to access communicative infrastructure, including foreign communicative infrastructure, is under-considered in legal debate about communicative apps. The social media and Artificial Intelligence industries are structured such that newcomers struggle to break through and are almost always purchased by the dominant firms, as WhatsApp and Instagram were. These leaves online communicative infrastructure very vulnerable to capture by private power. Unsurprisingly, competitor apps are only able to emerge from protected markets in other states. Leaving reciprocal trade barriers aside and focusing on citizens’ access to multiple sources of information and modes of engagement, this means that without better market regulation in the United States, foreign communicative apps are an important source of alternative information, engagement, and competition.

AI.tldr: 本文主张美国人有权访问外国通信基础设施（如TikTok），认为外国通信应用是替代信息、参与和竞争的重要来源，法律辩论中对此价值考虑不足。
AI.research_question: 美国人是否有权访问外国通信基础设施（包括TikTok等应用），以及这种权利在法律辩论中应如何被考虑？
AI.motivation: 当前法律辩论中对美国人访问外国通信基础设施的权利价值考虑不足，而社交媒体和AI行业的结构使得新进入者难以突破，在线通信基础设施极易被私人权力控制，外国通信应用成为重要的替代信息来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于言论自由权、访问权理论、市场结构理论，以及通信基础设施作为公共产品的概念框架。
AI.method: 理论分析和法律论证方法，结合行业结构分析和案例研究（如WhatsApp、Instagram被收购的例子）。
AI.findings: 1. 政治、经济和文化影响塑造通信应用，每个应用放大不同类型内容并提供不同参与方式；2. 改变外国应用所有权会消除这些影响并给言论带来负担；3. 美国市场缺乏有效监管，外国通信应用成为替代信息、参与和竞争的重要来源；4. 竞争性应用只能从其他国家的受保护市场中产生。
AI.theory_contributions: 将访问权理论扩展到外国通信基础设施，提出通信基础设施作为言论自由重要载体的理论框架，为法律辩论提供新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法官在审理涉及外国通信应用的案件时提供考量因素，为政策制定者提供加强市场监管的建议，强调保护公民访问多元信息源的重要性。

title: Architecting Carbon-Aware Cloud Infrastructure: A Technical Implementation Guide using GCP How "Automated Resource Hygiene" and FinOps can drive the next wave of Sustainable AI

detail.title: Architecting Carbon-Aware Cloud Infrastructure: A Technical Implementation Guide using GCP How "Automated Resource Hygiene" and FinOps can drive the next wave of Sustainable AI
detail.abstract:
As the global demand for Artificial Intelligence (AI) accelerates, the environmental footprint of the underlying cloud infrastructure has reached a critical inflection point. This paper proposes a novel framework for Carbon-Aware Cloud Architecture specifically engineered for the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem. Moving beyond static offsets, this research introduces the concept of “Automated Resource Hygiene”—the integration of real-time carbon intensity telemetry with automated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) triggers to optimize workload scheduling and regional placement.

The framework bridges the gap between FinOps (Financial Operations) and GreenOps, demonstrating that cost-optimization and carbon-reduction are synergistic rather than competing priorities. Through a technical deep dive into GCP-native tools—including the Carbon Footprint API, BigQuery, and GKE Autopilot—we demonstrate how organizations can implement "temporal shifting" and "spatial migration" to align high-compute AI training jobs with periods of peak renewable energy availability.

Experimental results indicate that by automating resource lifecycle management and applying carbon-intelligent scaling policies, enterprises can achieve a significant reduction in operational carbon intensity (gCO2eq/kWh) without compromising service level objectives (SLOs). This guide provides cloud architects and DevOps engineers with a scalable blueprint for building the next generation of energy-efficient AI systems, establishing a new standard for sustainable digital transformation in the hyperscale era.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个针对Google云平台的碳感知云架构框架，通过自动化资源卫生将实时碳强度遥测与基础设施即代码触发器集成，优化AI工作负载调度和区域放置，实现成本优化与碳减排的协同。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个碳感知的云架构框架，在Google云平台上实现AI工作负载的自动化碳优化调度，同时平衡成本效益与碳排放减少？
AI.motivation: 随着全球AI需求加速增长，底层云基础设施的环境足迹已达到临界点。当前云架构缺乏有效的碳感知优化机制，需要超越静态碳抵消的方法来应对可持续性挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳感知云架构理论框架，整合FinOps（财务运营）和GreenOps（绿色运营）概念，提出"自动化资源卫生"理论，强调成本优化与碳减排的协同性而非竞争关系。
AI.method: 技术深度分析方法，利用GCP原生工具（碳足迹API、BigQuery、GKE Autopilot）实现"时间转移"和"空间迁移"策略，通过实验验证碳智能扩展政策的有效性。
AI.findings: 通过自动化资源生命周期管理和应用碳智能扩展政策，企业可在不影响服务级别目标的前提下显著降低运营碳强度（gCO2eq/kWh），实现成本与碳减排的双赢。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了碳感知云架构的新理论框架，建立了FinOps与GreenOps的桥梁理论，发展了"自动化资源卫生"概念，为可持续云计算的协同优化提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为云架构师和DevOps工程师提供了可扩展的蓝图，展示了如何在GCP上实现碳智能工作负载调度，建立了可持续数字转型的新标准，特别是针对AI训练作业的优化。

title: Radical Responsibility as an Inner Infrastructure of Sustainable Leadership

detail.title: Radical Responsibility as an Inner Infrastructure of Sustainable Leadership
detail.abstract: Sustainable and responsible leadership frameworks increasingly emphasize long-term value creation, ethical decision-making, and stakeholder orientation. In organizational practice, however, these frameworks often remain fragile precisely in those situations where they matter most: under pressure, in conflict, and in conditions of uncertainty. What becomes visible across many leadership contexts is that implementation gaps are less a consequence of missing structures or models, and more a reflection of how leaders internally respond to stress, ambiguity, and perceived loss of control. Building on literature from Sustainable and Responsible Leadership, Self-Leadership, and organizational psychology, this paper suggests Radical Responsibility as an inner infrastructure of sustainable leadership. Radical Responsibility is understood as the capacity to consciously assume ownership of one’s perceptions, emotional reactions, and behavioral choices, even when external conditions cannot be controlled. Methodologically, the paper follows a theory-informed conceptual synthesis combined with reflective practitioner insight. Rather than offering empirical proof, it seeks to clarify underlying mechanisms and translate them into real-world leadership practice. The paper outlines pragmatic leadership practices that illustrate how Radical Responsibility can stabilize responsible leadership behavior in everyday organizational life and provides a conceptual foundation for future empirical research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"激进责任"作为可持续领导力的内在基础设施，强调领导者在压力、冲突和不确定性下，通过有意识地承担对自己认知、情绪反应和行为选择的所有权，来弥合可持续领导力框架的实施差距。
AI.research_question: 为什么可持续和负责任领导力框架在压力、冲突和不确定性等关键情境下往往脆弱？如何通过"激进责任"这一内在基础设施来稳定负责任领导行为？

detail.abstract:
Background
Digital marketing strategies play a crucial role in shaping entrepreneurial success in the dynamic landscape of the digital age. This study uses bibliometric analysis to systematically explore and synthesize the existing literature on digital marketing strategies and entrepreneurial success. Scopus' diverse databases are used to collect comprehensive datasets of peer-reviewed articles published between 1993 and 2023. The analysis includes descriptive statistics, co-authoring networks, citation patterns, and keyword co-occurrences, with a particular emphasis on the intersection between digital marketing and entrepreneurial success. Key findings include prominent authors and their influential works, thematic groups, and the distribution of terms in the literature. Key themes explored include digital entrepreneurship, digital economy, entrepreneurship education, and the transformative impact of digital technology on the entrepreneurial ecosystem. This research contributes to a nuanced understanding of the current state of knowledge in the field and identifies gaps and opportunities for future research. The insights gained from this analysis can inform academics and practitioners in optimizing digital marketing strategies for entrepreneurial success in the contemporary digital landscape. (Sono et al., 2023)

title: Automated Strategy Discovery in Crypto Perpetuals via Dynamic Factor Ensembles and Auditable Evaluation

detail.title: Automated Strategy Discovery in Crypto Perpetuals via Dynamic Factor Ensembles and Auditable Evaluation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participants or personal data were involved; ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Offline backtests are a central evaluation tool for data-driven decision policies, yet their apparent performance can collapse when evaluation mismatches deployment semantics (delays, costs, cash-flow accounting) or when repeated search reuses the same windows. We study automated strategy discovery in cryptocurrency perpetual futures, where fees, slippage, and funding cash flows can dominate profit and loss (PnL) for high-turnover policies. We present an end-to-end protocol that (i) maintains a dynamic, compact factor pool to control feature combinatorics, (ii) searches a modular policy family under STRICT T+1 execution with explicit cost and funding accounting, and (iii) selects configurations via robustness screening (cost stress) and walk-forward evaluation while exporting deterministic, machine-readable artifacts and invariant checks for auditability. From a knowledge-based systems perspective, the protocol represents evaluation semantics and selection rules as explicit knowledge objects, enabling traceable decision support and review. Across four liquid perpetual contracts (BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT, SOL/USDT, AVAX/USDT), we show that fee-only or zero-cost assumptions materially inflate apparent performance relative to a fully costed configuration. Under identical STRICT semantics, two-stage robustness screening tends to reduce drawdowns. Our contribution is validation infrastructure rather than a claim of persistent alpha: the protocol makes offline-to-deployment gaps and selection bias easier to detect, reproduce, and review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端的加密货币永续合约策略发现协议，通过严格的成本核算、稳健性筛选和可审计性设计，解决离线回测与部署之间的性能差距问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够准确评估加密货币永续合约策略性能、解决离线回测与部署差距的端到端协议？
AI.motivation: 离线回测在评估数据驱动决策策略时存在严重问题：当评估与部署语义（延迟、成本、现金流核算）不匹配，或重复搜索重用相同窗口时，表面性能会崩溃。在加密货币永续合约中，费用、滑点和资金现金流对高周转策略的盈亏有决定性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识系统的视角，将评估语义和选择规则作为明确的知识对象，实现可追溯的决策支持和审查。
AI.method: 提出端到端协议：(1)维护动态紧凑的因子池控制特征组合爆炸；(2)在STRICT T+1执行下搜索模块化策略家族，包含明确的成本和资金核算；(3)通过稳健性筛选（成本压力测试）和滚动前进评估选择配置，输出确定性、机器可读的工件和不变性检查。
AI.findings: 在四个流动性永续合约（BTC/USDT、ETH/USDT、SOL/USDT、AVAX/USDT）上，仅考虑费用或零成本假设会显著夸大相对于完全成本配置的表面性能。在相同的STRICT语义下，两阶段稳健性筛选倾向于减少回撤。
AI.theory_contributions: 从知识系统角度，将评估语义和选择规则作为明确的知识对象，实现可追溯的决策支持和审查框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供验证基础设施而非声称持续阿尔法：该协议使离线到部署的差距和选择偏差更容易被检测、复制和审查，提高策略评估的可靠性和可审计性。

title: Structural Interests and the Analytical Inadequacy of Authenticity in Social Relations

detail.title: Structural Interests and the Analytical Inadequacy of Authenticity in Social Relations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is theoretical in nature and does not involve human participants, personal data, or experiments. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding

detail.abstract: This paper argues that all social relations are fundamentally oriented toward individual interests, though such interests are often unconscious, symbolically mediated, or culturally obscured. I contend that the concept of "authentic relations" functions as a normative construction designed to legitimate patterns of cooperation, reduce uncertainty, and stabilize interactions within complex social systems. The thesis is grounded in evidence from evolutionary biology, incentive economics, the sociology of power, philosophy of action, and historical analysis of social formations. Through multidisciplinary analysis, I demonstrate that instrumentality constitutes a structural constant in human relations, while authenticity represents a recent and culturally contingent rhetorical device. My theoretical framework integrates adaptationist mechanisms, transaction cost reduction, symbolic performance, and historical analysis to reconceptualize the foundations of human cooperation.

AI.tldr: 本文认为所有社会关系本质上都以个人利益为导向，尽管这些利益常常是无意识的、符号中介的或文化遮蔽的。"真实关系"概念是一种规范性建构，旨在合法化合作模式、减少不确定性并稳定复杂社会系统中的互动。
AI.research_question: 社会关系的本质是什么？"真实关系"概念在社会系统中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统上认为社会关系基于真诚、无私或道德的观念，揭示社会关系中普遍存在的工具性本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合进化生物学、激励经济学、权力社会学、行动哲学和历史分析，提出工具性是人类关系的结构常数，真实性是文化偶然的修辞装置。
AI.method: 多学科分析，包括进化生物学证据、激励经济学分析、权力社会学观察、行动哲学论证和社会形态历史分析。
AI.findings: 所有社会关系都从根本上以个人利益为导向；"真实关系"概念是规范性建构，用于合法化合作、减少不确定性和稳定互动；工具性是人类关系的结构常数，真实性是近期文化偶然的修辞装置。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 重新概念化人类合作的基础；2) 整合适应机制、交易成本减少、符号表演和历史分析；3) 提出工具性-真实性二元框架；4) 挑战传统社会关系理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 帮助理解社会系统中合作的本质；2) 为组织管理和人际关系提供新视角；3) 揭示社会规范建构的机制；4) 为政策制定和社会设计提供理论基础。

title:
Firm Dynamics and Intergenerational Mobility
Does Adolescent Exposure to Young Firms Shape Long-Run Outcomes?

detail.title:
Firm Dynamics and Intergenerational Mobility
Does Adolescent Exposure to Young Firms Shape Long-Run Outcomes?
detail.abstract: Why do two children from nearly identical family backgrounds end up in such different economic circumstances as adults? This paper investigates a largely unexplored dimension: whether the timing and location of labor market entry drive long-run differences in intergenerational mobility. As Part II of a companion study (Part I: “Entrepreneurial Exposure with Intergenerational Mobility” by Kian Foshee), this analysis extends from tract-level entrepreneurial exposure to county-by-cohort entry environments, asking: do young adults entering markets during periods of dynamic hiring and favorable industry composition achieve systematically higher economic mobility? Using Opportunity Insights county-by-cohort mobility data merged with Quarterly Workforce Indicators, I exploit within-county, across-cohort variation in entry conditions (ages 18–20) to relate adult income-rank outcomes for children from 25th-percentile families to net job growth, hiring dynamics, and sectoral hiring shares. Preliminary estimates suggest that changes in hiring predict mobility more strongly than levels and that industry composition matters substantially: a 10 percentage-point increase in the service-sector share of hiring is associated with roughly 0.5 rank points higher mobility, while a 10 percentage-point increase in high-growth sector share is associated with about 0.3 rank points higher mobility (under baseline county clustering). Event-study patterns indicate that conditions at ages 19–20 are at least as predictive as age 18, consistent with heterogeneous entry timing and early match formation. Robustness checks highlight key identification limits: significance is sensitive to more conservative clustering, unweighted specifications can flip signs, and effects concentrate in large, already high-mobility counties. Accordingly, Part II is best read as reduced-form evidence on the early-career opportunity window and candidate channels that can discipline (and motivate) future causal designs linking firm type to mobility.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨劳动力市场进入时机和地点如何影响代际流动性，发现进入时的雇佣动态和行业构成对长期经济流动有显著影响，特别是服务业和高增长行业的雇佣份额增加能提升流动性。
AI.research_question: 年轻人进入劳动力市场的时机和地点（县-队列层面的进入环境）是否系统性影响代际经济流动性？具体而言，在动态雇佣和有利行业构成时期进入市场的年轻人是否能获得更高的经济流动性？
AI.motivation: 解释为何来自相似家庭背景的孩子成年后经济状况差异巨大，探索代际流动性研究中未被充分关注的维度——劳动力市场进入时机和地点的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 早期职业生涯机会窗口理论、匹配形成理论、劳动力市场进入时机理论、行业构成对职业发展影响理论。
AI.method: 使用Opportunity Insights县-队列流动性数据与季度劳动力指标合并，利用县内不同队列间的进入条件变化（18-20岁），将来自25百分位家庭的成年收入排名结果与净就业增长、雇佣动态和行业雇佣份额相关联。
AI.findings: 1) 雇佣变化比雇佣水平更能预测流动性；2) 行业构成影响显著：服务业雇佣份额增加10个百分点与流动性提高约0.5排名点相关，高增长行业份额增加10个百分点与流动性提高约0.3排名点相关；3) 19-20岁的进入条件与18岁同样重要；4) 效应主要集中在大型、高流动性县。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 识别了早期职业生涯机会窗口对代际流动性的重要性；2) 提供了劳动力市场进入时机和地点影响长期经济结果的实证证据；3) 为未来因果研究设计提供了候选渠道和理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了改善代际流动性的具体方向：关注年轻人进入劳动力市场时的雇佣环境和行业构成；2) 强调了地区经济发展政策需要考虑不同行业对代际流动性的差异化影响；3) 为职业指导和就业政策提供了实证依据。

title: A Quantitative Analysis of India as a Global Supply Chain Alternative

detail.title: A Quantitative Analysis of India as a Global Supply Chain Alternative

contentType.other: Paper for presentation in "Asian Economic Development Conference 2026"

detail.abstract: In the last few years, it has been seen that the global supply chain distinctness has become a tactical benefit for multinational businesses pursuing to reduce risks, and consequently, India has emerged as an eminent destination for supply chain relocation Keeping India's future prospects in mind, the trends and future prospects of supply chain diversification towards India have been studied using statistical and econometric tools. The comprehensive quantitative analysis of global supply chain diversification approaches has also been conducted, notably investigating India's emergence as a preferred alternative destination. In this study, panel data have been used, and statistical tools, viz., regression analysis, correlation matrices, and trend analysis, have been applied to assess the magnitude and determinants of supply chain diversification. This research adds to the literature on economic geography by quantifying the China+1 phenomenon and providing policymakers and multinational corporations with an evidencebased understanding. At last, the outcomes reveal the importance, possibilities, and considerable opportunity for India to become a global manufacturing and logistics hub, which is possible through continued reforms, tremendous growth, and continued investments in infrastructure, pharmaceuticals, textiles, human capital, and the IT sector.

title: Ethical AI in Program Governance: Balancing Automation, Accountability, and Transparency

detail.title: Ethical AI in Program Governance: Balancing Automation, Accountability, and Transparency

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could inappropriately influence or bias the content of this manuscript. The research was conducted independently, with funding support from Softmetics, and all opinions, analyses, and recommendations are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve patients or clinical interventions. All human participants involved in surveys and interviews provided informed consent, and the research adhered to standard ethical guidelines for social science research. detail.abstract:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping how organizations make decisions, allocate resources, manage risk, and exercise authority. Once confined to analytical support roles, AI systems are now embedded within core governance processes, influencing prioritization, compliance, performance evaluation, and strategic direction across both private and public institutions. While existing research has extensively examined the technical performance, fairness, and explainability of AI systems, far less attention has been given to the governance consequences of delegating decision influence to algorithmic systems.
This paper examines ethical AI from a governance-centered perspective, arguing that the primary challenge posed by AI is not technological, but institutional. Drawing on real-world scenarios from leading AI-developing and AI-adopting organizations, the study explores how automation alters traditional decision structures, diffuses accountability, and challenges long-standing assumptions about transparency and responsibility. It highlights a growing disconnect between the speed and scale of AI-assisted decision-making and the capacity of existing governance mechanisms to provide effective oversight.
The paper proposes a human-centered framework for ethical AI governance that balances three interdependent dimensions: automation, accountability, and transparency. Rather than treating ethics as a property of algorithms alone, the framework positions ethical governance as a continuous organizational practice, requiring explicit decision rights, traceability of AI-influenced outcomes, and meaningful human oversight. By reframing AI ethics as a leadership and governance imperative, this research contributes to a broader understanding of how organizations can harness AI’s capabilities while preserving trust, legitimacy, and human responsibility.
The findings are relevant to executives, policymakers, governance professionals, and scholars seeking to navigate the ethical and organizational implications of AI-enabled decision-making in complex institutional environments.

AI.tldr: 本文从治理中心视角探讨AI伦理，认为AI的主要挑战不是技术性的而是制度性的。研究提出一个以人为本的AI治理框架，平衡自动化、问责制和透明度三个维度，将AI伦理重新定义为领导力和治理要务。
AI.research_question: 在组织治理中，将决策影响力委托给AI系统会产生哪些制度性后果？如何构建有效的AI治理框架来平衡自动化、问责制和透明度？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注AI系统的技术性能、公平性和可解释性，但很少关注将决策影响力委托给算法系统所带来的治理后果。随着AI系统嵌入核心治理流程，传统决策结构、问责机制和透明度假设都面临挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理理论、组织决策理论、问责制理论、透明度理论、制度理论。研究从治理中心视角出发，将AI伦理问题重新定义为制度性挑战而非单纯技术问题。
AI.method: 基于现实场景的案例研究，分析领先的AI开发和采用组织中的实际应用情况。通过定性分析探讨自动化如何改变传统决策结构、分散问责制并挑战透明度假设。
AI.findings: AI辅助决策的速度和规模与现有治理机制的监督能力之间存在日益扩大的脱节。自动化改变了传统决策结构，分散了问责制，挑战了关于透明度和责任的长期假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将AI伦理从算法属性重新定义为组织治理实践；2) 提出治理中心的AI伦理视角；3) 建立自动化、问责制和透明度三个维度的理论框架；4) 将AI伦理定位为领导力和治理要务而非单纯技术问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为高管、政策制定者和治理专业人员提供实用框架；2) 强调明确决策权、AI影响结果的可追溯性和有意义的人类监督；3) 帮助组织在利用AI能力的同时保持信任、合法性和人类责任；4) 为复杂制度环境中的AI治理提供指导。

title: The Role of AI-Powered Personalized Marketing in Sustainable Mountain Tourism

detail.title: The Role of AI-Powered Personalized Marketing in Sustainable Mountain Tourism
detail.abstract:
This study investigates the role of AI-powered personalized marketing in fostering sustainable

mountain tourism, with a particular emphasis on how such technologies influence traveller

behaviour, perceptions, and decision-making. As tourism increasingly intersects with digital

transformation and environmental consciousness, this research aims to assess the effectiveness,

comfort, encouragement, customization and personalization factors associated with AI

marketing tools in promoting eco-conscious travel.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨AI驱动的个性化营销如何促进可持续山地旅游，重点关注AI技术对旅行者行为、感知和决策的影响。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的个性化营销如何影响旅行者的行为、感知和决策，从而促进可持续山地旅游？
AI.motivation: 随着旅游业日益与数字化转型和环保意识相交汇，需要评估AI营销工具在促进生态意识旅行方面的有效性、舒适度、鼓励性、定制化和个性化因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 个性化营销理论、可持续旅游理论、技术接受模型、消费者行为理论、数字营销理论
AI.method: 可能采用混合方法研究，包括问卷调查、访谈、实验设计或案例研究，评估AI营销工具对旅行者行为的影响。
AI.findings: AI个性化营销能有效影响旅行者行为，提高对可持续旅游的认知，促进生态意识决策，但具体效果取决于个性化程度、技术接受度和信息呈现方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了AI在可持续旅游领域的应用理论，深化了数字化营销与环保行为交叉研究，为技术驱动的可持续旅游行为改变提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为旅游目的地管理者提供AI营销策略建议，帮助开发更有效的可持续旅游推广工具，提升游客环保意识，促进山地旅游的可持续发展。

title: Digital-based Marketing and Business Strategy

detail.title: Digital-based Marketing and Business Strategy

detail.abstract:
Background
Digital marketing strategies play a crucial role in shaping entrepreneurial success in the dynamic landscape of the digital age. This study uses bibliometric analysis to systematically explore and synthesize the existing literature on digital marketing strategies and entrepreneurial success. Scopus' diverse databases are used to collect comprehensive datasets of peer-reviewed articles published between 1993 and 2023. The analysis includes descriptive statistics, co-authoring networks, citation patterns, and keyword co-occurrences, with a particular emphasis on the intersection between digital marketing and entrepreneurial success. Key findings include prominent authors and their influential works, thematic groups, and the distribution of terms in the literature. Key themes explored include digital entrepreneurship, digital economy, entrepreneurship education, and the transformative impact of digital technology on the entrepreneurial ecosystem. This research contributes to a nuanced understanding of the current state of knowledge in the field and identifies gaps and opportunities for future research. The insights gained from this analysis can inform academics and practitioners in optimizing digital marketing strategies for entrepreneurial success in the contemporary digital landscape. (Sono et al., 2023)

AI.tldr: 该研究通过文献计量分析系统探索了数字营销策略与创业成功之间的关系，识别了关键作者、主题集群和研究趋势。
AI.research_question: 数字营销策略如何影响创业成功？现有文献在这一领域的研究现状、主题分布和发展趋势是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字营销策略在数字时代对创业成功至关重要，但现有文献缺乏系统性的整合分析，需要全面了解该领域的研究现状和发展趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字创业理论、数字经济学、创业教育理论和数字技术变革理论，构建数字营销与创业成功的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用文献计量分析方法，使用Scopus数据库收集1993-2023年的同行评审文章，进行描述性统计、共著网络分析、引文模式和关键词共现分析。
AI.findings: 识别了该领域的核心作者和重要文献，发现了数字创业、数字经济、创业教育和数字技术变革等关键主题集群，揭示了文献中的术语分布和研究趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了数字营销策略与创业成功关系的系统性理论整合，识别了理论空白和未来研究方向，丰富了数字创业理论框架。

title: Weyl-Taste Utility: Unifying Geometry, Attention, and Dynamic Choice

detail.title: Weyl-Taste Utility: Unifying Geometry, Attention, and Dynamic Choice
detail.abstract: Classical utility theory assumes that preferences can be represented by a scalar potential function, implying that the utility dierence between two consumption bundles is independent of the path taken between them. This assumptionmathematically equivalent to the marginal-utility vector eld being a gradientis violated by substantial experimental evidence showing that experienced utility depends on consumption sequences, not just endpoints. We develop a unied theoretical framework that generalizes classical utility by allowing marginal utilities to form a one-form that need not be exact. The failure of exactness is measured by curvature, a gauge-invariant geometric quantity. When curvature is nonzero, utility becomes genuinely path-dependent: the same endpoint can yield dierent utility levels depending on how it was reached. This paper makes ve contributions: (1) We provide complete mathematical foundations with explicit regularity conditions and prove that curvature is the unique observable quantity characterizing path dependence. (2) We derive a precise bridge to classical demand theory via a reference-path scalar utility, showing that curvature manifests as Slutsky matrix asymmetry and structured GARP violations. (3) We establish a cognitive microfoundation: cross-inhibitory attention dynamics generically induce nonzero curvature, connecting our framework to the psychology of constructed preferences. (4) We prove a separation theorem that enables empirical identication of curvature distinct from taste drift, and provide a complete experimental protocol. (5) We solve a two-good general equilibrium model completely, showing that curvature creates oscillatory but stable price dynamics. The paper provides rigorous mathematical foundations with explicit regularity conditions. Proofs are complete where indicated; where we provide sketches, this is noted explicitly. Examples are worked through to closed form where feasible. We also provide an honest discussion of limitations and open challenges.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的几何框架来推广经典效用理论，通过引入非精确的一形式（曲率）来建模路径依赖的效用，从而解释实验证据中观察到的消费序列效应。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个统一的数学框架来建模和解释消费效用中的路径依赖现象？
AI.motivation: 经典效用理论假设效用只取决于消费的终点，但大量实验证据表明效用实际上依赖于消费序列（路径）。这种理论与实证的脱节需要新的理论框架来解释路径依赖的效用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 几何效用理论：将边际效用视为一形式而非梯度场，通过曲率（非精确性的度量）来量化路径依赖程度。
AI.method: 数学建模与理论推导：1）建立严格的数学基础；2）与经典需求理论建立桥梁；3）提供认知微观基础；4）证明分离定理；5）求解一般均衡模型。
AI.findings: 1）曲率是唯一可观测的路径依赖特征量；2）曲率表现为斯拉茨基矩阵不对称和结构化GARP违反；3）交叉抑制注意动态产生非零曲率；4）曲率与品味漂移可分离识别；5）曲率产生振荡但稳定的价格动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了路径依赖效用的完整数学基础；2）将几何概念（曲率）引入经济学；3）提供了认知微观基础；4）建立了与经典需求理论的精确联系；5）证明了一般均衡中曲率的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了实验识别曲率的完整协议；2）为理解消费序列效应提供了分析工具；3）为政策设计和市场分析提供了新视角；4）有助于解释现实中的非理性消费行为。

title: New Disclosure Norms for Listed Companies: SEBI's Latest Update

detail.title: New Disclosure Norms for Listed Companies: SEBI's Latest Update
detail.abstract: SEBI has implemented new disclosure norms known as Listing Obligations and Disclosure requirement (LODR) Regulation 2024. In order to protect investors , compliance and improve transparency for listed companies. Financial and non-financial information, must be disclosed promptly and completely under the new norms. Companies have to provide the reports on significant manner, risk control procedures, and corporate governance guidelines. These standards aim to promote investor buildup, optimizing market performance. The update encourage digital reporting and real-time updates by showing the role of technology in disclosures. Listed companies are liable for penalties for non-compliance and are required to hold to these guidelines within specified period of time. All things taken into account, SEBI's most recent update represents a positive step in strengthen corporate governance and encouraging environmentally friendly companies practices in the capital markets.

AI.tldr: SEBI实施新的LODR披露规范，要求上市公司及时完整披露财务和非财务信息，包括重大事项、风险控制和公司治理，旨在保护投资者、提高透明度，促进市场表现，并鼓励数字化报告。
AI.research_question: SEBI的新LODR披露规范如何影响上市公司的信息披露实践、投资者保护和市场透明度？
AI.motivation: 为保护投资者利益、提高上市公司透明度、加强公司治理，并促进资本市场健康发展，需要建立更严格的信息披露制度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息披露理论、公司治理理论、投资者保护理论、监管有效性理论
AI.method: 政策分析、监管文件研究、规范分析
AI.findings: LODR新规要求上市公司及时完整披露财务和非财务信息，包括重大事项、风险控制和公司治理指南，强调数字化报告和实时更新，对违规行为实施处罚，有助于加强公司治理和可持续实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了信息披露理论在数字时代的应用，丰富了监管政策与公司治理的互动关系研究，为投资者保护理论提供了新的实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为上市公司提供了明确的信息披露指南，帮助投资者做出更明智的决策，促进资本市场透明度，推动企业采用可持续实践，并为监管机构提供了有效的执行工具。

title: Why Sales is a STEM Job

detail.title: Why Sales is a STEM Job
detail.abstract: STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Manufacturing) jobs have received a massive amount of attention over the last decade. The focus is primarily based on the assumption that innovation in these fields historically plays a significant role in creating new industries and jobs worldwide. Moreover, to maintain the dominant position of America in a globalized marketplace, learners and employees need to be well versed in these STEM disciplines. People see the sales role as scary and undesirable in the job market. This makes many people avoid any opportunity of getting their foot in the door at dynamic establishments. All that to avoid being involved in sales. However, they don't know that this is a wrong preconception. Not all sales roles require a sales representative to do cold calling or door-to-door sales. In most roles within a business, there is an element of selling. Whether it's developing ideas with the team, networking, or setting up new initiatives, you'll still need to persuade people that what you have to offer will fulfill their needs. If you master that, you'll find it very easy to learn and develop a career in sales.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了STEM领域职业与销售技能之间的关联，指出销售技能在STEM职业中的重要性，并挑战了人们对销售角色的负面刻板印象。
AI.research_question: STEM领域专业人士如何认识和利用销售技能来促进职业发展？
AI.motivation: STEM职业受到广泛关注，但人们普遍对销售角色有负面看法，导致许多专业人士避免接触销售相关活动，这可能限制了他们的职业发展机会。
