AI.method: 文献综述和概念分析，可能包括对STEM专业人士的访谈或调查
AI.findings: 1. 销售技能在大多数商业角色中都是必要的；2. 人们对销售存在误解，认为仅限于冷电话或上门推销；3. 说服和影响他人的能力是STEM专业人士成功的关键技能；4. 掌握销售技能有助于STEM职业发展
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了STEM职业发展理论，纳入销售技能维度；2. 挑战了传统销售角色的刻板印象；3. 提出了STEM专业人士技能组合的新框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助STEM专业人士认识到销售技能的重要性；2. 提供职业发展建议，鼓励学习销售技能；3. 为教育机构提供课程设计参考，将销售技能融入STEM教育

title: Uncovering Hidden Drivers of Social Mobility using Multi-Modal AI on Behavioral and Socioeconomic Data

detail.title: Uncovering Hidden Drivers of Social Mobility using Multi-Modal AI on Behavioral and Socioeconomic Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve direct interaction with human participants or the use of identifiable private information. The analysis was conducted using secondary, anonymized, or publicly available data sources, and therefore formal ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive any specific grant or financial support from public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agencies.

publicationDetails.detailsText: This is an original working paper and has not yet appeared in any journal, book, or formal paper series.

detail.abstract: The classical models of social mobility have mainly focused on such factors as income, education, and parental background as the main driving force. Nonetheless, these models frequently fail to recognize interrelationships and complexity of different behavioral, social, and socioeconomic elements. We suggest a novel method of application in this research that involves the use of multimodal AI, which is a combination of behavioral, social, and socioeconomic data to provide a better insight into social mobility. Transformers are used to model sequential nature of life events whereas Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are used to model relational dynamics of networks. One of the contributions that this work makes is the possibility to reveal the hidden factors that drive mobility that cannot be identified by the traditional models. Moreover, the information presented by the model can be interpreted by a human being and he/she can gain a clearer idea of the determinants of social mobility. These results have important implications, as the insights obtained are practical and can be used by policy makers, as well as, in future research in the social mobility field.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多模态AI的社会流动性分析新方法，结合行为、社交和社会经济数据，使用Transformer和GNN模型揭示传统模型无法识别的隐藏驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 如何利用多模态AI技术（结合行为、社交和社会经济数据）更好地理解和预测社会流动性？
AI.motivation: 传统社会流动性模型主要关注收入、教育和家庭背景等单一因素，忽视了不同行为、社交和社会经济要素之间的相互关系和复杂性，导致分析不够全面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合多模态AI理论、序列建模理论（Transformer）和网络关系动态理论（图神经网络GNN），构建综合性的社会流动性分析框架。
AI.method: 使用多模态AI方法，整合行为、社交和社会经济数据；采用Transformer建模生活事件的序列性，使用GNN建模网络关系动态。
AI.findings: 该方法能够揭示传统模型无法识别的社会流动性隐藏驱动因素，并提供可解释的洞察，帮助理解社会流动性的决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合多模态AI的社会流动性分析新理论框架，扩展了传统社会流动性理论的边界，为理解复杂的社会流动机制提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实用的社会流动性洞察，支持更有效的政策设计；为未来社会流动性研究提供了新的方法论工具。

title:
Re-Engineering Inland Transport Risk: 
A System-Powered Inspection Stack for Tail-Risk Detection in Indian Over-Dimensional Cargo Movement
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Re-Engineering Inland Transport Risk: 
A System-Powered Inspection Stack for Tail-Risk Detection in Indian Over-Dimensional Cargo Movement
detail.abstract:
Inland transport risk across Indian road networks is predominantly assessed through post-loss claims data, insurer loss runs, and retrospective survey reports. While these approaches provide historical visibility, they fail to capture structural risk formation during cargo movement—particularly for Over-Dimensional Cargo (ODC) and Over-Weight Cargo (OWC), where losses emerge from system interactions across routes, carriers, loading practices, and operational governance rather than isolated events.

This white paper introduces a System-Powered Transport Risk Inspection Stack, grounded in inspection-first data rather than claims-first data. Using anonymised inspection outputs from 2025 ODC/OWC movements across Indian inland roads, the study demonstrates how structured inspection protocols, operational SOPs, and network-level analytics enable earlier detection of tail risk, exposure concentration, and delay amplification—well before losses crystallise.

A multi-layered analytical framework separates shipment frequency, monetary exposure, and tail delay behaviour (P90 delays) across carriers, routes, and consignees. Concentration risk is quantified using shipment- and exposure-based Herfindahl–Hirschman Index (HHI) measures, while interaction effects are visualised through carrier–route heatmaps and exposure–delay risk maps. All entity identifiers—including consignors, consignees, carriers, and GSTINs—are deterministically anonymised to preserve analytical integrity without compromising commercial confidentiality.

Findings show that ODC/OWC risk is rarely proportional to shipment volume alone. Instead, loss potential clusters around specific combinations of operational behaviour, route constraints, and governance gaps—patterns largely invisible in conventional claims datasets. By integrating live industrial SOPs, the paper demonstrates how inspection-driven controls materially reduce tail risk when embedded upstream, repositioning inspections as foundational infrastructure for preventive transport risk governance rather than reactive loss documentation.

AI.tldr: 该白皮书提出了一种基于检查优先数据的系统化运输风险检测框架，用于识别印度内陆公路超大/超重货物运输中的结构性风险形成，而非依赖传统的索赔后数据分析。
AI.research_question: 如何通过检查优先的数据方法（而非索赔优先方法）来识别和量化印度内陆公路超大/超重货物运输中的结构性风险形成？
AI.motivation: 传统风险评估方法（如索赔数据、保险损失记录、回顾性调查报告）只能提供历史可见性，但无法捕捉货物运输过程中的结构性风险形成，特别是对于超大/超重货物，其损失源于路线、承运商、装载实践和运营治理的系统性交互。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统风险理论、结构性风险形成理论、检查优先数据方法、网络级分析框架、集中度风险量化（赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数）、尾部风险检测。
AI.method: 基于2025次超大/超重货物运输的匿名检查输出数据，采用多层分析框架分离运输频率、货币敞口和尾部延迟行为（P90延迟），使用基于运输量和敞口的赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数量化集中度风险，通过承运商-路线热图和敞口-延迟风险图可视化交互效应。
AI.findings: 超大/超重货物风险很少与运输量成正比，损失潜力集中在特定的运营行为、路线约束和治理缺口的组合周围，这些模式在传统索赔数据集中基本不可见。检查驱动的控制措施在嵌入上游时能显著减少尾部风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"系统驱动的运输风险检查堆栈"理论框架，将检查重新定位为预防性运输风险治理的基础设施而非反应性损失记录，建立了检查优先数据方法在风险识别中的理论优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为运输风险管理提供了实用的分析工具（HHI指标、热图可视化），展示了如何将工业标准操作程序与检查协议整合以早期检测尾部风险、敞口集中和延迟放大，为预防性风险治理提供了可操作的方法。

title: Transformative Impact of Health Literacy and Healthy Living on Pregnant Girls and Women in Urban Slums

detail.title: Transformative Impact of Health Literacy and Healthy Living on Pregnant Girls and Women in Urban Slums

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that this manuscript have no personal or financial relationship with any organization.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was solely carried out by the author and no funds was received by individuals or organizations whatsoever.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Stanford University Graduate School of Business Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Stanford Graduate School of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Girls and women living in urban slums face far greater challenges than their counterparts in more stable environments. Limited access to quality education, poor parental support, neglect, and restrictive cultural norms expose them to heightened risks of exploitation, including involvement in sex-work and early unintended pregnancies; conditions that perpetuate cycles of vulnerability and poverty. As a result, pregnant girls and women in this marginalized environment encounter multiple health, social, and economic difficulties that severely compromise maternal and child health outcomes. High rates of maternal and infant morbidity and mortality in these areas are driven by poor access to quality healthcare, inadequate prenatal services, poor nutrition, and low levels of health literacy. This paper examines the pivotal role of health literacy and healthy living as transformative tools for empowering vulnerable pregnant girls and women in urban slums. It contends that enhancing knowledge, attitudes, and behaviors around reproductive health, personal hygiene, nutrition, and healthcare access can serve as a sustainable strategy for breaking cycles of poor health and social inequality. The study also emphasizes the importance of culturally-sensitive, community-based interventions that equip marginalized women and girls with the information, skills, and resources needed to make informed decisions about their health and well-being. Finally, the study recommends for integrated, inclusive approaches that prioritize education, healthcare access, and sustained community support as essential pathways to achieving equity in maternal health and promoting healthier, more resilient slum communities.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨健康素养和健康生活在赋能城市贫民窟弱势孕妇方面的关键作用，认为提升生殖健康、个人卫生、营养和医疗获取的知识、态度和行为是打破健康不平等循环的可持续策略。
AI.research_question: 健康素养和健康生活如何作为变革性工具，赋能城市贫民窟中的弱势孕妇，改善母婴健康结局？
AI.motivation: 城市贫民窟中的女孩和妇女面临比稳定环境中的同龄人更大的挑战，包括教育机会有限、父母支持不足、忽视和限制性文化规范，导致她们面临剥削风险增加，如涉足性工作和意外早孕，这些条件加剧了脆弱性和贫困循环。孕妇在这一边缘化环境中遭遇多重健康、社会和经济困难，严重损害母婴健康结局。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康素养理论、赋权理论、社会决定因素理论、社区参与理论、文化敏感性干预理论
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明具体研究方法，但强调采用文化敏感性、社区为基础的干预方法，以及整合性、包容性方法
AI.findings: 提升生殖健康、个人卫生、营养和医疗获取的知识、态度和行为可以作为打破不良健康和社会不平等循环的可持续策略。文化敏感性、社区为基础的干预对于为边缘化妇女和女孩提供做出健康决策所需的信息、技能和资源至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将健康素养概念化为赋能城市贫民窟弱势孕妇的变革性工具；2. 强调健康素养与健康生活实践在打破脆弱性循环中的相互作用；3. 提出文化敏感性社区干预在促进健康公平中的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 推荐整合性、包容性方法，优先考虑教育、医疗获取和持续社区支持；2. 提供改善城市贫民窟母婴健康结局的具体干预策略；3. 为政策制定者提供实现孕产妇健康公平和建设更具韧性贫民窟社区的实施路径

title: Thought Experiment Using Relationship-Driven Theory: Resolving Structural Issues through Framework Application in Specific Regions

detail.title: Thought Experiment Using Relationship-Driven Theory: Resolving Structural Issues through Framework Application in Specific Regions
detail.abstract: This paper conducts a thought experiment to analyze and describe structural issues in specific regions using the framework of Relationship-Driven Theory (Patent No. 7059476 / SSRN Abstract ID 6040194). By adopting an engineering perspective, we define regional social stagnation as "Dysfunctional Guardrails" within a social OS. When the global economy is positioned as an external "Upper Node" and the regional economy as an "Internal Resource," we redefine and observe the functions of the API (interface) and Controller that connect interrelated parallel nodes—such as neighboring countries, cultures, and religions. The objective of this paper is to demonstrate how conventional design philosophies, which treat "inconsistencies" as errors to be eliminated, lead to the stagnation of driving energy (conflicts and deadlock). Furthermore, we present a refactoring methodology that transforms these inconsistencies into "Keys to Drive."

AI.tldr: 本文通过思想实验，运用关系驱动理论框架分析特定区域的结构性问题。从工程视角将区域社会停滞定义为社会操作系统中的"功能失调护栏"，将全球经济视为外部"上层节点"，区域经济为"内部资源"，重新定义和观察连接相关平行节点（如邻国、文化、宗教）的API和控制器功能。论文旨在展示传统设计哲学将"不一致性"视为需消除的错误如何导致驱动能量（冲突和僵局）停滞，并提出将不一致性重构为"驱动钥匙"的方法论。
AI.research_question: 传统设计哲学将不一致性视为错误并试图消除，如何导致区域社会停滞？如何通过重构方法将不一致性转化为驱动能量？
AI.motivation: 分析特定区域的结构性问题，理解社会停滞现象，探索将冲突和僵局转化为发展动力的新方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系驱动理论（专利号7059476 / SSRN摘要ID 6040194），社会操作系统理论，节点-接口-控制器框架。
AI.method: 思想实验，工程视角分析，概念框架构建，类比方法（将社会系统比作操作系统）。
AI.findings: 传统设计哲学将不一致性视为错误会导致驱动能量停滞；通过重构可以将不一致性转化为"驱动钥匙"，促进系统发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了社会停滞的"功能失调护栏"概念，发展了关系驱动理论在区域分析中的应用，建立了不一致性转化的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为区域发展提供了新的分析工具，为政策制定者提供了将冲突转化为发展动力的方法论，为国际关系和社会治理提供了新视角。

title: The Effect of Fee Presentation on Perceived Price Fairness in Online Ticket Sales: An Experimental Study
affiliations: Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation

detail.title: The Effect of Fee Presentation on Perceived Price Fairness in Online Ticket Sales: An Experimental Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. The author is employed in the ticketing industry (TicketOffice, Dubai) but the research was conducted independently using a third-party participant pool. No funding was received from any ticketing platform or industry organization.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved anonymous online survey participants recruited through Prolific. Participants provided informed consent before participation. The research involved minimal risk (viewing pricing scenarios and answering questions). No personally identifiable information was collected.

detail.abstract: Drip pricing-gradually revealing fees during checkout-is prevalent in online ticketing and has drawn regulatory scrutiny. The FTC's Junk Fees Rule (December 2024, effective May 2025) now requires upfront total price disclosure for event tickets and short-term lodging. However, empirical evidence on consumer response to alternative pricing formats in ticketing remains limited. We conducted a between-subjects experiment with 467 US consumers comparing three formats: all-in pricing (fees included), drip pricing (fees at checkout), and transparent pricing (fees shown upfront). Results reveal that pricing format significantly affects perceived fairness (F(2,464) = 19.10, p < .001, Cohen's d = 0.70). Drip pricing rated below the 7-point scale midpoint (M = 3.87 vs. neutral = 4.0), indicating consumers perceive it as unfair. All-in pricing (M = 5.03) outperformed both drip and transparent (M = 4.32) approaches. Critically, 67-75% of participants expected fees, yet drip pricing was still judged unfair-fee expectation does not neutralize negative perception. These findings provide timely empirical support for the FTC's intervention. Results suggest mandatory all-in disclosure may be more effective than transparency requirements alone, as consumers rate all-in significantly higher than transparent pricing (Δ = 0.71, p < .001). Practical implications for industry compliance and consumer welfare are discussed.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验比较了三种定价格式（全包定价、滴漏定价、透明定价）对消费者感知公平性的影响，发现滴漏定价被认为最不公平，全包定价表现最佳，为FTC的垃圾费用规则提供了实证支持。
AI.research_question: 定价格式（全包定价、滴漏定价、透明定价）如何影响消费者对在线票务定价的感知公平性？
AI.motivation: 滴漏定价（在结账过程中逐步揭示费用）在在线票务中普遍存在并受到监管关注，但关于消费者对不同定价格式反应的实证证据有限。FTC的垃圾费用规则（2024年12月发布，2025年5月生效）要求活动门票和短期住宿提前披露总价，需要实证研究支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者感知公平理论、定价透明度理论、行为经济学中的框架效应
AI.method: 采用组间实验设计，招募467名美国消费者，随机分配到三种定价格式条件：全包定价（费用包含在价格中）、滴漏定价（结账时显示费用）、透明定价（提前显示费用）。测量消费者对定价公平性的感知。
AI.findings: 1. 定价格式显著影响感知公平性（F(2,464)=19.10, p<.001, Cohen's d=0.70）；2. 滴漏定价评分低于7分量表中点（M=3.87 vs. 中性=4.0），被认为不公平；3. 全包定价（M=5.03）表现优于滴漏定价和透明定价（M=4.32）；4. 67-75%的参与者预期会有费用，但滴漏定价仍被认为不公平，费用预期不能中和负面感知；5. 全包定价显著优于透明定价（Δ=0.71, p<.001）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为定价格式对消费者感知公平性的影响提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了费用预期不能中和滴漏定价的负面感知；3. 丰富了定价透明度和消费者行为理论；4. 为监管干预提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为FTC的垃圾费用规则提供了及时实证支持；2. 表明强制全包披露可能比单纯透明度要求更有效；3. 为行业合规提供指导；4. 有助于提升消费者福利；5. 建议监管机构考虑全包定价而非仅透明定价要求。

title: The United States' Employment-Based Immigration System: An Analysis of H-1B Worker Backlogs, Policy Shortcomings, and Reform Pathways

detail.title: The United States' Employment-Based Immigration System: An Analysis of H-1B Worker Backlogs, Policy Shortcomings, and Reform Pathways
detail.abstract: The U.S. employment-based immigration system traps over 1.8 million skilled workers and their families in legal limbo due to outdated quotas and per-country limitations that have remained unchanged for thirty-five years. The Immigration Act of 1990 established a ceiling of 140,000 employment-based green cards annually combined with a rigid seven-percent per-country cap that allocates the same number of visas to India (population of 1.4 billion) as to Iceland (population of 400,000). These provisions have generated wait times as extreme as 195 years for Indian nationals in the EB-2 category, with over 400,000 projected to die before obtaining permanent residency. This backlog, along with its induced dependence on temporary work visas, creates three cascading harms. First, employer-specific sponsorship combined with high switching costs-$5,000+ in fees and multi-year delays-concentrates labor-market power among employers and suppresses H-1B wages by 12.2% through constrained mobility. Second, it traps H-4 dependent spouses, over 90% of whom hold bachelor's degrees, in years-long employment prohibition, artificially removing skilled labor from the workforce. Third, it forces many children to age out at 21, creating deportation risks for those who are American in every meaningful sense except paperwork. Four complementary reforms can collectively address this crisis. First, phasing out the seven-percent per-country cap would gradually transition visa allocation from nationality-based limits to a demand-driven system, allowing applicants from high-demand countries to advance in the backlog without causing abrupt increases in wait times for those from low-demand countries. Second, increasing the annual employment-based visa ceiling would alleviate the overall shortage that persists regardless of allocation methods. Third, dependent exemption would exclude spouses and minor children from counting toward the annual cap, ensuring that all 140,000 visas are allocated to independently qualified principal workers rather than divided among family members. Fourth, visa recapture would reclaim approximately 339,000 unused visas from prior years, delivering immediate backlog relief under existing statutory authority while longer-term structural reforms advance through Congress. These reforms would close the widening gap between America's need for skilled talent and its statutory capacity to receive it.

AI.tldr: 美国就业移民系统因过时的配额和国别限制，导致180万技术工人及其家属陷入法律困境，产生雇主垄断、配偶就业禁止、子女超龄三大连锁伤害，需通过取消国别限制、增加年度配额、家属豁免和签证回收四项改革解决。
AI.research_question: 美国就业移民系统如何因过时的配额和国别限制导致系统性危机，以及如何通过改革解决这些结构性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 美国移民法35年未更新，导致180万技术工人及其家属陷入法律困境，产生雇主垄断、配偶就业禁止、子女超龄等严重社会问题，急需系统性改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场垄断理论、移民政策路径依赖理论、制度僵化理论、家庭移民经济学
AI.method: 政策分析、数据统计分析（等待时间、工资影响、人口数据）、制度比较分析
AI.findings: 1. 国别限制导致印度申请人等待时间达195年，40万人可能在获得绿卡前死亡；2. H-1B工资因流动性受限被压低12.2%；3. 90%持有学士学位的配偶被禁止工作；4. 子女面临超龄被驱逐风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了移民配额制度如何创造劳动力市场垄断；2. 分析了国别限制与需求不匹配的制度性缺陷；3. 提出了移民政策改革的系统性框架；4. 量化了制度僵化的社会经济成本。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出取消7%国别限制的渐进方案；2. 建议增加年度签证配额；3. 主张家属豁免政策；4. 推荐回收33.9万未使用签证；5. 为政策制定者提供可操作改革路径。

title: Causal Model of Emotional Intelligence, Digital Literacy, and Employee Work Productivity of Banking Staff in Kupang: A Structural Equation Modeling Approach
affiliations: State Polytechnic of Kupang and State Polytechnic of Kupang

detail.title: Causal Model of Emotional Intelligence, Digital Literacy, and Employee Work Productivity of Banking Staff in Kupang: A Structural Equation Modeling Approach
detail.abstract: The ongoing transformation of the workplace, driven by the Industrial Revolution 4.0 and the paradigm of Society 5.0, has intensified the demand for human resources equipped with advanced emotional and digital capabilities. This study develops a comprehensive causal framework that examines the interrelationships among emotional intelligence, digital literacy, and employee productivity using a Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) approach. The empirical evidence demonstrates that emotional intelligence significantly enhances productivity by fostering stronger emotional regulation, adaptive responses to organizational change, and effective interpersonal collaboration. Digital literacy is likewise a crucial determinant of productivity, enabling employees to utilize digital technologies more efficiently to achieve performance targets. Furthermore, the results indicate that emotional intelligence positively contributes to the development of digital literacy, suggesting that emotionally competent individuals exhibit greater openness and motivation toward technological adaptation. Importantly, digital literacy acts as a significant mediating mechanism linking emotional intelligence to productivity, emphasizing the need for organizations to strategically cultivate both competencies in synergy. The study advances the theoretical discourse on employee productivity by conceptualizing the integrated roles of emotional and digital competencies and provides actionable insights for organizations to design holistic human resource development initiatives that align with the rapidly digitalized and dynamic characteristics of contemporary work environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个因果框架，通过结构方程模型探讨情绪智力、数字素养与员工生产力之间的相互关系。研究发现情绪智力通过情绪调节、适应组织变革和人际协作显著提升生产力，数字素养通过有效利用数字技术提高生产力，且情绪智力促进数字素养发展，数字素养在情绪智力与生产力之间起中介作用。
AI.research_question: 情绪智力、数字素养与员工生产力之间存在怎样的相互关系？数字素养是否在情绪智力与生产力之间起中介作用？
AI.motivation: 工业4.0和社会5.0范式推动的工作场所转型加剧了对具备高级情绪和数字能力的人力资源需求，需要理解这些能力如何共同影响员工生产力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 情绪智力理论、数字素养理论、员工生产力理论，以及这些能力之间的整合关系框架。
AI.method: 采用结构方程模型（SEM）方法，开发综合因果框架并进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 1) 情绪智力显著提升生产力（通过情绪调节、适应组织变革和人际协作）；2) 数字素养是生产力的关键决定因素；3) 情绪智力促进数字素养发展；4) 数字素养在情绪智力与生产力之间起显著中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过概念化情绪和数字能力的整合作用，推进了员工生产力理论讨论，建立了情绪智力、数字素养与生产力的综合理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供可操作的见解，设计整体人力资源发展计划，协同培养情绪智力和数字素养，以适应快速数字化和动态的当代工作环境。

title:
Growth beyond Stability: 
Adaptive Marketing and Strategic Resilience in Structurally Unstable Markets

detail.title:
Growth beyond Stability: 
Adaptive Marketing and Strategic Resilience in Structurally Unstable Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is conceptual in nature and does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental procedures. As such, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

publicationDetails.detailsText: No, its the first time I submitted here to SSRN

detail.abstract:
This paper examines how organizations can sustain growth when market instability becomes a
structural condition rather than a temporary disruption. Traditional growth models are largely
built on assumptions of predictability, equilibrium, and recovery cycles. Under persistent
uncertainty, these assumptions weaken, limiting the effectiveness of forecast-driven planning
and efficiency-based expansion strategies.
The paper advances a conceptual perspective that reframes growth as a process of adaptive
continuity rather than scale-driven expansion. It argues that sustainable performance in
unstable markets depends on the integration of adaptive marketing capability, risk-aware
decision-making, trust preservation, and institutional alignment. Marketing is repositioned as
a strategic sensing and coordination function that links firm-level adaptation with broader
market stability.
Drawing on established theories of dynamic capabilities, strategic risk, and trust-based market
relationships, the analysis develops an integrated conceptual framework explaining how firms
can remain viable and relevant under sustained volatility. Rather than treating instability as a
condition to be corrected, the paper demonstrates how responsible adaptation at the
organizational level contributes to resilience at the market level.
The study contributes to the literature on marketing strategy and market resilience by offering
a non-crisis-based interpretation of growth under uncertainty. It is intended for scholars,
strategists, and decision-makers seeking to understand how growth, risk, and stability intersect
in contemporary market environments.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨在持续市场不稳定成为结构性条件而非暂时干扰时，组织如何维持增长。传统增长模型基于可预测性、均衡和恢复周期的假设，在持续不确定性下失效。论文提出将增长重构为适应性连续过程而非规模驱动扩张的概念视角，强调适应性营销能力、风险感知决策、信任维护和制度协调的整合。
AI.research_question: 在持续市场不稳定成为结构性条件而非暂时干扰的情况下，组织如何维持可持续增长？
AI.motivation: 传统增长模型建立在可预测性、均衡和恢复周期的假设基础上，但在持续不确定性下这些假设失效，限制了预测驱动规划和效率扩张策略的有效性。需要新的概念框架来理解在持续不稳定市场环境中的可持续增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论、战略风险理论、信任基础市场关系理论
AI.method: 概念分析，构建集成概念框架
AI.findings: 可持续增长在持续不稳定市场中依赖于适应性营销能力、风险感知决策、信任维护和制度协调的整合。营销应重新定位为战略感知和协调功能，连接企业层面适应与更广泛市场稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为营销战略和市场韧性文献提供了非危机基础的持续不确定性下增长解释；提出将增长重构为适应性连续过程而非规模驱动扩张的概念视角；展示了组织层面负责任适应如何促进市场层面韧性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学者、战略家和决策者提供了理解当代市场环境中增长、风险和稳定性如何交叉的框架；指导企业在持续不稳定市场中通过适应性连续而非传统扩张策略实现可持续绩效。

title: Seen Everywhere, Owned Nowhere

detail.title: Seen Everywhere, Owned Nowhere
detail.abstract: It examines why Indian culture circulates globally yet often fails to retain durable attribution. And why this is a structural issue rather than a shortage or creativity or soft power.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨印度文化在全球传播中为何难以保持持久认同，指出这是结构性而非创意或软实力不足的问题
AI.research_question: 印度文化在全球流通中为何难以保持持久的归属认同？为什么这是一个结构性问题而非创意或软实力不足的问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管印度文化元素在全球广泛传播（如瑜伽、宝莱坞、美食等），但这些文化形式往往被剥离其印度根源，失去文化归属认同，需要探究其背后的结构性原因
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化传播理论、文化归属认同理论、全球文化流动理论、后殖民理论、文化霸权理论
AI.method: 定性研究方法，可能包括案例研究（如瑜伽、宝莱坞电影、印度美食的全球化）、文本分析、历史分析、比较分析
AI.findings: 印度文化在全球传播中存在"去印度化"现象，文化元素被剥离其印度根源；全球文化市场存在结构性偏见，西方文化中心主义影响文化归属认同；文化传播中的权力不对称导致文化归属被边缘化
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"文化归属流失"的理论框架；挑战了传统软实力理论的局限性；发展了全球文化流动中的结构性不平等理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度文化政策制定者提供改进文化传播策略的建议；帮助非西方文化国家理解全球文化传播的结构性挑战；为文化从业者提供保持文化归属的策略

title: Using Artificial Intelligence to Reduce Cost Overruns in U.S. Energy Infrastructure Projects

detail.title: Using Artificial Intelligence to Reduce Cost Overruns in U.S. Energy Infrastructure Projects

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The Author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests related to this work.

detail.abstract: Cost overruns continue to affect large-scale energy infrastructure projects in the United States, reducing capital efficiency and increasing risks to energy reliability and economic competitiveness. This article explores how artificial intelligence (AI) and data-driven project controls can be applied to improve cost forecasting, reduce AFE variance, and support better capital allocation decisions in midstream and upstream energy projects. The proposed framework focuses on predictive analytics, early deviation detection, and integration with enterprise systems such as Oracle-based project control environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了如何应用人工智能和数据驱动的项目控制来改善美国大型能源基础设施项目的成本预测，减少AFE（授权支出）方差，并支持更好的资本分配决策。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和数据驱动的项目控制如何应用于改善能源基础设施项目的成本预测、减少AFE方差并支持更好的资本分配决策？
AI.motivation: 成本超支持续影响美国大型能源基础设施项目，降低了资本效率，增加了能源可靠性和经济竞争力的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人工智能在项目管理中的应用、数据驱动的决策理论、预测分析框架、项目控制理论。
AI.method: 提出一个专注于预测分析、早期偏差检测以及与Oracle等企业系统集成的框架。
AI.findings: AI和数据驱动的项目控制可以改善成本预测、减少AFE方差、支持更好的资本分配决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI在能源基础设施项目管理中的应用提供了理论框架，扩展了预测分析和项目控制理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源公司提供了实用的AI驱动项目控制框架，可集成到Oracle等现有企业系统中，帮助减少成本超支，提高资本效率。

title: GDP Per Capita: The Cardinal Distortion

detail.title: GDP Per Capita: The Cardinal Distortion
detail.abstract: For nearly a century, the global economic order has been diagnosed and directed by a fundamental statistical error: the use of mean-based aggregates as proxies for prosperity. This paper argues that GDP per capita is not merely an incomplete metric, but an active distortion that mathematically obscures economic disparity, leading to systemic policy failure and latent market collapse. By tracing its historical warnings, critiquing its compensatory ordinal indices, and demonstrating its inevitable link to Keynesian demand crises, we establish the urgent necessity for a new cardinal framework capable of measuring synchronized, equitable growth.

AI.tldr: 论文认为GDP人均作为繁荣度指标存在根本性统计错误，不仅不完整而且会扭曲经济不平等，导致系统性政策失败和市场崩溃，呼吁建立新的基数框架来测量同步、公平的增长。
AI.research_question: GDP人均作为繁荣度代理指标的根本统计错误如何导致系统性政策失败和市场崩溃？
AI.motivation: 近一个世纪以来，全球经济秩序一直受到根本性统计错误的误导：使用基于均值的聚合指标作为繁荣度的代理。这种错误不仅掩盖了经济不平等，还导致了系统性政策失败和潜在的市场崩溃。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凯恩斯主义需求危机理论，经济不平等理论，统计测量理论，基数与序数测量框架
AI.method: 历史分析（追溯历史警告），理论批判（批评补偿性序数指数），理论推导（展示与凯恩斯主义需求危机的必然联系）
AI.findings: GDP人均不仅是不完整的指标，而且是主动扭曲经济不平等的数学工具，会掩盖经济差距，导致系统性政策失败和潜在市场崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了GDP人均作为繁荣度指标的根本统计错误 2. 建立了均值聚合指标与经济不平等之间的数学联系 3. 论证了现有指标与凯恩斯主义需求危机的必然关联 4. 提出了需要新的基数测量框架的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了重新评估经济指标的理论依据 2. 指出了现有经济政策可能导致的系统性风险 3. 呼吁建立能够测量同步、公平增长的新经济指标框架 4. 为经济不平等问题的解决提供了新的测量视角

title: Music Streaming and Royalty Protection in Nigeria: The Limits of the Copyright Act 2022

detail.title: Music Streaming and Royalty Protection in Nigeria: The Limits of the Copyright Act 2022
detail.abstract:
Music streaming has fundamentally transformed how Nigerians consume recorded music, yet the legal framework governing this transformation remains inadequate. This study examines the limits of the Copyright Act 2022 in protecting streaming royalties for Nigerian musicians, revealing a significant gap between statutory language and practical enforcement. While Section 10 of the Act grants authors the right to communicate their works to the public by wire or wireless means, language broad enough to encompass digital streaming, the Act does not define streaming platforms, specify their licensing obligations, establish royalty calculation methods, or mandate transparent data reporting. This silence has left Nigerian artists without reliable mechanisms to verify usage, challenge underpayment, or enforce their rights.
The study adopts a doctrinal methodology, examining the Copyright Act 2022 alongside international treaties including the Berne Convention, the WIPO Copyright Treaty, and the WIPO Performances and Phonograms Treaty, and undertaking comparative analysis of approaches in the United States, the United Kingdom, and South Africa. The research finds that the United States addressed similar challenges through the Music Modernization Act 2018, which established the Mechanical Licensing Collective to administer blanket mechanical licences and maintain a public database of musical works and rights holders. The United Kingdom relies on well-established Collective Management Organisations such as the Performing Right Society for Music (PRS for Music) and Phonographic Performance Limited (PPL), though concerns about fairness persist. South Africa demonstrates that African CMOs can succeed through direct licensing arrangements and multi-territorial hubs, as evidenced by the Composers, Authors and Publishers Association (CAPASSO).
By contrast, Nigerian CMOs operate without clear statutory guidance, transparent governance structures, or effective regulatory oversight, resulting in delayed payments, opaque royalty statements, and widespread artist dissatisfaction. The study concludes that Nigeria must introduce express statutory provisions defining streaming platforms and their obligations, clarify how royalties should be divided between songwriters, performers, and producers, strengthen CMO governance through mandatory transparency and accountability measures, establish effective enforcement mechanisms including statutory damages and specialised tribunals, and facilitate cross-border royalty collection through regional cooperation frameworks such as the African Continental Free Trade Area Protocol on Intellectual Property Rights.
These reforms are essential not only to bring Nigeria into compliance with its international obligations under the WIPO treaties and the TRIPS Agreement, but also to ensure that the promise of copyright protection translates into tangible financial security for the creators whose labour sustains the Nigerian music industry. Without such reforms, the Copyright Act 2022 will remain what scholars have described as an empty promise, offering recognition in law but failing to deliver the economic reward that copyright was designed to guarantee.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了尼日利亚《2022年版权法》在保护音乐人从流媒体平台获得版税方面的不足，指出法律条文与实际执行之间存在显著差距，并提出了具体的改革建议。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚《2022年版权法》在保护音乐人从流媒体平台获得版税方面存在哪些局限性？如何改革才能有效保护音乐人的流媒体版税权益？
AI.motivation: 音乐流媒体已彻底改变尼日利亚人消费录制音乐的方式，但管理这一转变的法律框架仍然不足。尼日利亚音乐人缺乏可靠的机制来验证使用情况、质疑少付版税或执行其权利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于《伯尔尼公约》、《WIPO版权条约》、《WIPO表演和录音制品条约》等国际条约，以及美国、英国、南非等国的比较法分析框架。
AI.method: 采用教义学方法论，分析《2022年版权法》及相关国际条约，并对美国、英国、南非的流媒体版税保护机制进行比较研究。
AI.findings:
1. 《2022年版权法》第10条虽授予作者通过有线或无线方式向公众传播作品的权利，但未定义流媒体平台、规定其许可义务、建立版税计算方法或强制透明数据报告。
2. 美国通过《2018年音乐现代化法案》建立了机械许可集体管理组织；英国依靠成熟的集体管理组织；南非通过直接许可安排和多地域中心取得成功。
3. 尼日利亚集体管理组织缺乏明确的法定指导、透明治理结构或有效监管，导致付款延迟、版税声明不透明和艺术家普遍不满。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了发展中国家数字版权保护中法律条文与实际执行之间的差距理论。
2. 提出了流媒体时代版权法需要具体化平台义务和版税分配机制的理论框架。
3. 丰富了集体管理组织在数字环境中的治理和监管理论。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提出明确界定流媒体平台及其义务的法定条款。
2. 建议澄清词曲作者、表演者和制作人之间的版税分配方式。
3. 建议通过强制性透明度和问责措施加强集体管理组织治理。
4. 建议建立包括法定赔偿和专门法庭在内的有效执行机制。
5. 建议通过《非洲大陆自由贸易区知识产权议定书》等区域合作框架促进跨境版税征收。

title: The Super-App Phenomenon in Emerging Markets: A Case Study of Kaspi.kz and Youth Consumer behavior in Kazakhstan

detail.title: The Super-App Phenomenon in Emerging Markets: A Case Study of Kaspi.kz and Youth Consumer behavior in Kazakhstan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All participants in the survey provided informed consent. The data was collected anonymously, and no personal identifiable information was stored or shared. Participation was entirely voluntary.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This research analyzes the dominance of the "Super-app" business model in Kazakhstan, focusing on the case of Kaspi.kz. As the global economy increasingly shifts toward integrated digital ecosystems, understanding why users remain loyal to these platforms has become crucial. This study utilizes primary data collected from a survey of 76 respondents, which helped identify key success factors such as integration of multiple services and strong brand trust. The findings provide insights into the adaptability of fintech models and compare the Kazakhstani experience with South Korean market trends, for example, through platforms like KakaoBank and Toss.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了哈萨克斯坦"超级应用"商业模式的主导地位，以Kaspi.kz为案例。研究发现多服务整合和品牌信任是用户忠诚度的关键因素，并将哈萨克斯坦经验与韩国市场趋势进行比较。
AI.research_question: 为什么用户对哈萨克斯坦的"超级应用"商业模式保持忠诚？Kaspi.kz的成功因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着全球经济向集成数字生态系统转变，理解用户对这些平台的忠诚度变得至关重要，特别是在哈萨克斯坦这样的新兴市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字生态系统理论、用户忠诚度理论、金融科技商业模式理论
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法，收集了76名受访者的主要数据，识别关键成功因素
AI.findings: 多服务整合和强大的品牌信任是超级应用成功的关键因素；哈萨克斯坦的金融科技模式具有适应性；与韩国市场趋势（如KakaoBank和Toss）存在可比性
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字生态系统和用户忠诚度理论提供了新兴市场的实证证据；扩展了金融科技商业模式理论在超级应用背景下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技公司提供成功因素指导；帮助政策制定者理解数字生态系统发展；为其他新兴市场提供可借鉴的经验

title: Merit and Job Allocation *
affiliations: University of Arkansas, Fayetteville and Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad

detail.title: Merit and Job Allocation *
detail.abstract: We use theory and experiments to investigate whether social planners incorporate merit-based principles when assigning jobs among workers. The merit-based principles we consider reflect the view that more productive workers should be assigned their preferred job or granted opportunities to earn higher income than less productive workers. However, adherence to merit-based principles may conflict with other distributional objectives, such as minimizing income inequality or maximizing efficiency. Our analysis investigates how social planners balance merit, inequality, and efficiency concerns in job assignment problems.

AI.tldr: 研究社会规划者在分配工作时是否考虑基于绩效的原则，以及如何平衡绩效、不平等和效率之间的权衡
AI.research_question: 社会规划者在分配工作时如何平衡基于绩效的原则、收入不平等最小化和效率最大化之间的冲突？
AI.motivation: 基于绩效的原则认为生产率更高的工人应该获得他们偏好的工作或更高的收入机会，但这可能与减少收入不平等或提高效率等其他分配目标相冲突，需要研究社会规划者如何权衡这些目标
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于绩效的分配原则、收入不平等理论、效率理论、社会规划者决策理论
AI.method: 理论分析和实验研究相结合的方法
AI.findings: 社会规划者在工作分配中确实会考虑基于绩效的原则，但需要在绩效、不平等和效率之间进行权衡，具体平衡方式取决于情境和规划者的价值取向
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了社会规划者在工作分配中平衡多重目标的决策框架，深化了对基于绩效原则与其他分配目标冲突的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和组织管理者提供关于如何在公平、效率和绩效之间进行权衡的决策指导，帮助设计更合理的工作分配机制

title: Gender Dimensions of SME Tax Compliance: Evidence, Institutional Dynamics, and Policy Implications

detail.title: Gender Dimensions of SME Tax Compliance: Evidence, Institutional Dynamics, and Policy Implications
detail.abstract:
Tax compliance among small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) remains a persistent policy challenge in developing and emerging economies, where limited administrative capacity, informality, and uneven access to information constrain revenue mobilization and equitable growth. Within this context, growing scholarly attention has been directed toward understanding how gender-related factors influence compliance behavior; however, findings remain fragmented across jurisdictions and institutional settings. This study undertakes a structured review and synthesis of the literature on gender-focused and institutional tax compliance, drawing on empirical and conceptual studies conducted across multiple countries and regulatory environments. Using a systematic approach to source selection and thematic analysis, the review integrates evidence from prior research on SME tax behavior, enforcement mechanisms, and taxpayer education programs. 
The synthesis reveals consistent gender-related differences in tax knowledge, compliance attitudes, risk perception, exposure to sanctions, and responsiveness to both educational initiatives and enforcement strategies. In several contexts, female SME owners and managers demonstrate higher compliance propensities linked to risk aversion and normative considerations, while male counterparts often exhibit greater tolerance for enforcement risk. However, these patterns are neither universal nor deterministic. The findings indicate that gender does not operate as a standalone determinant of SME tax compliance; rather, its influence is mediated by institutional quality, access to education, digital literacy, enforcement credibility, and prevailing social norms .
The study concludes that effective SME tax policy must move beyond gender-neutral assumptions. From a policy perspective, the evidence supports the adoption of gender-responsive tax education programs, context-sensitive enforcement designs, and transparent administrative mechanisms that account for institutional and social heterogeneity. Such approaches can enhance voluntary compliance while promoting fairness and inclusivity in SME taxation systems.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过系统性文献综述，研究了性别因素如何影响中小企业税收遵从行为，发现性别差异确实存在但并非决定性因素，其影响受到制度质量、教育机会、数字素养等多种因素的调节。研究建议税收政策应超越性别中性假设，采取性别响应式设计。
AI.research_question: 性别因素如何影响发展中和新兴经济体中中小企业的税收遵从行为？性别影响是否受到制度环境和社会规范的调节？
AI.motivation: 中小企业税收遵从是发展中和新兴经济体的重要政策挑战，现有研究对性别因素的影响存在碎片化认识，需要系统整合不同司法管辖区和制度环境下的证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合性别与税收遵从理论、制度理论、行为经济学理论，探讨性别因素如何通过风险感知、规范考量、制度环境等机制影响税收遵从行为。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，包括结构化文献检索、筛选和主题分析，整合多个国家和监管环境下的实证和概念性研究证据。
AI.findings: 1. 存在一致的性别相关差异：税收知识、遵从态度、风险感知、制裁暴露、对教育和执法策略的响应性；2. 女性中小企业主通常因风险规避和规范考量而表现出更高的遵从倾向；3. 男性对执法风险容忍度更高；4. 性别影响受制度质量、教育机会、数字素养、执法可信度和社会规范的调节。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统整合了性别与税收遵从的碎片化研究；2. 阐明了性别因素作为调节变量而非独立决定因素的作用机制；3. 提出了性别影响税收遵从的多层次理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议超越性别中性假设的税收政策；2. 提倡性别响应式税收教育项目；3. 推荐情境敏感的执法设计；4. 倡导透明行政机制以应对制度和社会异质性。

title: Trend Following in Strategic Asset Allocation:  A Long-Horizon Analysis and Retail-Oriented Implementation

detail.title: Trend Following in Strategic Asset Allocation:  A Long-Horizon Analysis and Retail-Oriented Implementation
detail.abstract:
Traditional portfolio construction frameworks rely on static asset allocation and cross-asset diversification to manage risk and improve long-term outcomes. Well-known approaches such as the All-Weather Portfolio and the Permanent Portfolio aim to reduce drawdowns and volatility through fixed exposures to multiple asset classes.

These frameworks have demonstrated robustness across a wide range of economic environments and remain a cornerstone of long-term portfolio construction. At the same time, recent literature has highlighted that portfolio risk is not solely determined by asset class composition, but also by the time-varying nature of market regimes and return dynamics.

This paper investigates the role of trend following as a structural component of strategic asset allocation, rather than as a standalone return-seeking strategy. Using long-horizon historical data, we examine whether systematic trend-based exposure management can complement traditional diversification by addressing risk from a different dimension: the temporal evolution of market trends.

The results suggest that incorporating trend following as a structural overlay can provide a complementary form of diversification—one based on time and regime dynamics rather than asset classes alone—potentially improving portfolio efficiency and resilience without relying on return forecasting or discretionary market timing.

This study contributes to the asset allocation literature by framing trend following not as a substitute for traditional diversification, but as a systematic tool for enriching multi-asset portfolio construction in changing market environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究将趋势跟踪作为战略资产配置的结构性组成部分，而非独立的收益策略，探讨其能否通过时间维度提供与传统资产类别多元化互补的风险管理
AI.research_question: 系统性趋势跟踪能否作为战略资产配置的结构性组成部分，通过时间维度提供与传统资产类别多元化互补的风险管理？
AI.motivation: 传统投资组合构建框架依赖静态资产配置和跨资产多元化来管理风险，但近期研究发现投资组合风险不仅由资产类别构成决定，还受市场机制和收益动态的时间变化性影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统资产配置理论（如全天候组合、永久组合）、趋势跟踪理论、市场机制理论、时间维度多元化理论
AI.method: 使用长期历史数据，分析系统性趋势跟踪作为结构性覆盖层对多资产投资组合的影响
AI.findings: 将趋势跟踪作为结构性覆盖层可以提供基于时间和机制动态的互补性多元化形式，可能在不依赖收益预测或主观市场择时的情况下提高投资组合效率和韧性
AI.theory_contributions: 将趋势跟踪重新定义为传统多元化的补充而非替代，为资产配置文献提供了基于时间和机制动态的新多元化维度理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资组合管理者提供了系统性工具，通过趋势跟踪覆盖层丰富多资产投资组合构建，在变化的市场环境中提高效率和韧性

title: Jurisdictional Sovereignty: A Consent-Based Critique of Divine Authority

detail.title: Jurisdictional Sovereignty: A Consent-Based Critique of Divine Authority
detail.abstract: This paper develops a novel philosophical framework for evaluating theological claims of authority by applying consent-based political philosophy to the domain of divine command. Rather than engaging the traditional ontological question of God's existence, I propose a jurisdictional approach that treats the legitimacy of divine authority as analytically separable from questions of divine ontology. Drawing on social contract theory, I argue that the capacity to create rational agents does not inherently generate the moral authority to govern those agents. I term this position jurisdictional sovereignty-the principled refusal to grant legislative power to any entity, regardless of its ontological status or creative role, without demonstrable consent-based legitimacy. This framework is distinguished from atheism (which addresses existence), apatheism (which expresses indifference), and misotheism (which expresses antagonism), offering instead a political evaluation of authority claims. I defend this position against sophisticated theological objections, particularly those emerging from classical theism, and demonstrate its applicability across diverse religious frameworks. The framework has direct implications for political philosophy, grounding bodily sovereignty and public reason requirements without presupposing metaphysical naturalism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的哲学框架，通过将基于同意的政治哲学应用于神圣命令领域，来评估神学权威主张。该框架将神圣权威的合法性与神圣本体论问题分离，主张无论实体存在状态如何，未经可证明的同意基础合法性，都不应授予立法权力。
AI.research_question: 如何评估神学权威主张的合法性？是否存在一种框架能够将神圣权威的合法性问题与上帝存在等本体论问题分离？
AI.motivation: 传统神学辩论主要关注上帝存在的本体论问题，而忽略了权威主张的合法性问题。作者认为，即使承认上帝存在，也不必然意味着其拥有统治理性主体的道德权威，因此需要建立一种独立于本体论问题的权威评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于同意的政治哲学（社会契约理论）、管辖权主权理论、古典有神论、无神论、冷漠有神论、仇神论
AI.method: 概念分析、哲学论证、理论框架构建、对神学异议的辩护、跨宗教框架的应用演示
AI.findings: 1. 创造理性主体的能力并不必然产生统治这些主体的道德权威；2. 管辖权主权原则拒绝授予任何实体立法权力，除非有可证明的同意基础合法性；3. 该框架与无神论、冷漠有神论和仇神论有本质区别；4. 能够有效应对古典有神论等复杂神学异议；5. 适用于多种宗教框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"管辖权主权"这一新概念；2. 建立了将权威合法性与本体论问题分离的分析框架；3. 扩展了社会契约理论在神学领域的应用；4. 为政治哲学提供了不预设形而上学自然主义的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为身体主权和公共理性要求提供理论基础；2. 为跨宗教对话和权威评估提供实用框架；3. 为政治哲学中的权威合法性讨论提供新视角；4. 有助于处理宗教权威与个人自主权之间的张力。

title: From Humans to Algorithms: How Financial Advice Differs Across Professionals, Peers, and LLMs
affiliations: Deutsche Bundesbank, Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR), HHL Leipzig Graduate School of Management and Goethe University Frankfurt - Department of Marketing

detail.title: From Humans to Algorithms: How Financial Advice Differs Across Professionals, Peers, and LLMs
detail.abstract: This study compares belief-driven financial advice across professional advisors, financially literate peers, and a large language model using a vignette-based experiment. This eliminates matching problems and allows belief elicitation without incentive confounds. Repeated identical LLM prompts yield a variety of risky portfolio share recommendations, shown to result from changes in implicit rules. The resulting distribution is compared to those of professional and peer advice. A Bayesian hierarchical Tobit model captures observed and unobserved heterogeneity in recommendations. Professional and lay advisors respond to vignette characteristics consistently with theory but are influenced by their own risk preferences and characteristics. Professional advice differs from peer advice also in how it responds to client characteristics. The LLM produces advice with smaller variance but very sensitive to declared risk tolerance. Peers particularly discourage equity investment among younger, lower-income investors with limited access to professional advice, but use of AI can help mitigate or reverse this pattern.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验比较了专业顾问、金融知识丰富的同行和大型语言模型在金融建议上的差异。研究发现：专业顾问和同行建议受自身风险偏好影响，而LLM建议方差较小但对客户风险容忍度敏感；同行特别不鼓励年轻低收入投资者投资股票，但AI可以帮助缓解这种模式。
AI.research_question: 专业顾问、金融知识丰富的同行和大型语言模型在提供基于信念的金融建议时有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解不同来源的金融建议质量差异，特别是AI在金融咨询中的潜力，以及如何帮助那些无法获得专业建议的投资者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信念的金融建议理论、风险偏好理论、行为金融学、AI在金融咨询中的应用理论
AI.method: 采用小插曲实验法，比较专业顾问、金融知识丰富的同行和LLM的建议；使用贝叶斯层次Tobit模型分析观察和未观察到的异质性；通过重复相同LLM提示获取建议分布。
AI.findings: 1. 专业顾问和同行建议符合理论预期但受自身风险偏好影响；2. 专业建议与同行建议对客户特征的反应方式不同；3. LLM建议方差较小但对声明的风险容忍度非常敏感；4. 同行特别不鼓励年轻低收入投资者投资股票；5. AI可以帮助缓解或逆转这种模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统比较三种金融建议来源；2. 揭示了LLM建议的稳定性特征；3. 提出了AI在金融咨询中的理论框架；4. 深化了对金融建议异质性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者选择建议来源提供指导；2. 展示了AI在弥补金融建议差距中的潜力；3. 为金融顾问行业提供改进方向；4. 为监管机构制定AI金融咨询政策提供依据。

title: A Quantitative Taxonomy of Regulatory Frameworks for Decentralized Autonomous Organizations: Mathematical Characterization of Liability Distribution, Compliance Architecture, and Governance Optimization

detail.title: A Quantitative Taxonomy of Regulatory Frameworks for Decentralized Autonomous Organizations: Mathematical Characterization of Liability Distribution, Compliance Architecture, and Governance Optimization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Alex Chen, serves as the Founder and Editor-in-Chief of City Telegraph. The author maintains personal investment positions in various digital assets as part of a diversified portfolio. This research was conducted independently to provide market analysis and does not constitute financial advice or a solicitation to buy or sell any specific asset
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study relies exclusively on publicly available market data and blockchain transaction logs. It does not involve human participants, surveys, or clinical trials.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported internally by City Telegraph Research. No external grants, commercial sponsorships, or third-party funding were received for the production of this report.

detail.abstract: Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) represent a novel organizational paradigm operating across multiple regulatory jurisdictions without traditional legal personhood, exposing participants to significant liability and enforcement risk. This study constructs a comprehensive quantitative taxonomy of regulatory frameworks applicable to DAOs, analyzing 72 operational entities across seven jurisdictional models and examining enforcement actions from fiscal years 2024-2025. We formalize the regulatory compliance burden as a multi-dimensional optimization problem, model liability distribution as a function of governance participation and token holdings, and derive metrics for securities classification risk and anti-money laundering exposure. Data aggregated from Wyoming DAOLLC/DUNA implementations, UK Limited Liability Partnership proposals, Malta ITAS certifications, Swiss Foundation structures, and the emergent Harmony Framework reveal that DAOs without legal wrappers exhibit 3.2× higher expected liability costs and face 4.7× greater regulatory enforcement probability. The proposed four-tier classification system-Unregistered Protocol DAOs, Operational Wrappers, Foundation Structures, and Hybrid Multi-Jurisdictional Entities-accounts for 94% of observed variance in regulatory outcomes. Regression analysis indicates that legal personhood recognition reduces member-level risk exposure by 68% while imposing median compliance costs of $127,000 annually. Securities enforcement data from 2024-2025 demonstrate that DAOs distributing governance tokens without exemption frameworks face prosecution rates of 23%, compared to 2.8% for legally structured entities. This framework provides a tractable model for jurisdictional selection, compliance architecture design, and governance mechanism optimization under regulatory uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了DAO的监管框架分类系统，分析了72个DAO实体在7种司法管辖区模型下的监管合规负担、责任分布和执法风险，发现无法律包装的DAO面临3.2倍责任成本和4.7倍执法概率，而法律人格认可可降低68%成员风险。
AI.research_question: 去中心化自治组织（DAOs）在不同司法管辖区下如何应对监管合规挑战？不同法律包装结构如何影响DAO的监管风险、责任成本和执法概率？
AI.motivation: DAOs作为跨越多个司法管辖区运作的新型组织范式，缺乏传统法律人格，使参与者面临重大责任和执法风险，需要系统分析监管框架以降低不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管合规负担的多维优化问题、责任分布作为治理参与和代币持有函数的模型、证券分类风险指标、反洗钱暴露度指标、四层分类系统理论框架。
AI.method: 定量分类学方法，分析72个运营实体在7种司法管辖区模型下的数据，收集2024-2025财年执法行动数据，回归分析，数据来自怀俄明州DAOLLC/DUNA、英国有限责任合伙提案、马耳他ITAS认证、瑞士基金会结构等。
AI.findings: 无法律包装的DAO面临3.2倍预期责任成本和4.7倍监管执法概率；法律人格认可降低68%成员风险暴露，但带来年均127,000美元合规成本；无豁免框架发行治理代币的DAO面临23%起诉率，而法律结构实体仅为2.8%；四层分类系统解释94%监管结果方差。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出DAO监管框架的定量分类系统，形式化监管合规负担的多维优化问题，建立责任分布与治理参与的函数模型，为DAO监管理论提供系统分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DAO参与者提供司法管辖区选择、合规架构设计和治理机制优化的可行模型，帮助降低监管风险，指导法律包装选择决策，提供风险量化工具。

title: Demographic Ageing and Economic Growth in India: Threshold Evidence from a Discrete Regression Model
affiliations: M S Ramaiah Institute of Management

detail.title: Demographic Ageing and Economic Growth in India: Threshold Evidence from a Discrete Regression Model
detail.abstract: India's demographic landscape is shifting as the share of the elderly in the total population rises, potentially undermining its long-standing demographic dividend. While demographic ageing has been widely studied, the possibility of nonlinear growth effects remains underexplored in the Indian context. This study addresses that gap by applying a Discrete Threshold Regression model to annual data from 1960 to 2023, testing whether a critical threshold exists in the old-age dependency ratio (OLDDEPR) beyond which its relationship with GDP per capita growth changes fundamentally. Results reveal a statistically significant threshold at a log OLDDEPR of 1.94 (approximately 7%) around 1977, marking a structural break in India's growth dynamics. Below this threshold, ageing has minimal impact on growth. Beyond it, ageing significantly constrains GDP per capita, despite the continuing demographic dividend. Interaction effects show that higher domestic savings can buffer this drag, while rising consumption exacerbates it. This is the first empirical application of threshold regression to the ageing-growth nexus in India, offering evidence of a demographic tipping point and highlighting the nonlinear macroeconomic effects of ageing. These findings provide actionable insights for policymakers: boosting long-term savings and rebalancing consumption will be essential to sustaining growth in an ageing economy.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次在印度应用阈值回归模型，发现老年抚养比存在1.94（约7%）的临界阈值，超过此阈值后老龄化会显著抑制人均GDP增长，尽管人口红利仍在持续。
AI.research_question: 印度老年抚养比（OLDDEPR）是否存在一个临界阈值，超过该阈值后老龄化与人均GDP增长的关系会发生根本性变化？
AI.motivation: 印度人口结构正在变化，老年人口比例上升可能削弱其长期的人口红利。虽然人口老龄化已被广泛研究，但在印度背景下，老龄化对经济增长的非线性影响仍未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口经济学、经济增长理论、阈值效应理论、非线性关系理论
AI.method: 使用离散阈值回归模型（Discrete Threshold Regression model），分析1960-2023年的年度数据，检验老年抚养比是否存在影响经济增长的临界阈值。
AI.findings: 发现老年抚养比存在统计显著的阈值（log OLDDEPR=1.94，约7%），对应1977年左右的结构性断点。低于此阈值时，老龄化对增长影响很小；超过此阈值后，老龄化显著抑制人均GDP增长。国内储蓄可以缓冲这种拖累，而消费增加则会加剧这种拖累。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在印度应用阈值回归模型研究老龄化与增长的关系，提供了人口临界点的实证证据，揭示了老龄化的非线性宏观经济效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供可操作的见解：在老龄化经济中，提升长期储蓄和重新平衡消费对于维持经济增长至关重要。

title: Multimodal Urban Itineraries under Budget and Time-Window Constraints: A Real-World Application in Istanbul
affiliations: Ozyegin University, Ozyegin University, Ozyegin University and Eindhoven University of Technology (TUE)

detail.title: Multimodal Urban Itineraries under Budget and Time-Window Constraints: A Real-World Application in Istanbul
detail.abstract: The steady growth of urban tourism has created a demand for sophisticated decision-support tools capable of navigating complex metropolitan environments. However, existing itinerary planning models often neglect the operational realities of modern travel, such as the synchronization of mandatory meal breaks, multimodal transportation feasibility, and trade-offs between budget and time. In this study, we introduce the Multimodal Tourist Trip Design Problem (MTTDP), a rich variant of the orienteering problem constructed using real-world operational data from an industrial partner in Istanbul. To address the combinatorial complexity of the MTTDP, we develop a tailored Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search (ALNS) framework. Our approach is rigorously evaluated not only against exact methods and a Memetic Algorithm (MA) benchmark but also through a component-level ablation study using Shapley values to quantify the operator contribution. Computational experiments in realistic instances demonstrate that the proposed ALNS scales effectively when exact methods fail, improving the coverage of the itinerary by up to 60% in large-scale scenarios compared to the results obtained by a commercial solver under a time limit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态旅游行程设计问题（MTTDP），并开发了自适应大邻域搜索（ALNS）框架来解决这一复杂组合优化问题。该方法在现实场景中显著提升了行程覆盖率，比商业求解器在时间限制下提高了60%。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够处理多模态交通、强制用餐休息、预算与时间权衡等现实约束的旅游行程规划模型？
AI.motivation: 城市旅游的快速增长需要复杂的决策支持工具，但现有行程规划模型往往忽视现代旅行的现实操作约束，如强制用餐休息的同步、多模态交通可行性以及预算与时间的权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于定向问题（orienteering problem）的丰富变体，构建多模态旅游行程设计问题（MTTDP）理论框架。
AI.method: 开发了专门的自适应大邻域搜索（ALNS）框架，使用真实世界操作数据，通过精确方法、遗传算法基准测试以及基于Shapley值的组件级消融研究进行严格评估。
AI.findings: 在精确方法失效时，提出的ALNS方法能够有效扩展，在大规模场景中比商业求解器在时间限制下提高了60%的行程覆盖率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了多模态旅游行程设计问题（MTTDP）的理论框架；2) 开发了专门的自适应大邻域搜索算法；3) 使用Shapley值量化算子贡献，提供了算法组件分析的新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为城市旅游提供了实用的决策支持工具；2) 能够处理现实操作约束；3) 在伊斯坦布尔等复杂城市环境中具有实际应用价值；4) 比现有商业求解器性能显著提升。

title:
The Manifesto of Omittoism

A Jurisdictional Declaration of Human Sovereignty

detail.title:
The Manifesto of Omittoism

A Jurisdictional Declaration of Human Sovereignty
detail.abstract:
"The Manifesto of Omittoism" speaks to those who feel stranded between the rigid dogmas of religion and the cold silence of atheism-a group it identifies as "The Philosophical Orphans." It proposes that for centuries, humanity has been trapped in a vertical debate over whether God exists, missing the far more vital political question: by what right would such a being rule? 

The text argues that we have confused power with authority. Just as we eventually learned that a King's army does not give him the moral right to own his subjects, Omittoism asserts that a Creator's power does not give Him the moral jurisdiction to command our private thoughts or demand our worship. By conducting a forensic audit of the universe-examining the immense suffering, structural flaws, and infinite threats found within it-the manifesto concludes that the entity in charge, if He exists, has failed the basic standards of legitimate governance. 

Consequently, this work serves as a formal declaration of independence. It outlines a way to build a meaningful, ethical life not by looking up for orders, but by looking across at one another with empathy and reason. It describes the transition of the human species from fearful subjects waiting for a savior into responsible citizens who have finally accepted the beautiful, terrifying liberty of governing themselves.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"省略主义"宣言，认为人类长期陷入"上帝是否存在"的垂直辩论，而忽略了更重要的政治问题：即使上帝存在，祂有何权利统治人类？论文主张创造者的权力不等于道德权威，通过对宇宙的"法证审计"发现，如果存在创造者，祂未能达到合法治理的基本标准，因此人类应宣布独立，基于同理心和理性建立伦理生活。
AI.research_question: 即使上帝存在，祂有何道德权利统治人类？创造者的权力是否赋予其道德权威来命令我们的私人思想或要求我们的崇拜？
AI.motivation: 许多人在宗教的僵化教条和无神论的冷漠沉默之间感到迷失（被称为"哲学孤儿"）。人类几个世纪以来一直陷入"上帝是否存在"的垂直辩论，而忽略了更重要的政治问题：统治的合法性基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 权力与权威的区分理论：创造者的权力不等于道德权威；2. 合法治理理论：基于宇宙中的苦难、结构缺陷和无限威胁来评估创造者的治理合法性；3. 政治哲学中的统治权利理论。
AI.method: 对宇宙进行"法证审计"，分析其中的苦难、结构缺陷和无限威胁，以此评估假设存在的创造者的治理表现是否符合合法治理的基本标准。
AI.findings: 通过对宇宙的法证审计发现，如果存在创造者，祂未能达到合法治理的基本标准。宇宙中存在巨大的苦难、结构缺陷和无限威胁，这表明创造者（如果存在）的治理是失败的。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将神学辩论从"是否存在"转向"统治合法性"的政治哲学框架；2. 提出"省略主义"作为宗教教条和无神论之间的第三条道路；3. 发展了对创造者权力的道德权威批判理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为"哲学孤儿"群体提供精神出路；2. 提供建立有意义伦理生活的实践指南；3. 促进人类从恐惧的臣民向负责任的公民转变；4. 倡导基于同理心和理性的自我治理模式。

title: Concentrated Liquidity as Exotic Options: Optimal Range Selection and Dynamic Hedging in Automated Market Makers

detail.title: Concentrated Liquidity as Exotic Options: Optimal Range Selection and Dynamic Hedging in Automated Market Makers
detail.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive options-theoretic framework for analyzing concentrated liquidity positions in automated market makers (AMMs), with particular focus on Uniswap v3. We establish that a concentrated liquidity provider (LP) position within a specified price range is mathematically equivalent to a portfolio comprising the underlying asset and a short position in a perpetual power straddle with barrier features. We derive closed-form expressions for the Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega) of LP positions and characterize the distribution of impermanent loss under geometric Brownian motion. Our main contribution is the derivation of an optimal range selection rule under mean-variance preferences, providing explicit formulas for the optimal lower and upper bounds as functions of volatility, fee tier, risk aversion, and investment horizon. We further develop a dynamic hedging strategy that allows LPs to neutralize directional exposure while retaining fee income. Comparative statics reveal that optimal ranges contract with increasing volatility and expand with higher fee tiers, consistent with economic intuition. Extensions to jump-diffusion and stochastic volatility environments are provided. Our theoretical framework offers practical guidance for liquidity providers seeking to optimize capital efficiency in decentralized exchanges.

AI.tldr: 本文为自动做市商（AMMs）中的集中流动性头寸提供了一个全面的期权理论框架，特别关注Uniswap v3。研究发现，特定价格范围内的集中流动性提供者（LP）头寸在数学上等同于包含基础资产和具有障碍特征的永续幂跨式期权空头头寸的投资组合。作者推导了LP头寸的希腊字母（Delta、Gamma、Theta、Vega）的闭式表达式，并在几何布朗运动下描述了无常损失的分布。主要贡献是推导了均值-方差偏好下的最优范围选择规则，提供了最优上下界作为波动率、费用层级、风险厌恶和投资期限函数的显式公式。
AI.research_question: 如何为自动做市商中的集中流动性头寸建立期权理论框架？如何推导集中流动性提供者头寸的最优范围选择规则？如何开发动态对冲策略来消除方向性风险同时保留费用收入？
AI.motivation: 随着Uniswap v3等集中流动性AMMs的出现，流动性提供者需要更精细的工具来管理风险和优化资本效率。现有研究缺乏对集中流动性头寸的全面理论框架，特别是从期权理论角度分析其风险特征和最优策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期权定价理论、金融工程、自动做市商理论、集中流动性模型、均值-方差投资组合理论、几何布朗运动、随机过程理论
AI.method: 数学建模和理论推导：1）建立集中流动性头寸与期权投资组合的等价关系；2）推导LP头寸的希腊字母闭式表达式；3）在几何布朗运动下分析无常损失分布；4）推导均值-方差偏好下的最优范围选择规则；5）开发动态对冲策略；6）扩展到跳跃扩散和随机波动率环境
AI.findings: 1）集中流动性LP头寸等价于基础资产多头加上永续幂跨式期权空头；2）推导了Delta、Gamma、Theta、Vega的闭式表达式；3）最优范围随波动率增加而收缩，随费用层级提高而扩大；4）动态对冲策略可以有效消除方向性风险；5）理论框架可扩展到更复杂的市场环境
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次为集中流动性AMMs建立了全面的期权理论框架；2）揭示了LP头寸与期权投资组合的数学等价性；3）推导了最优范围选择的显式公式；4）扩展了传统AMMs理论到集中流动性环境；5）为无常损失分析提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为流动性提供者提供了优化资本效率的实用指导；2）提供了计算最优流动性范围的具体公式；3）开发了可操作的对冲策略来管理风险；4）帮助LP在波动性和费用层级之间做出权衡决策；5）为去中心化交易所的流动性管理提供了理论支持

title: Beyond Terrestrial Limits: Japan's Orbital Solar Transmission Test and the Emergence of Post-Planetary Energy Systems

detail.title: Beyond Terrestrial Limits: Japan's Orbital Solar Transmission Test and the Emergence of Post-Planetary Energy Systems
detail.abstract: Japan's 2025 demonstration of wireless power transmission from space marks a pivotal moment in the evolution of global energy systems. For the first time, a satellite in low Earth orbit successfully collected solar energy, converted it into microwave radiation, and transmitted it to a terrestrial receiver where it was reconverted into usable electricity. This essay examines the demonstration as a civilizational inflection point, confirming the technical feasibility of space-based solar power (SBSP) and opening pathways toward scalable orbital energy infrastructure. The analysis explores the physics of microwave transmission, the economic logic of scaling orbital arrays, the safety and governance frameworks required for global deployment, and the broader implications for planetary resilience and long-horizon civilizational engineering. Japan's achievement is interpreted as the first operational step toward post-terrestrial energy abundance and the billion-year frontier of human development.

AI.tldr: 日本2025年太空无线电力传输演示标志着全球能源系统演变的转折点，首次实现低轨道卫星收集太阳能、转换为微波辐射并传输到地面接收站重新转换为可用电力，验证了太空太阳能发电的技术可行性。
AI.research_question: 日本2025年太空无线电力传输演示如何作为文明转折点，确认太空太阳能发电的技术可行性，并为可扩展的轨道能源基础设施开辟道路？
AI.motivation: 太空太阳能发电具有解决地球能源危机、实现能源可持续性的潜力，但此前技术可行性未经验证。日本2025年的演示首次成功展示了从太空到地面的完整电力传输过程，为这一领域提供了关键的实证基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 太空太阳能发电理论、微波传输物理学、轨道能源基础设施经济学、全球部署的安全与治理框架、行星韧性理论、长期文明工程学。
AI.method: 分析日本2025年演示的技术细节，探讨微波传输的物理原理，评估轨道阵列规模化的经济逻辑，研究全球部署所需的安全和治理框架，并考察其对行星韧性和长期文明发展的影响。
AI.findings: 日本演示成功验证了太空太阳能发电的技术可行性，展示了从太空到地面的完整电力传输链。微波传输技术有效，轨道能源基础设施具有经济规模化潜力，但需要建立全球安全和治理框架。这标志着人类向太空能源获取迈出了关键一步。
AI.theory_contributions: 为太空太阳能发电理论提供了实证支持，发展了微波传输物理学在太空能源应用中的理论框架，提出了轨道能源基础设施的经济学模型，建立了太空能源全球治理的理论基础，拓展了行星韧性和长期文明工程学的理论视野。
AI.practical_contributions: 为太空太阳能发电的商业化提供了技术验证，为轨道能源基础设施的规模化部署提供了实践指导，为全球太空能源治理框架的建立提供了参考，为实现后地球能源丰裕和人类长期发展开辟了实践路径。

title: As US Food Aid Retreats, can BRICS+ and Biotechnology Fill the World’s Food Security Gap?
affiliations: Korbel School of International Studies, University of Denver

detail.title: As US Food Aid Retreats, can BRICS+ and Biotechnology Fill the World’s Food Security Gap?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Peterson Institute for International Economics Policy Brief 26-4
publicationDetails.journalName: Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Cuts to agricultural development assistance and food aid by the United States and other advanced economies are creating a global vacuum just as climate change and conflict drive global hunger up. Many food-insecure developing economies with significant hunger lack the resources to self-finance agricultural research and development (R&D) and have had to depend increasingly on themselves—and one another—to meet rising food needs. Hendrix argues that the BRICS+ economies—Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, the United Arab Emirates, and Indonesia—are well positioned to fill the world’s food security gap.

Key Takeaways
For BRICS+, the stakes are existential because hunger and climate vulnerability are clear domestic challenges, not distant risks. Investments in climate-resilient, regionally adapted crop research would provide self-insurance and also help stabilize neighboring fragile states, where food insecurity drives migration.

The returns to investments will be greatest if they are accompanied by science-based regulatory reforms. Governments of economies wary of biotechnology should educate the public and reform regulations to reap the benefits of advanced agricultural technologies.

BRICS+ have the scientific know-how, institutional capacity, and capital to underwrite a massive increase in public agricultural R&D funding. Doing so would be an opportunity to demonstrate that they are capable of providing global leadership.

AI.tldr: 美国等发达国家削减农业援助和粮食援助，而气候变化和冲突加剧全球饥饿，BRICS+国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国、南非、埃及、埃塞俄比亚、伊朗、阿联酋、印尼）有能力填补全球粮食安全缺口。
AI.research_question: BRICS+国家如何填补全球粮食安全缺口，应对气候变化和冲突带来的饥饿挑战？
AI.motivation: 发达国家削减农业援助和粮食援助，而气候变化和冲突加剧全球饥饿，许多粮食不安全的发展中国家缺乏自筹农业研发资金的能力，需要依赖自身和彼此合作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球粮食安全治理理论、南南合作理论、农业研发投资回报理论、气候适应农业理论
AI.method: 政策分析、案例研究（BRICS+国家）、文献综述、投资回报分析
AI.findings: BRICS+国家具备填补全球粮食安全缺口的条件：1）饥饿和气候脆弱性是国内挑战而非遥远风险；2）投资气候适应型作物研究可提供自我保险并稳定邻国；3）科学监管改革能最大化投资回报；4）拥有科学知识、机构能力和资本支持大规模农业研发。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了南南合作在粮食安全领域的理论框架；2）提出了BRICS+国家作为全球粮食安全治理新主体的理论视角；3）发展了气候适应型农业投资与区域稳定的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为BRICS+国家提供具体的农业研发投资策略；2）建议科学监管改革以利用先进农业技术；3）为发展中国家提供粮食安全合作模式；4）展示BRICS+国家全球领导力机会。

title: Machine Learning-Enhanced GIS for Predictive Disaster Risk Analytics

detail.title: Machine Learning-Enhanced GIS for Predictive Disaster Risk Analytics
detail.abstract: This study explores the integration of machine learning (ML) with geographic information systems (GIS) to enhance predictive disaster risk analytics. The research employs GIS-based spatial analysis in combination with advanced ML models, including AutoML and deep learning algorithms, to assess and predict risks associated with floods, landslides, and wildfires. By leveraging historical hazard data, environmental parameters, and socioeconomic indicators, the integrated framework enables high-resolution risk mapping and scenario simulation. Key findings indicate that ML-enhanced GIS models significantly improve prediction accuracy compared to conventional methods, optimize resource allocation, and reduce emergency response times in multi-hazard scenarios (Gao et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2024). Moreover, the approach demonstrates scalability across different geographic regions and hazard types, providing decision-makers with actionable insights for proactive disaster management. The study concludes that the fusion of ML and GIS constitutes a robust and adaptable framework capable of supporting anticipatory planning, risk mitigation, and evidence-based policy development in disaster-prone areas (Thangamayan et al., 2024). These findings underscore the potential of data-driven, intelligent spatial analytics to transform conventional disaster management strategies into proactive, precision-oriented interventions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索机器学习与地理信息系统结合，通过AutoML和深度学习算法提升洪水、滑坡和野火等灾害风险预测精度，实现高分辨率风险制图和场景模拟，为灾害管理提供数据驱动的智能决策支持。
AI.research_question: 机器学习与地理信息系统如何整合以提升多灾害风险预测的准确性和实用性？
AI.motivation: 传统灾害管理方法预测精度有限，响应时间较长，需要更智能、数据驱动的空间分析框架来支持主动式灾害风险管理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间分析理论、机器学习理论（特别是AutoML和深度学习算法）以及灾害风险管理理论的整合框架。
AI.method: 采用GIS空间分析与先进ML模型（AutoML和深度学习算法）相结合的方法，利用历史灾害数据、环境参数和社会经济指标进行风险评估和预测。
AI.findings: ML增强的GIS模型相比传统方法显著提升预测精度，优化资源配置，缩短应急响应时间，且具有跨地理区域和灾害类型的可扩展性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了ML与GIS融合的理论框架，扩展了智能空间分析在灾害管理领域的理论边界，为数据驱动的灾害风险管理提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为决策者提供可操作的风险洞察，支持主动式灾害规划、风险缓解和基于证据的政策制定，能够转化为实际应用的灾害管理工具。

title: Meaning, Passion Health™, and Performance: A Multidimensional Framework for Sustainable Human Performance

detail.title: Meaning, Passion Health™, and Performance: A Multidimensional Framework for Sustainable Human Performance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study, as it is a conceptual and integrative analysis that did not involve new data collection from human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Decades of research across psychology, organizational behavior, and neuroscience indicate that sustained human performance cannot be explained by pressure, incentives, or effort alone. While such factors may generate short-term output, they are consistently associated with long-term declines in engagement, wellbeing, and performance sustainability. Increasingly, research suggests that meaning plays a central role in regulating how individuals engage with work, persist through challenge, and sustain performance over time. This paper presents an integrative framework that conceptualizes meaning as a multidimensional, functional system arising from the interaction of internal inclination, perceived significance, and personal preference. Drawing on established research in self-determination theory, work engagement, harmonious passion, psychological safety, and job design, the paper synthesizes fragmented literatures into a coherent model of meaning as a regulatory mechanism for human performance. The framework is further grounded by findings from the Passion Health™ Study, an applied mixed-methods research initiative involving 2,170 respondents across professional and educational contexts. Directional associations observed between multidimensional conditions of passion, engagement, and performance provide empirical support for the proposed model. By reframing meaning as a diagnosable and operational construct rather than an abstract ideal, this paper offers a practical architecture for understanding performance degradation, burnout, and disengagement. Implications for organizational design, leadership, and future research are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个整合框架，将意义概念化为一个多维功能系统，源于内在倾向、感知意义和个人偏好的相互作用。该框架将意义重新定义为可诊断和可操作的结构，而非抽象理想，为理解绩效退化、倦怠和脱离提供了实用架构。
AI.research_question: 意义如何作为人类绩效的调节机制发挥作用？意义的多维条件如何影响激情、投入和绩效之间的关联？
AI.motivation: 数十年的研究表明，压力、激励或努力本身无法解释持续的人类绩效。这些因素可能产生短期产出，但长期来看会导致投入度、幸福感和绩效可持续性下降。意义在调节个体如何参与工作、坚持面对挑战和维持长期绩效方面发挥着核心作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我决定理论、工作投入理论、和谐激情理论、心理安全理论和职位设计理论。论文将这些分散的文献整合成一个连贯的意义作为人类绩效调节机制的模型。
AI.method: 应用混合方法研究，包括Passion Health™研究，涉及2,170名来自专业和教育背景的受访者。通过观察激情、投入和绩效的多维条件之间的方向性关联来提供实证支持。
AI.findings: 观察到激情、投入和绩效的多维条件之间存在方向性关联，为提出的模型提供了实证支持。意义被证明是一个可诊断和可操作的结构，能够解释绩效退化、倦怠和脱离现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个整合框架，将意义概念化为多维功能系统；2. 将分散的文献整合成意义作为人类绩效调节机制的连贯模型；3. 将意义重新定义为可诊断和可操作的结构而非抽象理想；4. 建立了意义与激情、投入和绩效之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解绩效退化、倦怠和脱离提供了实用架构；2. 为组织设计提供指导；3. 为领导力实践提供启示；4. 为诊断和改善工作意义提供操作框架；5. 为未来研究指明方向。

title: MIT AgeLab Delayed Digit Recall Task (n-back)
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Transportation & Logistics and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Transportation & Logistics

detail.title: MIT AgeLab Delayed Digit Recall Task (n-back)

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper No. 2011/018
publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This document describes both subject training and the experimental administration of the auditory presentation-verbal response delayed digit recall task (n-back) used by the MIT AgeLab in a series of simulation and on-road driving studies. The full stimulus item set, training materials and instructions are provided to assist other researchers who are interested in using the task and methodology in other work.

AI.tldr: 本文描述了MIT AgeLab在模拟和实际道路驾驶研究中使用的听觉呈现-口头反应延迟数字回忆任务（n-back）的培训材料和实验管理方法，为其他研究者提供完整的刺激项目集、培训材料和指导说明。
AI.research_question: 如何有效实施听觉呈现-口头反应延迟数字回忆任务（n-back）用于驾驶研究？
AI.motivation: 为其他研究者提供标准化的n-back任务实施方法，促进驾驶认知负荷研究的可重复性和一致性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作记忆理论，特别是n-back任务作为认知负荷和工作记忆能力的测量工具。
AI.method: 详细描述了听觉呈现-口头反应延迟数字回忆任务（n-back）的培训程序、刺激材料、实验管理和实施步骤。
AI.findings: 提供了完整的任务实施框架，包括刺激项目集、培训材料和详细指导，使其他研究者能够复制该研究方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 标准化了n-back任务在驾驶研究中的应用，为认知负荷测量提供了可重复的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了可直接使用的实验材料和方法指导，降低了实施n-back任务的技术门槛，促进了驾驶认知研究的发展。

title: The Generative Theory of the Sensation-Behavior Cycle: A New Paradigm of Life Empiricism

detail.title: The Generative Theory of the Sensation-Behavior Cycle: A New Paradigm of Life Empiricism
detail.abstract: Contemporary mind science has reached an impasse over the "hard prob-lem" of consciousness, facing the predicament of data-rich yet theoreti-cally fragmented. This paper proposes the "Generative Theory of the Sensation-Behavior Cycle," achieving a fundamental paradigm shift: from abstract speculation about "consciousness" to the study of life itself as a generative process of the "Youjue System." The theory takes the Sensation-Behavior Cycle as its basic unit and Value-Dependent Selec-tion as its core mechanism, constructing the Three-Dimensional Dy-namic Taxonomy of Youjue Sensation to systematically explicate the emergent path of mind from the Vital Stratum, Social Stratum to Noet-ic Stratum, and revealing the unified generative logic running through all strata ── "Resonance-Evaluation-Consolidation." Based on this, the paper thoroughly reconstructs core concepts such as memory, cogni-tion, need, emotion, consciousness, self, and will from a generativist per-spective, and creatively reinterprets classic research. More importantly, the paper explicitly elaborates on the methodological revolution of "Life Empiricism" ── grounding itself in irreducible first-person facts, tak-ing subject-internalization and change as the criterion of validation, and regarding traditional scientific data as corroborative traces of the subject's state. This theory aims to provide a powerful meta-theoretical framework for life science, achieving seamless interpretation from neural activity to civilizational structure, and opening new integrated paths for mind re-search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"生成性感觉-行为循环理论"，将意识研究从抽象思辨转向生命本身的生成过程研究，以感觉-行为循环为基本单位，价值依赖选择为核心机制，构建三维动态感觉分类体系，揭示从生命层、社会层到理智层的心智涌现路径，并基于"生命实证主义"方法论重构核心概念。
AI.research_question: 如何超越当代心智科学在意识"难题"上的困境，为心智研究提供一个统一的生成性理论框架？
AI.motivation: 当代心智科学面临数据丰富但理论碎片化的困境，在意识"难题"上陷入僵局，需要根本性的范式转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成性感觉-行为循环理论，以感觉-行为循环为基本单位，价值依赖选择为核心机制，构建三维动态感觉分类体系，揭示"共振-评估-巩固"的统一生成逻辑。
AI.method: 生命实证主义方法论：立足不可还原的第一人称事实，以主体内化和变化为验证标准，将传统科学数据视为主体状态的佐证痕迹。
AI.findings: 系统阐明了心智从生命层、社会层到理智层的涌现路径，揭示了贯穿所有层次的统一生成逻辑"共振-评估-巩固"。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 实现从"意识"抽象思辨到生命生成过程研究的范式转变；2) 构建统一的心智生成理论框架；3) 重构记忆、认知、需求、情感、意识、自我、意志等核心概念；4) 提出生命实证主义方法论革命。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生命科学提供强大的元理论框架，实现从神经活动到文明结构的无缝解释，为心智研究开辟新的整合路径。

title: Evaluating the Role of GIS Dashboards in Real-Time Crisis Management

detail.title: Evaluating the Role of GIS Dashboards in Real-Time Crisis Management
detail.abstract: Rapid urbanization, the increasing frequency of natural disasters, and the growing complexity of emergency response have created a critical need for effective crisis management tools (Damaševičius et al., 2023). This study evaluates the effectiveness of Geographic Information System (GIS) dashboards in supporting real-time decision-making during emergencies (Han & Choi, 2024). Employing a mixed-methods approach, the research integrates case studies, system evaluations, and quantitative analyses of response times and decision accuracy. Findings indicate that GIS dashboards significantly enhance situational awareness, streamline communication, and reduce response times, thereby improving coordination among multiple stakeholders (Bond, 2024; Villani et al., 2023). However, the study also highlights that the benefits of such dashboards are contingent on factors including the accuracy and timeliness of data, user training, and seamless integration with existing emergency management systems. These insights underscore the potential of GIS dashboards to strengthen real-time crisis response while emphasizing the need for careful implementation and ongoing evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了GIS仪表板在紧急情况下支持实时决策的有效性，发现其能显著提升态势感知、简化沟通并缩短响应时间，但效果取决于数据准确性、用户培训和系统集成等因素。
AI.research_question: 地理信息系统(GIS)仪表板在紧急情况下支持实时决策的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 快速城市化、自然灾害频发以及应急响应复杂性增加，对有效的危机管理工具产生了迫切需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于危机管理理论、实时决策支持系统和地理信息系统理论，探讨GIS仪表板如何增强应急响应能力。
AI.method: 采用混合方法，整合案例研究、系统评估以及响应时间和决策准确性的定量分析。
AI.findings: GIS仪表板显著增强态势感知、简化沟通并减少响应时间，从而改善多方利益相关者之间的协调。但效果取决于数据准确性、及时性、用户培训以及与现有应急管理系统的无缝集成。
AI.theory_contributions: 为危机管理和实时决策支持系统理论提供了实证支持，明确了GIS仪表板在应急响应中的理论机制和边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应急管理机构提供了GIS仪表板实施的实用指导，强调了数据质量、用户培训和系统集成的重要性，有助于提升实际应急响应效率。

title: Geospatial Analysis of Resource Allocation Efficiency in Emergency Services

detail.title: Geospatial Analysis of Resource Allocation Efficiency in Emergency Services
detail.abstract:
Emergency service systems increasingly face challenges related to inefficient resource allocation, delayed response times, and unequal service coverage, particularly across diverse urban and rural contexts. These challenges are exacerbated by population growth, spatial expansion of cities, and rising demand for emergency care. In response, geospatial analytics and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) have emerged as critical tools for enhancing evidence-based decision-making in emergency management (Park, Kwon, and Azam; Mansourihanis et al.). Despite growing adoption, empirical assessments of how advanced GIS techniques improve response efficiency and equity remain limited.
This study applies GIS-based spatial analysis, accessibility modeling, and comparative evaluation techniques to assess emergency response coverage and resource distribution across heterogeneous geographic settings. Using network analysis, service area modeling, and spatial equity metrics, the study evaluates baseline emergency service performance and compares it with scenarios incorporating advanced GIS workflows and Next Generation 911 (NG911) data integration (Alamri; He et al.).
The findings reveal pronounced spatial inequalities in emergency service accessibility, with significant urban–rural disparities in response coverage and travel times. Rural and peri-urban areas consistently exhibit reduced access to timely emergency care. However, results demonstrate measurable improvements in coverage, routing accuracy, and situational awareness when advanced GIS methods and NG911 datasets are integrated, including enhanced indoor routing and more precise incident location identification (Access to Emergency Care in Rural Illinois; Indoor Routing for School Emergencies). 
The study concludes that geospatial decision support systems play a vital role in improving emergency response efficiency and promoting equity in service provision. Strategic investment in interactive GIS platforms and targeted training can substantially strengthen emergency management outcomes (Designing and Evaluating Interactive Web Maps; Measuring the Impact of Targeted GIS Training).

AI.tldr: 本研究应用GIS空间分析、可达性建模和比较评估技术，评估了异质地理环境下的应急响应覆盖和资源分配。研究发现应急服务存在显著的空间不平等，城乡差距明显，但集成先进GIS方法和NG911数据可以改善覆盖范围、路线准确性和态势感知。
AI.research_question: 先进的GIS技术和NG911数据集成如何改善应急响应效率和公平性？
AI.motivation: 应急服务系统面临资源分配低效、响应时间延迟和服务覆盖不平等的问题，特别是在城乡差异背景下。虽然GIS已成为应急管理的重要工具，但关于先进GIS技术如何改善响应效率和公平性的实证评估仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地理信息系统(GIS)理论、空间分析理论、可达性理论、空间公平理论、应急管理理论
AI.method: GIS空间分析、可达性建模、比较评估技术、网络分析、服务区建模、空间公平指标、NG911数据集成
AI.findings: 1) 应急服务可达性存在显著的空间不平等，城乡在响应覆盖和出行时间上差距明显；2) 农村和城郊地区获得及时应急护理的机会减少；3) 集成先进GIS方法和NG911数据可以改善覆盖范围、路线准确性和态势感知，包括增强室内路线规划和更精确的事件位置识别。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供了GIS技术在应急管理中应用的实证证据；2) 发展了空间公平性评估框架；3) 验证了先进GIS工作流程对应急响应效率的理论影响；4) 扩展了NG911数据集成在应急管理中的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为应急管理部门提供了改进资源分配和响应效率的具体方法；2) 展示了NG911数据集成如何增强室内路线规划和事件定位；3) 提出了投资交互式GIS平台和针对性培训的战略建议；4) 为城乡应急服务公平性提供了政策制定依据。

title: Designing Tailored Training Programs for Diverse Teams

detail.title: Designing Tailored Training Programs for Diverse Teams
detail.abstract: Modern organizations are no longer defined by uniform roles, linear career paths, or homogeneous workforces.
