Teams today are shaped by diversity across culture, geography, professional background, age, learning preferences, and cognitive styles. At the same time, the pace of technological change continues to compress the lifespan of skills, forcing organizations to rethink how learning happens at scale¹. In this context, traditional, standardized training programs increasingly fail to produce meaningful outcomes. Attendance may be high, but relevance and application often remain low.

AI.tldr: 传统标准化培训项目在现代多样化团队和快速技术变革背景下效果有限，需要重新思考规模化学习方式。
AI.research_question: 在组织日益多样化、技术变革加速的背景下，如何设计有效的规模化学习方案以替代传统标准化培训？
AI.motivation: 现代组织面临团队多样性增加（文化、地理、专业背景、年龄、学习偏好、认知风格）和技术变革加速的双重挑战，传统标准化培训项目虽然参与度高但相关性和应用性低，无法满足实际需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织学习理论、成人学习理论、多样性管理理论、技术变革与技能生命周期理论。
AI.method: 基于文献综述和案例分析的方法，探讨传统培训的局限性并提出新的学习设计框架。
AI.findings: 传统标准化培训在现代多样化组织中效果有限，需要更加个性化、情境化的学习方案来应对技术快速变革和团队多样性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了组织学习理论，提出了在多样化和快速变革环境下学习设计的新理论框架，整合了多样性管理与技能发展理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了设计有效规模化学习方案的实践指导，帮助管理者应对团队多样性和技术变革带来的学习挑战。

title: Barriers to the Formalization of SMEs and Tax Collection Impact

detail.title: Barriers to the Formalization of SMEs and Tax Collection Impact
detail.abstract:
Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) play a pivotal role in economic development, job creation, and the sustainability of national tax systems (Balogun & Rasool, 2024). Despite their significance, many SMEs operate informally, which limits their contribution to government revenue and reduces opportunities for growth. Formalization has been recognized as a critical factor in enhancing tax compliance, promoting transparency, and strengthening fiscal capacity (Chijikwa, 2024; Mehjabeen & Khan, 2024). This study adopts a multi-method approach, including multi-case study analysis, surveys, in-depth interviews with SME owners, and policy document review, to examine the challenges and drivers of SME tax compliance (Rimadhani et al., 2024). Findings indicate that SMEs face significant barriers, including limited awareness of tax obligations, high compliance costs, complex administrative procedures, and insufficient incentives for formalization (Lavic, 2023; Indrianti & Hidayati, 2024). 
The results also reveal that supportive measures, including targeted educational programs, simplified tax processes, and incentive-based formalization initiatives, can significantly improve compliance and expand the tax base. The study underscores the importance of aligning government policies with SME capacities and needs, demonstrating that strategic interventions not only enhance voluntary compliance but also contribute to broader economic development objectives (Mpofu, 2023; Balogun & Rasool, 2024). These insights provide a foundation for policymakers and tax authorities to design effective strategies that encourage SME formalization and optimize revenue generation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨中小企业税务合规的挑战与驱动因素，发现中小企业面临税务意识不足、合规成本高、行政程序复杂等障碍，而针对性教育、简化流程和激励措施能显著改善合规情况。
AI.research_question: 中小企业税务合规面临哪些挑战？哪些因素能驱动中小企业提高税务合规性？
AI.motivation: 中小企业在经济发展、就业创造和国家税收体系中扮演关键角色，但许多中小企业以非正式方式运营，限制了其对政府收入的贡献和增长机会。正规化被认为是提高税务合规、促进透明度和增强财政能力的关键因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于中小企业正规化与税务合规相关理论，包括税收合规理论、中小企业发展理论和政策干预理论。
AI.method: 采用多方法研究设计，包括多案例研究分析、问卷调查、与中小企业主的深度访谈以及政策文件审查。
AI.findings: 中小企业面临显著障碍：税务义务意识有限、合规成本高、行政程序复杂、正规化激励不足。支持性措施（针对性教育项目、简化税务流程、基于激励的正规化举措）能显著改善合规并扩大税基。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对中小企业税务合规障碍与驱动因素的理论理解，为中小企业正规化与税收合规理论提供了实证支持，拓展了政策干预与合规行为关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和税务当局设计有效策略提供基础：实施针对性教育项目、简化税务流程、制定激励性正规化举措，使政府政策与中小企业能力和需求保持一致，促进自愿合规和经济发展。

title: Guaranteed Basic Income for Transition-Age Foster Youth: A Policy Review and Economic Rationale

detail.title: Guaranteed Basic Income for Transition-Age Foster Youth: A Policy Review and Economic Rationale
detail.abstract: Transition-age foster youth in the United States face high rates of homelessness, unemployment, and mental health issues. Recently, several Guaranteed Basic Income (GBI) pilot programs have been introduced to address these problems through direct, unconditional cash support. This paper reviews five GBI pilots (2020–2025) that target youth aging out of foster care in California, New York, and Maryland. Using published evaluations, government reports, and nonprofit analyses, we summarize outcomes related to housing stability, employment, education, and mental wellbeing. Although detailed long-term data are still limited, early results indicate that GBI programs lead to noticeable improvements in youth outcomes and can reduce costs for public systems. We examine the economic reasoning for GBI through a social return on investment (SROI) perspective, discuss program features that improve fairness and effectiveness, and highlight opportunities for more thorough research and policy development. These findings present GBI as a powerful policy option deserving of further support and study.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了美国五个针对即将离开寄养系统的青少年的基本收入保障试点项目，发现这些项目能显著改善住房稳定性、就业、教育和心理健康，并通过社会投资回报视角证明其经济合理性。
AI.research_question: 基本收入保障试点项目如何影响即将离开寄养系统的青少年的住房稳定性、就业、教育和心理健康结果？
AI.motivation: 美国即将离开寄养系统的青少年面临高无家可归率、失业和心理健康问题，需要有效的政策干预来改善他们的生活状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会投资回报视角，用于分析基本收入保障项目的经济合理性。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，基于已发布的评估报告、政府文件和非营利组织分析，总结五个基本收入保障试点项目的结果。
AI.findings: 早期结果显示，基本收入保障项目能显著改善青少年的住房稳定性、就业、教育和心理健康，并可能降低公共系统的成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 从社会投资回报视角为基本收入保障项目提供了经济理论支持，证明了其作为政策工具的合理性。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了提高项目公平性和有效性的关键特征，为政策制定者提供了具体实施建议，并指出了未来研究和政策发展的方向。

title: Corporate Sustainability under Trade Protectionism: Governance Vulnerability and ESG Reallocation

detail.title: Corporate Sustainability under Trade Protectionism: Governance Vulnerability and ESG Reallocation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no relevant financial or non-financial interests to disclose.

detail.abstract: Market-based cross-border governance-through trade liberalization, investor scrutiny, and global value chain monitoring-has long played an important role in shaping firms' sustainable development practices. The recent resurgence of trade protectionism raises concerns that these external governance mechanisms may weaken, while policy uncertainty at the institutional level increases. Despite a growing literature on trade-policy uncertainty and firm behavior, evidence remains limited on how firms adjust their sustainability strategies under such regime-level shocks. This study examines firms' sustainability responses to the Section 301 tariffs imposed by the United States on Chinese products during 2018-2019. Exploiting cross-industry variation in tariff exposure and firm-level panel data from Chinese listed companies, the analysis adopts a quasi-experimental framework to explore how protectionist shocks relate to firms' environmental, social, and governance (ESG) engagement. Rather than focusing solely on aggregate ESG outcomes, the study emphasizes potential reallocation across ESG dimensions under heightened uncertainty. The analysis further explores whether differences in domestic policy environments are associated with heterogeneous sustainability responses to trade-policy shocks. By comparing institutional-oriented and market-oriented policy frameworks, the study highlights the role of policy design in shaping firms' sustainability adjustment paths under external uncertainty. Overall, the findings suggest that understanding corporate sustainability under protectionism requires attention not only to overall ESG engagement, but also to its internal composition and institutional context.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在2018-2019年美国对华301关税保护主义冲击下，中国企业如何调整其ESG（环境、社会、治理）可持续发展策略，特别关注ESG维度间的重新分配以及不同国内政策环境下的异质性反应。
AI.research_question: 在贸易保护主义冲击（如美国301关税）下，企业如何调整其可持续发展策略？这种调整在ESG不同维度间如何重新分配？国内政策环境差异如何影响企业对贸易政策冲击的可持续性反应？
AI.motivation: 贸易保护主义复兴可能削弱基于市场的跨境治理机制（如贸易自由化、投资者审查、全球价值链监控），同时制度层面的政策不确定性增加。现有文献对贸易政策不确定性与企业行为的研究较多，但关于企业在此类制度冲击下如何调整可持续发展策略的证据仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于跨境治理理论、贸易政策不确定性理论、企业可持续发展战略理论，特别关注保护主义冲击下ESG维度的重新分配机制，以及制度环境与市场导向政策框架的调节作用。
AI.method: 采用准实验框架，利用跨行业关税暴露差异和中国上市公司面板数据，分析美国301关税（2018-2019）对企业ESG参与的影响。不仅关注总体ESG结果，更强调不确定性加剧下ESG维度间的潜在重新分配。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）保护主义冲击下企业ESG策略发生调整；2）ESG不同维度间存在重新分配现象；3）国内政策环境差异导致企业对贸易政策冲击的可持续性反应存在异质性；4）制度导向与市场导向政策框架塑造了企业在外部不确定性下的可持续性调整路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）扩展了贸易政策不确定性对企业可持续发展影响的理解；2）提出了ESG维度重新分配的概念框架；3）阐明了制度环境在调节企业应对保护主义冲击中的作用；4）丰富了跨境治理理论在保护主义背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践启示：1）政策制定者需关注保护主义对企业可持续性的复杂影响；2）企业管理者应重视ESG策略在不确定性下的适应性调整；3）投资者需考虑制度环境对企业可持续性反应的影响；4）强调了政策设计在塑造企业可持续性调整路径中的重要性。

title: Housing Capital Gains across the Income Distribution
affiliations: Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE, Florida International University (FIU) - Hollo School of Real Estate and Copenhagen Business School

detail.title: Housing Capital Gains across the Income Distribution

publicationDetails.journalName: Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We show that high-income buyers earn higher capital gains on housing using detailed transaction data from Denmark. Geographic location statistically accounts for nearly all the difference, with little role for aggregate market timing, property type, or other buyer characteristics. This finding is consistent with income-based sorting, whereby higher-income households systematically sort into locations with persistently higher price growth. We test whether credit conditions shape access to locations with higher house-price growth and find no detectable change in buyer composition by income rank around major credit expansions and contractions.

AI.tldr: 高收入购房者在丹麦房产交易中获得更高资本收益，主要原因是他们选择地理位置更好的房产，而非市场时机或其他因素，这支持了收入驱动的区位分选理论。
AI.research_question: 高收入购房者为何能获得更高的房产资本收益？这种收益差异主要来自哪些因素？
AI.motivation: 理解房产市场中的不平等现象，探究高收入群体获得更高资本收益的机制，特别是区位选择在其中扮演的角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 收入驱动的区位分选理论：高收入家庭系统性地选择具有持续更高价格增长潜力的地理位置。
AI.method: 使用丹麦详细的房产交易数据进行分析，通过统计方法分解资本收益差异的来源，并检验信贷条件对区位选择的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 高收入购房者确实获得更高资本收益；2. 地理位置差异解释了几乎所有的收益差异；3. 市场时机、房产类型或其他买家特征作用很小；4. 信贷条件的扩张和收缩对按收入排名的买家构成没有可检测的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为收入驱动的区位分选理论提供了实证支持，表明地理区位是解释房产收益不平等的主要机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了房产市场不平等的主要来源，为政策制定者理解住房财富积累差异提供了重要依据，表明单纯调整信贷政策可能无法有效改变区位选择模式。

title: Governance Tension Structures in AI-Driven Socio-Technical Systems: An Eight-Dimensional Governance Tension Coordinate Framework within a Multi-Layer Learning Paradigm

detail.title: Governance Tension Structures in AI-Driven Socio-Technical Systems: An Eight-Dimensional Governance Tension Coordinate Framework within a Multi-Layer Learning Paradigm

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patients, or personal data, and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence and platform-based technologies are increasingly embedded in global urban–rural digital transformation processes, policymakers face mounting governance challenges in urban–rural digital transformation and AI governance. These challenges can no longer be adequately addressed through conventional policy coordination mechanisms alone. AI-driven platform technologies activate multiple heterogeneous governance constraints operating across different institutional time scales, thereby generating structurally cumulative tensions in decision-making processes. This study addresses a core question in urban–rural digital transformation and AI governance: how can such multidimensional tensions be systematically diagnosed in order to support a human-centred pathway of digital development? Drawing on a multi-layer learning paradigm, the paper proposes an eight-dimensional governance tension coordination framework as a diagnostic tool for analysing how AI-driven socio-technical systems exert simultaneous and irreducible pressures on urban–rural governance. The framework disaggregates governance constraints into eight analytically distinct dimensions and elucidates how these dimensions interact through mechanisms of cross-dimensional coupling. Empirical analysis of platform-driven urban–rural digital transformation in Asian countries demonstrates that digital interventions do not exert uniform effects on existing governance structures. Rather, they selectively activate particular constraint dimensions and generate differentiated patterns of tension through inter-dimensional coupling. This study develops a transferable comparative analytical framework for diagnosing governance tensions across diverse urban–rural socio-technical systems. For urban–rural digital transformation and AI governance, the framework has clear practical value: it enables policymakers to identify, prior to the escalation of conflict, which governance constraints are being activated, how they interact, and along which pathways tensions are likely to propagate. By revealing the structural nature of governance challenges in urban–rural digital contexts, this research contributes to the development of digital transformation pathways that are more resilient, inclusive, and context-sensitive.

AI.tldr: 本文针对城乡数字化转型和AI治理中的多维治理张力问题，提出了一个八维治理张力协调框架作为诊断工具，帮助政策制定者识别和协调AI驱动平台技术引发的治理约束冲突。
AI.research_question: 在城乡数字化转型和AI治理中，如何系统诊断多维治理张力以支持以人为本的数字发展路径？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能和平台技术日益嵌入全球城乡数字化转型过程，政策制定者面临日益严峻的治理挑战。这些挑战无法仅通过传统的政策协调机制充分解决，因为AI驱动的平台技术激活了跨不同制度时间尺度的多重异质治理约束，在决策过程中产生结构性累积张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层学习范式；八维治理张力协调框架；跨维度耦合机制
AI.method: 提出八维治理张力协调框架作为诊断工具；对亚洲国家平台驱动的城乡数字化转型进行实证分析
AI.findings: 数字干预对现有治理结构的影响并非均匀一致，而是选择性地激活特定约束维度，并通过跨维度耦合产生差异化的张力模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一个可转移的比较分析框架，用于诊断不同城乡社会技术系统中的治理张力；揭示了城乡数字背景下治理挑战的结构性本质
AI.practical_contributions: 框架具有明确的实践价值：使政策制定者能够在冲突升级前识别哪些治理约束被激活、它们如何相互作用以及张力可能沿哪些路径传播；有助于发展更具韧性、包容性和情境敏感性的数字化转型路径

title: Predicting Law of Property Act Receivership: Evidence from UK Companies House Charge Data

detail.title: Predicting Law of Property Act Receivership: Evidence from UK Companies House Charge Data
detail.abstract: This study develops and validates a predictive model for Law of Property Act (LPA) receivership appointment using publicly available UK Companies House charge registration data. While existing corporate distress prediction literature focuses predominantly on general insolvency outcomes, secured creditor enforcement through receivership represents a distinct legal and commercial pathway with different predictive characteristics. Analysing 398,750 UK companies with registered charges over a five-year period, we examine whether charge registration patterns, creditor composition, and security structure characteristics can predict subsequent LPA receiver appointments. We classify 510 unique creditor name patterns into 14 categories, enabling granular analysis of creditor type as a predictive feature. Our principal finding is that companies with Qualifying Floating Charge Holders (QFCHs) are 3.5 times more likely to experience receiver appointment than companies with other charge structures (χ² = 1,222, p < 0.0001). This substantially outperforms the model's predictive power for Creditors' Voluntary Liquidation (CVL), where the same features yield only 1.25x lift, confirming that receivership and general insolvency represent distinct outcome populations. Secondary findings reveal significant creditor-type effects: companies with challenger bank or specialist buy-to-let lender exposure exhibit 8.4% distress rates, representing 2.95x the baseline. Geographic concentration patterns identify elevated receivership risk in specific regions, with certain postcodes showing distress rates exceeding 15%. These findings have practical implications for secured lenders conducting portfolio stress testing, insolvency practitioners identifying appointment opportunities, and creditors assessing recovery prospects. The methodology demonstrates that charge registration data, freely available from Companies House, contains substantial predictive signal for secured creditor enforcement outcomes that is not captured by conventional credit scoring approaches.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用英国公司注册处的抵押登记数据，开发并验证了财产法（LPA）接管人任命的预测模型。研究发现，拥有合格浮动抵押持有人（QFCHs）的公司被任命接管人的可能性是其他抵押结构公司的3.5倍，且接管人与一般破产是不同的结果群体。
AI.research_question: 抵押登记模式、债权人构成和担保结构特征能否预测后续的LPA接管人任命？
AI.motivation: 现有企业困境预测文献主要关注一般破产结果，但通过接管人进行的担保债权人执行代表了一条独特的法律和商业路径，具有不同的预测特征，需要专门研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于担保债权人执行理论、企业困境预测理论和抵押登记数据分析框架，强调接管人与一般破产的区别。
AI.method: 分析398,750家英国公司在五年期间的抵押登记数据，将510个独特的债权人名称模式分类为14个类别，使用统计方法（包括卡方检验）评估预测能力。
AI.findings: 1. 拥有QFCHs的公司被任命接管人的可能性是其他公司的3.5倍；2. 挑战者银行或专业购房出租贷款机构的公司困境率为8.4%，是基线的2.95倍；3. 特定地区的接管风险较高，某些邮编的困境率超过15%；4. 接管人与债权人自愿清算（CVL）是不同的结果群体。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统性地将抵押登记数据用于预测担保债权人执行结果；2. 证明了接管人与一般破产是不同的结果群体；3. 建立了债权人类型分类框架；4. 扩展了企业困境预测理论到担保执行领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为担保贷款人提供投资组合压力测试工具；2. 帮助破产从业者识别任命机会；3. 协助债权人评估回收前景；4. 证明免费的公司注册处数据包含传统信用评分方法未捕捉的预测信号。

title: SMEs' Perception of Tax Fairness and Its Effect on Compliance

detail.title: SMEs' Perception of Tax Fairness and Its Effect on Compliance
detail.abstract: This study presents a comparative analysis of payroll taxation policies across developed and developing countries, focusing on their design, compliance, and economic implications for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). Employing a mixed-method approach, the research integrates an extensive literature review, secondary data analysis, and case study comparisons to examine how different jurisdictions implement and enforce payroll tax regimes. Key findings reveal significant variations in compliance rates, enforcement mechanisms, and the administrative burden placed on SMEs. Developed countries typically exhibit higher levels of automation, transparency, and taxpayer support, resulting in improved compliance and lower administrative costs. In contrast, developing countries often face challenges related to limited administrative capacity, weaker enforcement, and lower taxpayer awareness, which collectively hinder effective tax collection and compliance. The study underscores that the effectiveness of payroll tax systems is not solely determined by statutory rates but heavily relies on robust administration, transparent procedures, and continuous taxpayer education. These insights suggest that policy reforms aimed at strengthening institutional capacity, simplifying tax processes, and enhancing awareness programs can improve compliance and reduce economic distortions, particularly for SMEs. The findings contribute to the broader understanding of payroll taxation as a critical component of fiscal policy and provide guidance for governments seeking to optimize tax collection while supporting business growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了发达国家和发展中国家的工资税政策，重点关注其对中小企业的影响，发现税收系统的有效性不仅取决于税率，更依赖于行政能力、透明度和纳税人教育。
AI.research_question: 发达国家和发展中国家在工资税政策设计、合规性和经济影响方面存在哪些差异？这些差异如何影响中小企业的运营和合规行为？
AI.motivation: 工资税是财政政策的重要组成部分，但对中小企业影响显著。理解不同国家在工资税政策实施、合规性和行政负担方面的差异，有助于优化税收政策，支持企业发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收合规理论、制度经济学、财政政策理论、中小企业发展理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：包括广泛的文献综述、二手数据分析、案例比较研究
AI.findings:
1. 发达国家自动化程度高、透明度好、纳税人支持完善，合规率较高，行政成本较低
2. 发展中国家面临行政能力有限、执法薄弱、纳税人意识不足等挑战，影响税收征管和合规
3. 工资税系统的有效性不仅取决于法定税率，更依赖于健全的行政管理、透明程序和持续的纳税人教育
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了税收合规理论，强调制度能力对税收政策实施的重要性
2. 深化了对工资税作为财政政策关键组成部分的理解
3. 为比较税收政策研究提供了实证基础
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政府提供政策建议：加强制度能力、简化税收流程、增强纳税人教育
2. 帮助优化税收征管，减少经济扭曲，特别是对中小企业
3. 为寻求优化税收征管同时支持企业增长的政府提供指导

title:
Design Implications of Foundation Depth Theory: 
Exit Architecture and Legitimation Dynamics

detail.title:
Design Implications of Foundation Depth Theory: 
Exit Architecture and Legitimation Dynamics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Background. Foundation Depth theory establishes that coordination systems depend on five trust layers
(Physical, Mathematical, Protocol, Institutional, Social), that all systems retain irreducible social
components, and that foundation depth trades off with adaptability. What follows for system design remains
unexplored.
Objective. This paper derives design principles from Foundation Depth theory through structured
argumentation, making explicit the inferential steps from theoretical propositions to practical implications.
Results. We derive two principles. First, Graduated Exit Architecture: systems should provide five levels of
adaptation (framing, interpretation, usage, layer, system) before users must exit entirely. This extends
Hirschman's binary Exit/Voice framework. Second, Release-Valve Coupling: the interpretive layer
simultaneously absorbs discrepancy and maintains functional legitimacy; these functions are mutually
enabling. Investment in narrative infrastructure is structural, not cosmetic.
Method. Structured argumentation from stated premises, with explicit paradigmatic commitments,
disciplinary boundaries, and self-application identifying structural blind spots.
Contribution. Testable design principles with operationalized predictions and falsification conditions,
bridging theory to empirical research programs.

AI.tldr: 该论文从基础深度理论推导出两个系统设计原则：分级退出架构（提供五个适应层级）和释放阀耦合（解释层同时吸收差异并维持功能合法性），为理论到实践搭建桥梁。
AI.research_question: 从基础深度理论可以推导出哪些系统设计原则？
AI.motivation: 基础深度理论建立了五个信任层级的协调系统框架，但该理论对系统设计的具体指导意义尚未被探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础深度理论（五个信任层：物理、数学、协议、制度、社会），赫希曼的退出/表达框架。
AI.method: 结构化论证方法，从明确的前提推导，包含范式承诺、学科边界和自我应用以识别结构性盲点。
AI.findings: 推导出两个设计原则：1) 分级退出架构：系统应在用户完全退出前提供五个适应层级（框架、解释、使用、层、系统）；2) 释放阀耦合：解释层同时吸收差异并维持功能合法性，叙事基础设施投资是结构性的而非表面性的。
AI.theory_contributions: 将赫希曼的二元退出/表达框架扩展为五级适应框架，为协调系统理论提供了可操作的设计原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可测试的设计原则，包含可操作化的预测和证伪条件，为理论到实证研究项目搭建桥梁。

title: Predictive Modeling of Environmental Hazards and Response Prioritization

detail.title: Predictive Modeling of Environmental Hazards and Response Prioritization
detail.abstract:
This study investigates the application of predictive modeling techniques for environmental hazards and the prioritization of emergency responses. Employing a combination of GIS-based analytics, machine learning models, and case studies within urban and industrial contexts (Aggarwal, 2024; GIWA & Fakokunde, 2024), the research evaluates how advanced computational tools can enhance hazard detection and emergency preparedness. Key findings indicate that AI-driven predictive models significantly improve the accuracy of hazard identification and streamline response efficiency. At the same time, GIS-based mapping effectively highlights high-risk areas, enabling targeted interventions.
The integration of these methodologies allows emergency planners to anticipate potential environmental threats, allocate resources more strategically, and minimize response delays. Overall, the study demonstrates that combining predictive analytics with comprehensive emergency planning strengthens urban and industrial resilience, mitigates environmental and social risks, and supports data-driven decision-making for disaster management (Ruan et al., 2023; Aljohani, 2023). These results underscore the value of interdisciplinary approaches in addressing complex environmental challenges and provide actionable insights for policymakers, emergency services, and urban planners seeking to enhance community safety and sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了预测建模技术在环境灾害和应急响应优先级排序中的应用，结合GIS分析、机器学习模型和案例研究，发现AI预测模型能显著提高灾害识别准确性和响应效率，GIS制图能有效识别高风险区域，这些方法的整合增强了城市和工业韧性。
AI.research_question: 预测建模技术如何应用于环境灾害评估和应急响应优先级排序？这些先进计算工具如何提升灾害检测和应急准备能力？
AI.motivation: 环境灾害对城市和工业区域构成严重威胁，需要更有效的预测和响应机制。传统方法在灾害识别准确性和响应效率方面存在局限，需要探索先进计算工具的应用潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地理信息系统(GIS)分析理论、机器学习预测模型理论、灾害风险管理理论，以及城市和工业环境韧性理论框架。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法：1) GIS空间分析技术；2) 机器学习预测模型；3) 城市和工业环境案例研究；4) 文献综述和实证分析。
AI.findings: 1) AI驱动的预测模型显著提高灾害识别准确性；2) GIS制图有效识别高风险区域，支持针对性干预；3) 方法整合使应急规划者能预测潜在威胁、优化资源配置、减少响应延迟；4) 预测分析与综合应急规划结合增强城市和工业韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 发展了环境灾害预测与应急响应的跨学科理论框架；2) 深化了GIS与机器学习在灾害管理中的整合理论；3) 丰富了城市和工业环境韧性理论；4) 推进了数据驱动决策在灾害管理中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供可操作的灾害管理见解；2) 帮助应急服务部门优化资源配置和响应策略；3) 支持城市规划者识别高风险区域并制定针对性干预措施；4) 增强社区安全和可持续发展能力；5) 为工业环境提供灾害风险评估和应急准备工具。

title: GIS-enabled Monitoring of Infrastructure Vulnerability in Urban Environments

detail.title: GIS-enabled Monitoring of Infrastructure Vulnerability in Urban Environments
detail.abstract: Urban infrastructure is increasingly vulnerable to environmental and anthropogenic hazards, necessitating the development of effective monitoring and management strategies. This study examines the application of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) for assessing infrastructure vulnerability in urban areas. Using a combination of spatial analysis, multi-criteria decision-making, and predictive modeling, the research identifies zones at heightened risk and evaluates the factors contributing to vulnerability. Results indicate that areas with dense land use, inadequate drainage, and aging infrastructure are particularly susceptible, revealing strong correlations between land use patterns and vulnerability levels (Emmanuel, 2024). Furthermore, GIS-enabled analysis provides a visual and quantitative framework that enhances the prioritization of infrastructure interventions, supporting proactive decision-making by urban planners and policymakers (Lee et al., 2024). The integration of predictive modeling with spatial data allows for scenario testing and risk forecasting, thereby improving the allocation of resources and the formulation of mitigation strategies. Overall, the findings demonstrate that GIS-based approaches offer actionable insights that are critical for strengthening urban resilience and guiding sustainable development planning. This study underscores the potential of geospatial technologies in transforming vulnerability assessment from reactive evaluation to anticipatory, data-driven urban management.

AI.tldr: 该研究应用GIS技术评估城市基础设施脆弱性，通过空间分析、多准则决策和预测建模识别高风险区域，发现土地利用密集、排水不足和基础设施老化是主要脆弱因素，为城市规划者提供数据驱动的决策支持。
AI.research_question: 地理信息系统(GIS)如何有效评估城市基础设施脆弱性，并识别高风险区域及其影响因素？
AI.motivation: 城市基础设施日益面临环境和人为灾害的威胁，需要开发有效的监测和管理策略来增强城市韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间分析理论、多准则决策理论和脆弱性评估理论，结合地理信息系统(GIS)技术框架。
AI.method: 采用空间分析、多准则决策和预测建模相结合的方法，对城市基础设施进行定量评估和风险预测。
AI.findings: 土地利用密集、排水系统不足和基础设施老化的区域脆弱性最高；土地利用模式与脆弱性水平存在强相关性；GIS分析为基础设施干预优先排序提供了可视化定量框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了GIS在脆弱性评估中的应用理论，建立了空间分析与预测建模相结合的理论框架，推动了从反应性评估向预见性城市管理的理论转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者和政策制定者提供数据驱动的决策支持工具，优化资源配置和减灾策略制定，支持可持续城市发展规划，增强城市基础设施韧性。

title: How Does Tort Reform Affect Health Care Delivery?
affiliations: University of Kentucky and University of Kentucky

detail.title: How Does Tort Reform Affect Health Care Delivery?
detail.abstract:
Health care costs in the U.S. have grown dramatically over the past several decades, with one possible cause being physicians providing unnecessary services out of fear of being sued for malpractice – a phenomenon known as “defensive medicine”. States responded by enacting different types of tort reforms. This paper reviews the literature on the effects of these tort reforms on outcomes related to malpractice risk, quantity and quality of health care services, overall utilization and expenditures, physician supply, and patient affordability. We use Google Scholar to identify papers that fall into this scope and use either associational or quasi-experimental quantitative methods. The preponderance of evidence points towards non-economic damage caps reducing malpractice risk, quantity of services (aside from diagnostics and obstetrics), and overall health care utilization and expenditures while increasing physician supply and not having detrimental effects on patient outcomes. In general, the effects of other types of tort reforms are less clear. The literature would benefit from further research utilizing recent methodological advances related to combining machine learning with causal inference and eliminating bias from heterogeneous treatment effects in staggered-treatment-time models.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了美国医疗侵权改革对医疗事故风险、医疗服务数量与质量、医疗利用与支出、医生供给及患者可负担性影响的文献。证据表明非经济损失赔偿上限能降低医疗事故风险、减少医疗服务量（诊断和产科除外）、降低总体医疗利用和支出，同时增加医生供给且不损害患者结果。其他类型侵权改革效果尚不明确。
AI.research_question: 美国各州实施的医疗侵权改革（特别是不同类型的侵权改革）对医疗事故风险、医疗服务数量与质量、医疗利用与支出、医生供给及患者可负担性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 美国医疗成本几十年来急剧增长，其中一个可能原因是医生因担心医疗事故诉讼而提供不必要的服务（即"防御性医疗"）。各州为此实施了不同类型的侵权改革，需要系统评估这些改革的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗侵权法和防御性医疗理论，探讨侵权改革如何通过改变医生的法律风险感知来影响医疗行为、医疗资源分配和医疗市场结构。
AI.method: 使用Google Scholar识别相关文献，采用关联性或准实验定量方法进行系统性文献综述，涵盖医疗事故风险、医疗服务数量与质量、医疗利用与支出、医生供给及患者可负担性等多个维度。
AI.findings: 非经济损失赔偿上限能有效降低医疗事故风险、减少医疗服务量（诊断和产科服务除外）、降低总体医疗利用和支出，同时增加医生供给且不损害患者结果。其他类型侵权改革的效果则不够明确。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了医疗侵权改革的多维度影响机制，为理解法律环境变化如何通过风险感知影响医疗行为提供了理论框架，并指出了不同类型改革效果的差异性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于非经济损失赔偿上限有效性的实证证据，建议优先考虑此类改革来控制医疗成本、增加医生供给，同时不损害患者健康结果。指出了未来研究应结合机器学习与因果推断方法。

title: Machine Learning for Market Volatility Regime Classification: A Comparative Analysis of LDA, SVM, and Neural Networks with Implications for Dynamic Asset Allocation

detail.title: Machine Learning for Market Volatility Regime Classification: A Comparative Analysis of LDA, SVM, and Neural Networks with Implications for Dynamic Asset Allocation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses exclusively publicly available, aggregated financial market data and does not involve human participants, patient data, or personal information. As such, ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This study presents a comprehensive empirical investigation comparing machine learning classification methodologies for identifying market volatility regimes, with direct applications to dynamic asset allocation strategies. Utilizing daily S&P 500 data spanning January 2000 through December 2024, encompassing 6,087 trading days across multiple market cycles, we evaluate Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), Support Vector Machines (SVM) with linear and radial basis function kernels, and feedforward neural networks within a rigorous time-series cross-validation framework. Our analysis reveals a fundamental paradox in regime classification: naive persistence forecasting achieves 92.73% overall accuracy due to substantial regime stickiness, yet catastrophically fails at regime transition points with merely 1.35% accuracy. In contrast, machine learning models demonstrate dramatically superior transition prediction, with neural networks achieving 51.35% accuracy at these critical junctures-a 38-fold improvement over persistence. This finding carries profound implications for portfolio management, as regime transitions represent precisely the moments when rebalancing decisions generate the greatest economic impact. Portfolio backtesting over the 2021-2024 out-of-sample period demonstrates that machine learningbased regime-switching strategies generate superior risk-adjusted performance. The neural network strategy achieves a Sharpe ratio of 0.768 compared to 0.634 for passive buy-and-hold allocation, representing a 21% improvement. Simultaneously, maximum portfolio drawdown decreases from 25.43% to 9.58%, a 62% reduction in downside risk. Statistical significance testing via McNemar's test and the Diebold-Mariano test confirms that model differences are highly significant, while robustness analysis validates the stability of our findings across alternative regime definitions, allocation schemes, and transaction cost assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实证比较多种机器学习分类方法（LDA、SVM、神经网络）在市场波动率区制识别中的表现，发现机器学习模型在区制转换点的预测准确性显著优于朴素持续性预测，这对动态资产配置策略具有重要实践价值。
AI.research_question: 机器学习分类方法在识别市场波动率区制方面的表现如何？这些方法在区制转换点的预测准确性是否优于传统方法？基于机器学习区制转换策略的动态资产配置能否产生更优的风险调整后收益？
AI.motivation: 市场波动率区制识别对动态资产配置至关重要，但传统方法在区制转换点预测上表现不佳。区制转换时刻正是资产配置决策产生最大经济影响的时刻，因此需要更有效的预测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场波动率区制转换理论、机器学习分类理论（线性判别分析、支持向量机、神经网络）、动态资产配置理论、投资组合风险管理理论。
AI.method: 使用2000年1月至2024年12月的标普500日度数据（6,087个交易日），在严格的时间序列交叉验证框架下，比较线性判别分析（LDA）、线性核和径向基核支持向量机（SVM）以及前馈神经网络的表现。采用McNemar检验和Diebold-Mariano检验进行统计显著性测试，并进行稳健性分析。
AI.findings: 朴素持续性预测虽然整体准确率达92.73%（由于区制粘性），但在区制转换点的准确率仅为1.35%。相比之下，机器学习模型在转换点预测上表现显著更优，神经网络达到51.35%的准确率，比持续性预测提高38倍。基于机器学习的区制转换策略在2021-2024年样本外测试中表现优异：神经网络策略夏普比率为0.768（被动买入持有策略为0.634），提升21%；最大回撤从25.43%降至9.58%，下降62%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了市场波动率区制分类中的基本悖论：高整体准确率与极低的转换点预测准确率并存。证明了机器学习方法在区制转换预测中的理论优势，特别是在捕捉非线性关系和复杂模式方面的能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资组合管理提供了有效的动态资产配置工具，能够在关键的市场转换时刻做出更准确的决策。实证表明基于机器学习的策略能显著提高风险调整后收益（夏普比率提升21%）并大幅降低下行风险（最大回撤减少62%）。为从业者提供了可操作的量化投资框架。

title: The Zeberg Macro Navigation Framework™

detail.title: The Zeberg Macro Navigation Framework™

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available, aggregate macroeconomic and financial data and does not involve human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Macroeconomic downturns are rarely recognized in real time. Despite extensive data availability and sophisticated modeling, policymakers and analysts have repeatedly failed to identify business-cycle turning points before recessions are already underway. This paper introduces the Zeberg Macro Navigation Framework™, a hierarchical, real-time macroeconomic framework designed to address this persistent failure by restoring sequencing, structure, and discipline to business-cycle interpretation.
The framework is grounded in the business cycle as the primary organizing principle and integrates three distinct but complementary analytical layers. The Business Cycle Core classifies the economy into four phases - Expansion, Slowdown, Contraction, and Recovery - using the systematic sequencing of leading, coincident, lagging, and phase-conditional imminent-recession indicators evaluated relative to a long-term growth equilibrium. A Market Structure layer, employing probabilistic multi-asset Elliott Wave analysis, interprets market behavior, trend maturity, and late-cycle overshoot without redefining the macro regime. A Global Liquidity layer treats monetary and financial conditions as conditional modifiers that influence timing and amplitude, but do not drive or prevent the cycle itself. 
The framework enforces explicit signal hierarchy, conflict resolution, and invalidation logic, avoiding the common analytical error of treating all indicators as equivalent. Historical evaluation demonstrates that the Business Cycle Core has identified all U.S. recessions without false positives and with month-level precision at the onset of contraction, including across structurally different downturns. A deliberately minimal regime-based application illustrates that correct cycle identification has first-order economic consequences, primarily through avoidance of contraction-phase exposure. 
The paper emphasizes real-time applicability, acknowledges data revisions and structural limitations, and is released as a living document with transparent versioning and governance. The framework does not claim predictive certainty; rather, it provides a falsifiable, hierarchical method for interpreting macroeconomic reality as it unfolds. Readers are invited to scrutinize, test, and challenge the framework across future cycles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Zeberg宏观导航框架，这是一个分层实时宏观经济框架，旨在解决政策制定者和分析师无法实时识别商业周期转折点的问题。该框架基于商业周期作为主要组织原则，整合了三个互补的分析层，通过恢复序列、结构和纪律来改进商业周期解释。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个分层、实时的宏观经济框架，以更准确地识别商业周期转折点，避免政策制定者和分析师在衰退已经开始后才意识到经济衰退的问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管有大量数据和复杂模型可用，政策制定者和分析师仍反复未能实时识别商业周期转折点，总是在衰退已经开始后才意识到问题。这种识别滞后导致决策失误和经济损失，需要一个新的框架来解决这一持久性失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 商业周期作为主要组织原则；2. 商业周期核心层：将经济分为扩张、放缓、收缩和复苏四个阶段；3. 市场结构层：采用概率多资产艾略特波浪分析；4. 全球流动性层：将货币和金融条件视为条件性调节因素；5. 明确信号层次、冲突解决和无效化逻辑。
AI.method: 分层框架设计方法：商业周期核心层使用领先、同步、滞后和阶段条件性即将衰退指标相对于长期增长均衡的系统序列；历史评估方法：测试框架对美国所有衰退的识别能力，包括结构不同的衰退；最小化制度应用方法：展示正确周期识别的经济后果。
AI.findings: 商业周期核心层能够识别所有美国衰退而没有误报，在收缩开始时达到月份级精度，包括跨越结构不同的衰退；正确周期识别具有一级经济后果，主要通过避免收缩阶段暴露来实现；框架强调实时适用性，承认数据修订和结构限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个分层、实时的宏观经济框架，恢复商业周期解释的序列、结构和纪律；2. 整合了三个互补的分析层，避免将所有指标视为等同的常见分析错误；3. 提供了可证伪、分层的宏观经济现实解释方法，而非声称预测确定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者和分析师提供了实时识别商业周期转折点的实用工具；2. 通过避免收缩阶段暴露，帮助减少经济决策失误和损失；3. 作为活文档发布，具有透明版本控制和治理，邀请读者在未来周期中审查、测试和挑战框架。

title: Monetary Policy & Household Consumption Inequality in India

detail.title: Monetary Policy & Household Consumption Inequality in India
detail.abstract: This study shows that conventional contractionary monetary policy shocks can reduce household consumption inequality. This study follows the modern state of the art of identifying monetary policy shocks with external instruments followed by Local Projection Instrumental Variable (LP-IV) regression to estimate the structural impulse responses of a contractionary monetary policy shock on three separate measures of household income inequality. This study estimates the Dynamic Causal Effect (DCE) of a scaled monetary policy shock on household consumption inequality measures in a fast frequency monthly data spanning over 36 months. Impulse Responses of a conventional 25 bps contractionary monetary shock show a lagged negative effect on household consumption expenditure gaps and on the consumption Gini and Theil index over the forecast horizon. The only exception is the food consumption Gini and Theil index in the rural region, which shows a lagged increase in the forecast horizon. This study shows the ex-post dynamics of household consumption inequality in response to a conventional monetary policy shock. Heterogeneous access to financial markets, heterogeneous debt holding along wth structural heterogeneity in consumption and job markets across the household groups are identified as the possible justification for this reduction in consumption inequality.

AI.tldr: 传统紧缩性货币政策冲击能够降低家庭消费不平等，主要通过金融渠道和劳动力市场异质性影响不同家庭群体
AI.research_question: 传统紧缩性货币政策冲击如何影响家庭消费不平等？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策对收入分配的影响机制，特别是消费不平等的动态响应，为政策制定提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制、家庭金融约束理论、消费不平等理论、异质性家庭模型
AI.method: 采用外部工具变量识别货币政策冲击，结合局部投影工具变量回归(LP-IV)，估计36个月高频月度数据的动态因果效应
AI.findings: 25个基点的紧缩性货币政策冲击对家庭消费支出差距、消费基尼系数和泰尔指数产生滞后负向影响；农村地区食品消费基尼系数和泰尔指数例外，呈现滞后上升
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了货币政策冲击对消费不平等的动态因果效应，识别了金融渠道和劳动力市场异质性的作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行制定货币政策时考虑分配效应提供实证依据，有助于设计更包容的货币政策框架

title: The 9 Chains Framework: An Engineering Approach to Sovereign Economics and Systemic Risk Analysis

detail.title: The 9 Chains Framework: An Engineering Approach to Sovereign Economics and Systemic Risk Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is based on theoretical analysis and strictly utilizes publicly available macroeconomic datasets (IMF, World Bank, Transparency International). No human subjects were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Traditional development economics often suffers from survivor bias, isolating individual factors such as institutional quality or human capital to explain the persistent stagnation of the Global South. This paper challenges that fragmented approach, introducing the "9 Chains Framework"-a deterministic engineering model that treats the national economy not as a philosophical concept, but as a mechanical system subject to stress and fatigue. By synthesizing institutional analysis with a novel "Dual-Filter Validation Protocol" (Cartesian Logic and Kantian Ethics), this study identifies nine critical dependencies ("Chains") that form a self-reinforcing stagnation loop. Furthermore, the paper models four derivative "Mechanisms of Decay" (e.g., The Humiliated Specialist, The Total Debt Trap) and applies the framework to forecast three impending global crises: the divergence of physical and paper assets (Gold/ETF), the resource limits of the AI bubble (Water/Energy), and the structural fatigue of the fiat currency system. This work aims to provide a quantitative "source code" for identifying state failure before it becomes irreversible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"9链条框架"，将国家经济视为机械系统而非哲学概念，识别出9个关键依赖关系形成自我强化的停滞循环，并建模4种"衰变机制"，预测3个即将到来的全球危机。
AI.research_question: 如何通过工程学模型而非传统发展经济学的碎片化方法来解释和预测全球南方的持续停滞？
AI.motivation: 传统发展经济学存在幸存者偏差，孤立分析制度质量或人力资本等单个因素，无法全面解释全球南方的持续停滞问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 9链条框架（确定性工程模型）、双重过滤验证协议（笛卡尔逻辑和康德伦理学）、衰变机制模型
AI.method: 制度分析与双重过滤验证协议（笛卡尔逻辑和康德伦理学）相结合，识别9个关键依赖关系，建模4种衰变机制
AI.findings: 识别出9个形成自我强化停滞循环的关键依赖关系，建模了4种衰变机制，预测了3个即将到来的全球危机
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将国家经济视为机械系统的工程学模型，挑战传统发展经济学的碎片化方法，提供识别国家失败的定量"源代码"

title: The Rhetorical Construction of Greed as a Basic Human Motive: A Neurocognitive Poetics Analysis of Bernard Mandeville's Fable of the Bees
affiliations: University G. d’Annunzio of Chieti-Pescara, University G. d’Annunzio of Chieti-Pescara and Independent

detail.title: The Rhetorical Construction of Greed as a Basic Human Motive: A Neurocognitive Poetics Analysis of Bernard Mandeville's Fable of the Bees

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest to declare for this study
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding

detail.abstract: This study examines Bernard Mandeville's The Fable of the Bees (1714) through a theoretically informed close reading that draws on the Neurocognitive Poetics Model of Literary Reading (NCPM). We analyze the cognitive affordances of this influential text, i.e. the potential for cognitive and emotional engagement offered by its textual features, rather than claiming direct evidence of reader processing. Using systematic qualitative coding supported by Atlas.ti software, we map the density and distribution of rhetorical devices across the poem's 433 verses, examining how Mandeville employs the beehive allegory, irony, paradox, and antithetical structures. Our analysis reveals a distinctive rhetorical architecture: high concentrations of foregrounding elements in the opening verses gradually yield to more direct social commentary before returning to metaphorical density in the closing Moral. We situate these findings within both the long history of the beehive topos in Western thought and the immediate political context of early eighteenthcentury England, suggesting that readers' prior familiarity with this allegorical tradition may have facilitated engagement with Mandeville's provocative economic arguments. By drawing on historical reception evidence and existing Mandeville scholarship, we offer a cognitive poetics perspective that complements traditional literary-historical approaches to this canonical text in the history of economic thought.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用神经认知诗学模型对曼德维尔《蜜蜂的寓言》进行理论指导下的细读分析，探讨文本的认知可供性，通过系统质性编码揭示其独特的修辞结构，并将发现置于西方蜜蜂寓言传统和18世纪早期英国政治背景中理解。
AI.research_question: 曼德维尔《蜜蜂的寓言》如何通过其文本特征（特别是修辞手法）为读者提供认知和情感参与的可能性？该文本的修辞结构如何影响读者对其经济观点的接受？
AI.motivation: 传统文学历史方法对《蜜蜂的寓言》的研究未能充分探讨文本本身的认知特征如何影响读者参与。本研究旨在通过认知诗学视角，分析文本的修辞结构如何促进读者对这一经典经济思想文本的理解和接受。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经认知诗学模型（NCPM）为理论基础，结合修辞分析、认知诗学理论和历史接受研究，探讨文本特征与认知处理之间的关系。
AI.method: 理论指导下的细读分析，使用Atlas.ti软件进行系统质性编码，对诗歌433节中的修辞手法（蜜蜂寓言、反讽、悖论、对立结构）进行密度和分布映射。
AI.findings: 发现独特的修辞结构：开头部分前景化元素密集，逐渐过渡到更直接的社会评论，结尾道德部分回归隐喻密度。读者对蜜蜂寓言传统的熟悉可能促进了对其经济观点的接受。
AI.theory_contributions: 为认知诗学领域提供实证案例，展示如何将神经认知模型应用于经典文本分析；为经济思想史研究提供新的文本分析方法；拓展修辞分析与认知科学的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为文学教学提供分析工具，帮助理解经典文本如何通过修辞策略影响读者；为跨学科研究（文学、认知科学、经济思想史）提供方法论示范；为数字人文研究中的文本分析提供参考。

detail.abstract:
<p><strong>SBCM Note #8: The Thermodynamics of Floating Fiction and Governance Engineering </strong><br>
— From "Money Game" to "Civil Computation": The G-Cart Architecture —</p>

<p><strong>Abstract:</strong><br>
This paper presents the final theorem of the Standard Block Comparison Method (SBCM), establishing <strong>"Governance Engineering"</strong> as a new discipline to bridge the thermodynamic gap between the Crypto Economy (Vacuum) and the Real Economy (Matter).</p>

<p>We classify economic trust into two states: <strong>"Entity-Pegged"</strong> (Fiat/Gold) and <strong>"Method-Pegged"</strong> (Crypto). We prove mathematically that "Speculation" is not a psychological phenomenon but the <strong>Joule Heating</strong> (Conversion Loss) generated when massless floating energy attempts to force its way through a narrow exit to the real world without impedance matching.</p>

<p>To resolve this, we propose the <strong>G-Cart Architecture</strong>, which redefines:</p>
<ul>
    <li><strong>Tokens</strong> as "Process Batches" (Industrial Signals) rather than money.</li>
    <li><strong>Municipalities</strong> as "Physical Computers" possessing Civil Computability ($C_{pot}$).</li>
    <li><strong>Gravity</strong> (Physical Distance) as the ultimate security firewall against digital exploitation.</li>
</ul>

<p>By implementing a <strong>"Work Standard"</strong> where 1 Token equals 1 Joule of physical work, and synchronizing payments with physical progress via the <strong>G-Gantt Protocol</strong>, we demonstrate a system that converts the "Greed" of the virtual world into the "Civil Infrastructure" of the physical world. This marks the end of the Money Game and the beginning of Governance Engineering.</p>

<p><strong>Key Concepts:</strong> Floating System, Joule Heating, Civil Computability, Virtual General Contractor, G-Cart.</p

AI.tldr: 本文提出了标准区块比较方法（SBCM）的最终定理，建立了"治理工程"这一新学科，以弥合加密经济（真空）与实体经济（物质）之间的热力学鸿沟。通过G-Cart架构，将代币重新定义为"过程批次"而非货币，将市政当局视为拥有公民可计算性的"物理计算机"，并提出"工作标准"（1代币=1焦耳物理功），将虚拟世界的"贪婪"转化为物理世界的"公民基础设施"。
AI.research_question: 如何弥合加密经济（真空）与实体经济（物质）之间的热力学鸿沟？如何将虚拟世界的投机能量转化为物理世界的公民基础设施？
AI.motivation: 当前加密经济与实体经济之间存在热力学鸿沟，投机行为导致能量损失（焦耳加热），需要建立新的治理工程学科来连接这两个领域，结束"金钱游戏"，开始真正的治理工程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 标准区块比较方法（SBCM）的最终定理；2. 热力学类比：加密经济为真空，实体经济为物质；3. 经济信任分类：实体锚定（法币/黄金）与方法锚定（加密）；4. 投机作为焦耳加热（转换损失）的数学证明；5. 公民可计算性（C_pot）概念。
AI.method: 1. 数学证明投机作为焦耳加热现象；2. 提出G-Cart架构设计；3. 定义代币作为"过程批次"（工业信号）；4. 将市政当局重新定义为"物理计算机"；5. 提出工作标准（1代币=1焦耳物理功）；6. 设计G-Gantt协议实现支付与物理进度的同步。
AI.findings: 1. 投机不是心理现象，而是无质量浮动能量试图通过狭窄出口进入现实世界时产生的焦耳加热（转换损失）；2. 物理距离（重力）是抵御数字剥削的终极安全防火墙；3. 通过G-Cart架构可以实现虚拟世界的"贪婪"向物理世界"公民基础设施"的转化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了治理工程作为新学科；2. 提出了经济信任的热力学分类框架；3. 数学证明了投机作为能量转换损失的本质；4. 提出了公民可计算性（C_pot）理论；5. 发展了从"金钱游戏"到"公民计算"的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供G-Cart架构的具体实施方案；2. 建立工作标准（1代币=1焦耳）的实际应用；3. 开发G-Gantt协议实现支付与进度的同步；4. 为市政当局作为物理计算机提供操作框架；5. 为解决加密经济与实体经济脱节问题提供实践路径。

title: When Politics Prices Capital: China, US Financial Power, and Geopolitical Shock Transmission in Emerging Capital Markets

detail.title: When Politics Prices Capital: China, US Financial Power, and Geopolitical Shock Transmission in Emerging Capital Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not Applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable

detail.abstract:
South Africa’s capital markets are structurally exposed to United States policy through two dominant transmission channels: (i) preferential market access under the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA); and (ii) US-anchored global portfolio investment flows transmitted via the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate cycle and emerging-market (EM) index allocation frameworks. This paper constructs a worst-case, fast-moving macro-financial stress scenario for the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) and the broader South African economy under a combined external shock: (1) a discontinuity of AGOA preferences and/or broad US tariff escalation affecting a substantial share of South African exports to the United States; and (2) a contemporaneous US-linked portfolio retrenchment (“risk-off”) episode consistent with historical EM sell-offs during global tightening cycles. Precise probabilities of such scenarios are beyond the scope of this analysis. 

Using a transparent shock-propagation framework (exports → exchange rate → inflation → policy rates → earnings and discount rates → equity valuation), the paper evaluates the sequencing and relative magnitude of repricing pressures across foreign exchange, bond, and equity markets under short to medium term stress conditions. The findings indicate that the dominant transmission mechanism is not trade exposure in isolation, but the nonlinear interaction between trade-induced currency depreciation and the higher discount rates demanded by global capital allocators as South Africa’s risk premium widens. The paper demonstrates how geopolitical trade shocks can rapidly translate into systemic financial instability through capital-market channels, even in economies with diversified export bases. The framework provides investors, policymakers, and corporate boards with a practical scenario toolkit for stress-testing earnings resilience, funding costs, balance-sheet stability, and market liquidity under adverse geopolitical and trade-policy regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个最坏情况下的宏观金融压力情景，分析南非资本市场如何通过AGOA贸易优惠和美国主导的全球投资流动两个渠道受到美国政策冲击，揭示了贸易冲击与资本流动的非线性相互作用是主要传导机制。

AI.motivation: 南非资本市场通过AGOA贸易优惠和美国主导的全球投资流动两个渠道结构性暴露于美国政策风险，需要评估这种双重冲击下的金融稳定性。

AI.theory_contributions: 提出了贸易冲击与资本流动非线性相互作用的传导机制理论，揭示了即使在出口基础多元化的经济体中，地缘政治冲击也能通过资本市场渠道引发系统性风险。

detail.abstract: Tax non-compliance among small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) remains a persistent challenge, contributing to significant revenue losses for governments and undermining the effectiveness of fiscal policies. This study examines the role of accounting software in promoting tax compliance among SMEs, investigating how digital tools can address common compliance challenges, including reporting inaccuracies, late filings, and limited transparency. Employing a mixed-method approach, the research integrates quantitative surveys of SME owners, qualitative case studies of businesses implementing accounting software, and a comprehensive review of existing literature on digital financial management and compliance practices. The findings reveal that the adoption of accounting software significantly improves reporting accuracy, minimizes errors, ensures timely tax filings, and enhances transparency in financial operations. SMEs that leverage these tools reported higher confidence in their compliance processes and a reduced incidence of regulatory penalties. The study concludes that accounting software is not merely a convenience but a critical enabler of effective tax compliance for SMEs. By streamlining record-keeping, automating calculations, and providing real-time reporting capabilities, these tools empower SMEs to meet regulatory obligations consistently. The research underscores the importance of policy initiatives and capacity-building programs that encourage SMEs to integrate digital accounting solutions, ultimately fostering a more compliant, transparent, and efficient tax environment.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨会计软件如何促进中小企业税务合规，发现数字化工具能显著提高报告准确性、减少错误、确保及时申报并增强财务透明度，是中小企业有效税务合规的关键推动因素。

AI.method: 采用混合方法：对中小企业主进行定量调查，对实施会计软件的企业进行定性案例研究，以及对数字财务管理和合规实践的现有文献进行全面回顾。
AI.findings: 会计软件的采用显著提高了报告准确性，减少了错误，确保了及时税务申报，并增强了财务运营透明度。使用这些工具的中小企业对合规流程更有信心，监管处罚发生率降低。

title: Predicting Analyst Performance: A Machine Learning Fund-of-Analysts Framework
affiliations: Paris Dauphine University, Students and CREST-ENSAE - CREST-ENSAE, students

detail.title: Predicting Analyst Performance: A Machine Learning Fund-of-Analysts Framework
detail.abstract: Inspired by Alpha in Analysts (2025), this paper investigates whether the cross-sectional and time-series heterogeneity in sell-side analyst skill can be exploited using modern machine learning techniques. We treat each analyst as a portfolio manager and construct analyst-level portfolios based on their 12-month target price recommendations, translating implied returns into systematic long–short positions. The objective is to predict one-month-ahead 12-months cumulative returns of these analyst portfolios using a rich set of analyst and portfolio-level characteristics. We extend the original framework along three key dimensions. First, we expand the information set from six to twenty-four predictive features capturing analyst behavior, portfolio composition, and historical performance. Second, we move from rolling ordinary least squares to an expanding walkforward cross-validation framework, allowing for realistic real-time prediction and model selection. Third, we compare linear and non-linear models by evaluating 8 forecasting approaches: OLS benchmarks with Ridge, Lasso, and Elastic Net regularization, as well as Random Forests, XGBoost, LightGBM, and multilayer perceptrons. Our empirical analysis covers 1,474 unique analysts and 105,866 analyst-month observations. We find that, although machine learning provides only modest improvements in point forecasting accuracy, it delivers large gains in cross-sectional ranking ability, a key input for analyst- selection and long–short investment strategies. However, for now, these gains difficulty translate into economically meaningful improvements in a dynamic “fund-of-analysts” allocation strategy that weights analysts based on predicted performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何利用机器学习技术挖掘卖方分析师技能的横截面和时间序列异质性，通过将每位分析师视为投资组合经理，基于其12个月目标价推荐构建分析师级投资组合，并使用丰富的分析师和投资组合特征预测未来收益。
AI.research_question: 现代机器学习技术能否有效利用卖方分析师技能的横截面和时间序列异质性来预测分析师投资组合的未来表现？
AI.motivation: 受Alpha in Analysts (2025)启发，研究分析师技能异质性的可预测性，探索机器学习在分析师选择和投资策略中的应用潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分析师技能异质性理论、投资组合管理理论、机器学习预测理论
AI.method: 将每位分析师视为投资组合经理，基于12个月目标价推荐构建分析师级投资组合，使用24个预测特征（分析师行为、投资组合构成、历史表现），采用扩展的滚动前向交叉验证框架，比较8种预测模型（OLS、Ridge、Lasso、Elastic Net、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM、多层感知器）。
AI.findings: 机器学习在点预测准确性方面改善有限，但在横截面排序能力方面有显著提升，这对分析师选择和长短仓投资策略至关重要。然而，这些改进难以转化为基于预测表现的动态"分析师基金"分配策略的经济意义改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了分析师技能异质性的预测框架，引入了更丰富的特征集和先进的机器学习方法，为分析师绩效预测提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资机构提供了改进分析师选择和投资组合构建的工具，展示了机器学习在金融分析中的实际应用潜力，但同时也指出了将预测能力转化为经济收益的挑战。
